jobs.title: Software Deployment Engineer
jobs.description:
About KPI Solutions

KPI Solutions is a national supply chain consulting and warehouse automation systems integrator, helping some of the biggest names in e-commerce, retail, and distribution move product faster and smarter. Formed in 2021 through the combination of Kuecker Logistics Group, PULSE Integration, and QC Software, KPI brings together decades of material handling and systems integration experience â rooted in material handling integration dating back to 1971. From initial design through go-live and ongoing support, KPI delivers engineered solutions that blend automated technologies (MHE, robotics, conveyor, ASRS, AMR/AGV) with intelligent warehouse execution software to optimize productivity, increase fulfillment speed, and build operational resilience for clients.

Position SummaryÂ 

The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is an individual-contributor role responsible for the end-to-end delivery, configuration, installation, and support of Kommand warehouse execution/control systems and related material handling hardware (pick-to-light, overhead illuminators, AutoStore, and T-sort integrations). This role owns project-level system configuration, commissioning, installation, upgrade, and live troubleshooting work independently, with minimal oversight, across both on-site and remote/office phases of the project lifecycle. It combines software commissioning, hardware coordination, database scripting, environment configuration, and formal test/sign-off responsibilities that have historically been distributed across multiple roles and a dedicated installation team.Â 

This position carries broadened scope following the consolidation of hardware installation and commissioning functions previously performed by a dedicated Systems Integration & Commissioning (SI&C) team, which has since been dissolved. The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is expected to operate as the primary and, in several functions, sole point of ownership for the responsibilities outlined below.Â 

Key ResponsibilitiesÂ 

On-Site DeliveryÂ 

  • Lead software commissioning of Kommand and peripheral hardware systems at customer sites; serve as primary technical owner, with hardware-side support from junior/peer staff.Â 
  • Own full-scope installation of pick-to-light systems, including wiring, physical installation, configuration, and functional testing â a scope absorbed from the former SI&C team.Â 
  • Own full-scope installation of overhead illuminator systems, following the same end-to-end responsibility as above.Â 
  • Conduct IQ (Installation Qualification) and UAT (User Acceptance Testing) following installation, including preparation of formal test documentation and customer sign-off.Â 
  • Serve as the sole owner of Kommand and system-level troubleshooting for live, in-production issues during on-site engagements.Â 

Remote / Office DeliveryÂ 

  • Independently deliver new Kommand installations, including application pre-configuration, database scripting, and pre-deployment testing. Sole personnel on this workstream, currently managing 4 upcoming and 1 active installation.Â 
  • Independently deliver Kommand version upgrades, including SSDT (SQL Server Data Tools) schema comparisons, version control, local pre-install testing, and direct customer coordination. Sole personnel on this workstream, with approximately 22 major upgrades planned in the current year.Â 
  • Production upgrade execution is performed after standard business hours to minimize customer downtime.Â 
  • DEV, QA, and Sandbox environment work is performed during standard business hours.Â 
  • Validate, diagnose, and remediate reported defects; route confirmed fixes to QA prior to merge and deployment. Escalation to other engineering resources is rare.Â 
  • Participate in the on-call rotation covering Kommand, AutoStore, and T-sort system escalations.Â 
  • Provide post-go-live project support on an as-needed basis, including system migrations (e.g., bin/location migrations), integration testing with customer ERP/WMS platforms (e.g., SAP/WMS), and multi-site rollout support.Â 

Project Configuration & DeploymentÂ 

  • Gather all Kommand configurations and system parameters required for a given project.Â 
  • Translate the Business Requirements Document (BRD) and customer conversations into the Kommand system settings spreadsheet, network spreadsheet, and system parameters.Â 
  • Educate the client on use of the host interface.Â 
  • Not required for all projects â dependent on whether the customer's integration involves interface changes (e.g., AutoCase, Pack & Hold).Â 
  • Configure the client's Kommand sandbox environment to be project-specific for customer testing, and support the client through that testing.Â 
  • Configure the Kommand production environment ahead of go-live.Â 
  • Assist with training on any new features requiring customer or internal education.Â 

Scope & IndependenceÂ 

This role currently operates as the sole owner of several critical workstreams, including all new Kommand installations, all Kommand upgrade delivery, and all live Kommand/system troubleshooting. The role requires the judgment and technical depth to manage customer-facing delivery, testing, and sign-off without a dedicated support team, and to make sound decisions under time pressure during after-hours production changes and live escalations.Â 

  • Demonstrated experience commissioning warehouse execution/control software and associated hardware peripherals.Â 
  • Working knowledge of SQL Server-based application environments, including SSDT schema comparison and version control practices.Â 
  • Experience with formal software testing methodology (IQ/UAT), including documentation and customer sign-off processes.Â 
  • Ability to independently diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve live production issues under time pressure.Â 
  • Comfort with hands-on installation work (wiring, hardware configuration) for pick-to-light and overhead illumination systems, or willingness/ability to develop this competency.Â 
  • Willingness to work after hours and participate in an on-call rotation.Â 
  • Ability to translate business requirements documentation and customer conversations into structured system configuration (settings, network, and parameter specifications).Â 
  • Strong customer-facing communication skills; comfortable coordinating directly with customer stakeholders during upgrades, go-live support, and system/interface training.Â 

Preferred QualificationsÂ 

  • Prior experience with AutoStore and/or T-sort systems.Â 
  • Experience with ERP/WMS integration testing (e.g., SAP).Â 
  • Background in material handling, warehouse automation, or industrial controls environments.Â

    • Vision Insurance

    • Company paid Basic Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability & Long-Term Disability
    • Voluntary Life & AD&D Insurance

    • Pet Insurance

    • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & 10 Holidays)

jobs.title: Behandlingsassistent
jobs.description:
Vi söker dig som kan vara en trygg vuxen och vill arbeta med barn i deras boende.

Vi söker just nu personal för särskild visstidsanställning (arbete vid behov).

Rekrytering sker löpande under ansökningsperioden utifrån verksamhetens behov.

Om oss

Creare omsorg- Allégatan består av ett Behandlingshem med 5 platser. Verksamheten ligger i Kil, ca 20 minuter från Karlstad. I organisationen finns även ett Behandlingshem i Fagerås samt öppenvårdsverksamhet.

Målgruppen för boendet är flickor och pojkar 8-12 år med egen beteendeproblematik. Placering i verksamheten sker enligt SoL eller LVU. De placerade barnen har minst 1-1 bemanning under all vaken tid.

Om arbetet

Vi arbetar miljöterapeutiskt utifrån en beteendevetenskaplig grund och använder ett lågaffektivt- och kognitivt förhållningssätt. I arbetet som behandlingsassistent ska du kunna skapa en trygg miljö för barnen genom en strukturerad och meningsfull vardag. Du skapar en stabil relation med barnen och söker varje dag nyfiket upp barnen för att lära dig mer om dem. Med utgångspunkt i vård- och genomförandeplaner ska du planera och genomföra behandlingsarbete tillsammans med de placerade barnen enskilt. Vi använder oss bland annat av metoderna TMO -Traumametveten omsorg, KBT för barn, TEJPING, MI - Motiverande samtal samt rePULSE. Du arbetar utifrån ett insatsschema och dokumenterar ditt arbete med barnen i vårt journalsystem. Till arbetsuppgifterna hör även allt det praktiska som uppkommer i ett hem såsom att laga mat, städa, tvätta, se till att barns hygien sköts med mera och att handleda i vardagliga sysslor. Du skall även vara delaktig i verksamhetens utvecklings- och förändringsarbete vars mål i sig skall stärka kvalitén samt skapa en bra arbetsplats.

Löpande interna utbildningstillfällen samt möten kopplade till arbetet genomförs månadsvis.

Kollektivavtal finns med Vårdföretagarna.

Om dig

Du ska ha minst 2-årig eftergymnasial utbildning inom socialt arbete såsom behandlingsassistent, behandlingspedagog, socialpedagog eller liknande utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig eller högre enligt gällande lagstiftning om utbildningskrav för behandlingspersonal på HVB-hem.

Arbetet passar dig som kan och vill arbeta i grupp tillsammans med dina kollegor för att skapa trygghet och struktur för de placerade barnen. Som person är du är kommunikativ och uppmärksam. Som person är du nyfiken och ansvarstagande för egen del samt även för barnens. Du strävar efter att vara en tydlig förebild. Du har förmågan att sätta tydliga gränser och är samtidigt flexibel i en händelserik miljö. På grund av arbetets karaktär så behövs god empatisk förmåga samt att du är lösningsfokuserad. Du behöver vara genuint intresserad av att lära dig mer om barnen och deras utmaningar. Du har gott om tålamod i en ibland långsam process, samt i pressade situationer. Ett gott bemötande gentemot barnen är något vi värdesätter högt. Du får gärna vara initiativrik, inspirerande och full av idéer. Din roll i verksamheten tillåter och uppmuntrar egna initiativ.

Vi söker dig som kan uttrycka dig väl i tal och skrift. Tjänsten kräver god dokumentationsförmåga. Du ska ha god förmåga att förstå och analysera sociala processer och problem. Du ska ha ett arbetssätt som präglas av engagemang och drivkraft. Du ska ha förmåga att ta eget ansvar och arbeta strukturerat. Du ska ha lätt för att hantera när förutsättningar och planering ändras i arbetet.

Arbetet kan vara både psykiskt- och fysiskt påfrestande tidvis utifrån de placerade barnens mående.

· Körkort för manuell växellåda är ett krav.

· Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.

  Vi är en rökfri arbetsplats.

- Assist with artworks and visual installations where needed

- Make final adjustments so everything is ready before the event begins


Evening dismantling: 18:00–20:00 (2 hours)

- Dismantle the event setups

- Collect and carefully pack decoration materials and artworks

- Move furniture and materials back to the loading area

- Load everything into the van

- Make sure all materials are collected and accounted for


Total working time: 5 hours.

Workers are welcome to stay at Finlandia Hall during the event (08:30–18:00). This is optional and is not part of the paid working hours. Lunch will be provided for those who stay.

Compensation:

€20/hour × 5 hours = €100 per person.

Payment can be made against an invoice or as work compensation using a tax card.

What Im looking for:

The work is physical and hands-on, so you should be comfortable carrying furniture, boxes and event materials.

You should be reliable and punctual, physically able to carry and move furniture, careful when handling artworks and other materials, and comfortable following instructions and floor plans.

Previous experience with event setup, exhibitions, moving, furniture installation, construction, theatre/film sets or similar work is useful but not required.

Most importantly, I need people who can work efficiently as a team and are comfortable jumping in wherever needed. This is more than an unloading job: we will be building the different event areas together according to the spatial design.

jobs.title: Bussförare i Tromsø - Norge
jobs.description:
Är du redo för ett nytt äventyr i Tromsø? Bli en del av Tide och bidra till trygga och hållbara reseupplevelser varje dag.

Vill du kombinera ett tryggt jobb med spektakulär natur och oförglömliga upplevelser?
Tide söker både tillsvidareanställda och säsongsanställda bussförare (3-12 månader) till Tromsø, en av Nordens mest unika städer. Här får du möjligheten att arbeta i en professionell och inkluderande arbetsmiljö samtidigt som du får uppleva midnattssol, norrsken och fantastiska möjligheter till friluftsliv.

Som bussförare hos oss spelar du en viktig roll i vardagen för tusentals människor. Varje dag ser du till att våra passagerare kommer fram tryggt och säkert, samtidigt som du bidrar till ett mer hållbart samhälle.

Därför väljer många Tide:
- Fast och trygg anställning hos ett av Norges största bussbolag
- Konkurrenskraftig lön enligt kollektivavtal
- Gedigen introduktion och stöd från erfarna kollegor
- Hjälp genom hela processen med förarkort/körtillstånd
- Möjlighet till tillfälligt boende vid anställningsstart
- En trivsam arbetsmiljö med fokus på samarbete och arbetsglädje

Varför Tromsø?
Tromsø kallas ofta för Nordens Paris och erbjuder en unik kombination av stadsliv och storslagen natur.
- Upplev norrskenet under vintern
- Njut av midnattssolen på sommaren
- Åk skidor och gör toppturer precis utanför staden
- Paddla kajak, fiska och upptäck fantastisk natur året runt
- Ta del av ett rikt kulturliv med festivaler, konserter och evenemang

Vi söker dig som har:
- Körkort klass D
- YKB (Yrkeskompetensbevis)
- Körtillstånd för persontransport eller möjlighet att ansöka om detta (Tide kan hjälpa till)
- För att kunna kommunicera väl med passagerare, kollegor och trafikledningen måste du behärska norska, svenska eller engelska på minst B2-nivå.
- Ett tryggt, serviceinriktat och behagligt körsätt

Lön och villkor:
Tide följer Bussbranschavtalet (kollektivavtal).

Genomsnittslönen för bussförare ligger på omkring 603 000 norska kronor per år, beroende på anställningstid, yrkesbevis, kompetens och olika lönetillägg. Utöver grundlönen tillkommer bland annat kvälls-, helg- och skifttillägg samt eventuell övertidsersättning.

Boende vid anställningsstart:
Vi hjälper dig med boende under uppstartsfasen. Under de första sex månaderna står Tide för hyran i ett av våra rum eller lägenheter.

Om du vill bo kvar efter denna period kan du hyra bostaden vidare på egen bekostnad.

Söker du eget boende kan vi även hjälpa till med hyresgaranti, referenser och praktiskt stöd i bostadssökandet.

Vi hjälper dig med körtillstånd:
För att arbeta som bussförare i Norge behöver du ett norskt körtillstånd för persontransport.

Tide vägleder dig genom hela processen, inklusive ansökan, läkarintyg och nödvändig dokumentation. Handläggningstiden hos polisen är normalt mellan 2 och 6 veckor, därför rekommenderar vi att du påbörjar processen så tidigt som möjligt.

Du hittar mer information här: https://jobb.tide.no/jobs/8337235-bussforare-i-tromso-upplev-nordens-paris

In English:
Ready for a New Adventure in Tromsø? Join Tide and help create safe, sustainable, and enjoyable travel experiences every day.

Would you like to combine a secure job with spectacular nature and exciting experiences?
Tide is looking for both permanent and seasonal bus drivers (3-12 months) for Tromsø, one of the most unique cities in Northern Norway.

Here, you will have the opportunity to work in a professional and inclusive environment while experiencing the Midnight Sun, the Northern Lights, and fantastic outdoor activities.

As a bus driver with us, you play an important role in the daily lives of thousands of people. Every day, you ensure that passengers reach their destinations safely while contributing to a more sustainable society.

Why Choose Tide:
- Permanent and secure employment with one of Norway's largest bus companies
- Competitive salary through a collective bargaining agreement
- Comprehensive training and support from experienced colleagues
- Assistance with the passenger transport licence application process
- Opportunity for temporary accommodation upon relocation
- A positive working environment focused on well-being and teamwork

We Are Looking for Someone Who Has:
- Category D driving licence
- CPC (Certificate of Professional Competence) / YSK for bus drivers
- A Passenger Transport Licence (Kjøreseddel) or eligibility to apply for one (Tide can assist)
- To communicate effectively with passengers, colleagues, and the traffic control centre, you must have Norwegian, Swedish, or English language skills at a minimum B2 level
- A safe, service-oriented, and comfortable driving style

Salary and Working Hours:
Tide follows the Norwegian Bus Industry Collective Agreement.

The average annual salary for bus drivers is approximately NOK 603,000, depending on seniority, vocational qualifications, competence, and additional allowances.

The bus industry offers various supplements, including shift allowances, evening and weekend premiums, as well as overtime pay. Salary will vary depending on the shifts worked.

Working hours may include split shifts and work at different times of the day, including weekends and public holidays. Overtime pay and other supplements are regulated by the collective agreement.

Accommodation When You Start:
We help you with accommodation during your start-up period. For the first six months, Tide covers the rent for one of our rooms or apartments.

After this period, you may choose to remain in the accommodation and continue renting at your own expense. Monthly rent typically ranges from approximately NOK 8,000 to NOK 11,000, depending on the property.

If you prefer to find your own accommodation, we can also assist with a rental deposit guarantee, references, and practical support during your housing search.

We Help You Obtain Your Passenger Transport Licence:
To work as a bus driver in Norway, you must hold a Norwegian Passenger Transport Licence (Kjøreseddel).

Tide can guide you through the entire process, including the application, medical certificate, and required documentation. Processing times with the police are normally between 2 and 6 weeks, so we recommend starting the process as early as possible.

For more information, please visit: https://jobb.tide.no/en-GB/jobs/8337402-bus-driver-in-tromso

jobs.description:
About Delinea:
Delinea is a pioneer in securing human and machine identities through intelligent, centralized authorization, empowering organizations to seamlessly govern their interactions across the modern enterprise. Leveraging AI-powered intelligence, Delineaâs leading cloud-native Identity Security Platform applies context throughout the entire identity lifecycle â across cloud and traditional infrastructure, data, SaaS applications, and AI. It is the only platform that enables you to discover all identities â including workforce, IT administrator, developers, and machines â assign appropriate access levels, detect irregularities, and respond to threats in real-time. With deployment in weeks, not months, 90% fewer resources to manage than the nearest competitor, and a 99.995% uptime, Delinea delivers robust security and operational efficiency without compromise. Learn more about Delinea on Delinea.com, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

Join our passionate, global team at Delinea and help us make the world a safer and more secure place. Our success is driven by world-class product leadership, outstanding engineers, and strategic investment from TPG. We value diversity, innovation, and a culture of respect and fairness. If you're ready to push boundaries and challenge the status quo in security, we want to hear from you.
Â 

Apply today to help us achieve our mission.

Delinea secures human, machine, and AI identities, eliminating standing privilege and reducing the attack surface across on-premises and cloud. As the platform expands into Non-Human Identity governance, AI agent identity, StrongDM, and consumption-based licensing, we are hiring a dedicated leader to own how we package value and price capability across the whole portfolio. This is a horizontal L-1 role, peer to the General Managers of Workforce, Workload and AI, reporting to the Chief Product Officer.

What You Will Own

  • Price and packaging architecture across the portfolio: tiering, licensing metrics, add-on structure, bundling.

  • Proposal quality into our monthly Price Committee: the analysis, the financial model, the recommendation, and the action register through to closure.

  • Discount governance, including band policy and the guardrails behind it.

  • Monetization for new categories: NHI governance, AI agent identity, StrongDM, consumption-based licensing.

  • Commercial readiness at launch, so packaging and pricing ship with the product.

  • The single source of truth for pricing, packaging and quoting guidance, partnering with Product Marketing on seller enablement.

  • Price realization, attach rate and competitive position, informed by competitor pricing, market benchmarks and win/loss data.

What We Are Looking For

  • 12+ years across pricing strategy, monetization, product management or product marketing, including 5+ years owning pricing as a named function.

  • A track record of building a monetization function where none existed: cadence, governance, documentation, analytical bench.

  • Experience preparing and defending recommendations to a formal pricing committee or equivalent decision body.

  • Demonstrated design of tiered packaging for enterprise software, and strong financial modeling (pricing impact, ARR and expansion, discount optimization).

  • Credibility with executive peers, holding a position on pricing under pressure without direct authority over sales or finance.

Strongly preferred

  • Cybersecurity or identity security (PAM, IAM, SIEM, endpoint); exposure to NHI, machine identity or secrets management.

  • Consumption-, usage-, or outcome-based pricing models alongside seat-based subscription.

  • Working knowledge of CPQ (Salesforce CPQ, Apttus); pricing through M&A integration or a major commercial model transition. MBA a plus.

Why Now

Pricing at Delinea has been carried by people doing it well alongside a full portfolio, and the surface area keeps growing. The opportunity is to make monetization a professional discipline, with a decision forum that already works. If you want to own monetization end-to-end rather than manage an approval queue, this role is built for it.

Why work at Delinea?

  • We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.

  • We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.

  • What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.

At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success:

  • Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do

  • Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments

  • Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team

  • Ownership - We take initiative and follow through

  • Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment

  • Global - We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.

We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays.

Delinea is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type with regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Upon conditional offer of employment, candidates are required to complete comprehensive criminal background check, verification of education, and verification of employment, per employment policy. In addition, all publicly posted social media sites may be reviewed.

Kierownik Gminnego Ośrodka Pomocy Społecznej w Dąbrowie Chełmińskiej
ogłasza nabór na stanowisko pracy pracownika socjalnego
Nazwa i adres jednostki: Gminny Ośrodek Pomocy Społecznej w Dąbrowie Chełmińskiej, ul. Długa 32, Wałdowo Królewskie, 86-070 Dąbrowa Chełmińska
Nazwa stanowiska pracy: Pracownik socjalny
I. Warunki pracy na stanowisku:
1. wymiar czasu pracy: w pełnym wymiarze - 1 etat;
2 rodzaj umowy: umowa o pracę;
3. miejsce pracy: praca administracyjno-biurowa w budynku GOPS w Wałdowie Królewskim przy ulicy Długiej 32, a także praca w środowisku na terenie Gminy Dąbrowa Chełmińska.
Zakres wykonywanych zadań na stanowisku:
1. praca socjalna;
2. przyjmowanie wniosków o pomoc i terminowe ich załatwianie;
3. przeprowadzanie rodzinnych wywiadów środowiskowych;
4. przygotowywanie dokumentacji przewidzianej przepisami prawa w celu udzielenia bądź odmowy udzielania pomocy społecznej;

7. pomoc w uzyskaniu dla osób będących w trudnej sytuacji życiowej poradnictwa dotyczącego możliwości rozwiązywania problemów i udzielania pomocy poprzez właściwe instytucje państwowe, samorządowe i organizacje pozarządowe oraz wspieranie w uzyskaniu pomocy;
8. udzielanie pomocy zgodnie z zasadami etyki zawodowej;
9. pobudzanie społecznej aktywności i inspirowanie działań samopomocowych w zaspokajaniu niezbędnych potrzeb życiowych osób, rodzin, grup i środowisk społecznych;
10. współpraca z asystentem rodziny i współdziałanie z zespołem interdyscyplinarnym oraz specjalistami w celu przeciwdziałania przemocy domowej

jobs.title: Customer Success Engineer (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
Job OverviewJoin ENPULSION as a Customer Success Engineer (f/m/x) and support our customers throughout their spacecraft missions - from pre-sales, to integration and testing, to on-orbit operations. You’ll act as the key technical partner, ensuring smooth product performance, clear communication, and successful mission outcomes in the fast-growing space industry.

Key responsibilities:
• Act as the main point of contact for project- and program management of key customers.
• Analyze customer requirements and develop compliance matrices to ensure alignment with customer needs and expectations.
• Provide technical support to the Sales team.
• Support customers with integration and operation of ENPULSION products.
• Provide technical support in the Assembly, Integration, and Testing (AIT).
• Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of ground support equipment.
• Manage and facilitate customer tests and workshops.
• Initiate, actively support and report on non-conformance processes and anomaly reviews in accordance with established processes.
• Analyze and review on-orbit telemetry, focusing on operator command sequences and thruster anomalies.
• Automate telemetry analysis with Python scripts.
• Recommend strategies and operational parameters based on telemetry and product performance.
• Provide on-orbit operations support to ensure products perform optimally in space.
• Deliver clear, concise, and well-written technical documentation.

Type of contract: Full time position with 38.5 hours/week

Salary : The minimum base salary for this position starts at EUR 2918,14 gross per month, with a planned significant overpayment depending on your professional experience and qualifications.

Your profile
• Technical or scientific education (FH/University/UAS/HTL), ideally a Master’s in Engineering, Physics, or Mechanical Engineering.
• 3+ years of professional experience in aerospace or a related industry
• Understanding of electric propulsion systems used for satellite mobility is beneficial.
• Knowledge of satellite systems, launch services, or space data platforms is a plus.
• Knowledge of Python programming language.
• Solid understanding of electronics design and operation.
• Familiarity with manufacturing processes desirable.
• Experience with documentation tools, simulation software, or mission planning tools, as well as collaborative platforms (JIRA).
• Familiarity with space industry standards and regulatory frameworks (e.g., ECSS, ITAR).
• Excellent English communication skills (spoken and written).
• Strong ability to explain complex technical issues to customers clearly and concisely.
• Willingness to travel to customer facilities as needed.
• Proactive, organized, and disciplined approach to independent work.
• Passionate about contributing to a fast-growing business and high-performing team.

Why us?At ENPULSION, you’ll join a young, international team united by a deep passion for space technology and innovation. We foster a friendly, open-minded work environment that encourages new ideas and rewards initiative. Our culture is fast-paced and growth-oriented - a place where your work will have a real impact, and where you can truly leave your mark.

Our benefits include:
• 25 days of paid vacation, plus additional compulsory paid days off
• Choice between a KlimaTicket (Metropol region), a parking space or cantina vouchers for on-site dining
• Role-dependent FlexTime and home office options
• Monthly team lunches and regular team-building events
• Learning & development budget to support your continued growth
• Firmenradl - Bike Leasing Program
• Office located at VIE Airport City with access to:
• FitFabrik Fitness Center
• Airport Health Center
• Shops, restaurants, and Crew Shop discounts
• VIE Community App for news and deals

About usMeet ENPULSION - a Space Tech company based in Wien-Flughafen Austria. Founded in 2016, it has quickly become a dominant player in the Space Industry selling some of the most advanced propulsion solutions for SmallSats to a large number of worldwide satellite platform integrators. The unique, modular solution we offer brings high performance at low cost to satellite manufacturers, fostering the democratization of space and enabling the exploration and exploitation of the solar system, positioning ENPULSION at the very heart of the NewSpace Area. The teams behind this are full of talented hardworking people, plenty of whom may just be your new lunch buddy!ENPULSION strongly believes in equal opportunities for everyone. We're encouraging applicants with diverse backgrounds to apply. All applications are processed without regard to gender, nationality, race, colour, religion, age, disability status, sexual orientation or marital status.

jobs.description:
As an (Associate) Vice President (f/m/d) at Siemens Advanta’s Strategy and Innovation Practice, you will serve as a senior leader overseeing pivotal domains: Delivery, Business Development, and People & Capability Building. Leveraging advanced expertise and leadership acumen, you will help define the next era of digitalization by crafting groundbreaking strategies and transformation roadmaps for Siemens and its global customers. The role entails direct responsibility for shaping business success, managing high-value projects, and serving as a trusted advisor for customer executives at C-level.Building on Siemens Advanta’s legacy as a global management consultancy powerhouse, the (Associate) Vice President role combines strategic depth, operational ownership, and cultural leadership—providing exposure to innovation-driven industries such as electrification, automation, and digitalization. **Ready to take your vision to the next level? Be part of a team where strategy meets technology, and innovation drives global impact.**How you will make an impact with us:

- Delivery Excellence:- Act as a trusted advisor to our customers, shaping strategic agendas and transformation roadmaps with your thought leadership.- Take operational and financial responsibility for acquiring and delivering high quality projects.- Oversee multidisciplinary teams in complex consulting engagements and large-scale programs to deliver innovative, tailored digital and organizational solutions for global industrial customers.
- Business Growth:- Shape strategic customer opportunities through thought leadership, innovative methodologies, and differentiated consulting approaches at the intersection of strategy, digitalization, and technology.- Lead the development of compelling value propositions, proposals, and solution concepts for complex transformation initiatives in close collaboration with Customer Partners and senior customer stakeholders.- Build trusted relationships with C-level executives, acting as a strategic advisor and fostering long-term partnerships across complex stakeholder environments.- Leverage Siemens’ unique expertise in industrial technology, automation, digitalization, and AI to create measurable value for customers and strengthen Siemens Advanta’s market positioning and growth.
- People & Capability Building- Develop differentiating methodologies, foster team growth, mentor employees, and build Consulting Excellence within the organization.- Inspire, coach, and grow high-performing, diverse teams ensuring an inclusive, performance-oriented consulting culture.

What you bring:

- Education: - Master’s degree or MBA from a top-tier university is desirable.- Backgrounds in engineering, physics, natural sciences, or strategic management are highly valued.
- Experience & Skills- Extensive consulting experience (8 - 12+ years), with a proven track record as Principal, (Associate) Partner or VP at a top-tier strategy consultancy, or equivalent experience in corporate strategy roles.- Track record in driving significant business growth**,** leading large-scale transformation programs, and building executive-level customer relationships.- Proven track record in leading digital transformation projects for Siemens’ customer base, focusing on industries like automotive and power & utilities.- AI expertise: Strong familiarity with AI-based strategy development and execution, leveraging AI to create impactful industry transformations.- End-to-end experience, ranging from strategy development to hands-on execution for technology-driven and industry-specific transformation projects.- Methodological depth in areas such as Target Operating Model (TOM), cost reduction initiatives, sustainability, and AI transformation.
- Working Style & Personality- Ability to thrive in a matrix organization, fostering strong internal partnerships and cross-functional collaboration.- Extensive experience leading international teams and actively creating an inclusive environment.- A leader who develops people, enjoys leading employees, brings diverse perspectives, thinks creatively, and goes beyond standard consulting approaches.- An entrepreneurial mindset and strong analytical acumen.
- Languages: The position can be filled in either Munich,Germany or Barcelona,Spain.
- Pathway 1: For candidates working in Munich and supporting primarily German-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in English is mandatory, while German is an advantage.- Pathway 2: For candidates working in Barcelona and supporting primarily Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in Spanish is mandatory, with proficiency in Portugese preferred.

What we offer you

- Attractive Compensation Package: A competitive salary that recognizes your expertise and performance.- Flexible Working Models: Enjoy time for yourself and your family through our flexible working hour models.- Continuous Learning: Benefit from specialized training and daily challenges to keep your expert knowledge up-to-date.- Innovative Environment: Become part of a team that values innovation and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Technischer Vertriebsaußendienst (m/w/d) – Marktentwicklung Ungarn (Elektroniker/in - Automatisierungs- und Systemtechnik)
jobs.description:
Sie kennen den ungarischen Markt, sind gerne bei Kunden vor Ort und begeistern sich für technische Lösungen?

Dann übernehmen Sie den weiteren Ausbau unseres Vertriebsgebietes in Ungarn. Sie gewinnen neue Kunden, entwickeln bestehende Geschäftsbeziehungen weiter und beraten Unternehmen zu unseren Dienstleistungen und Produkten. Dabei sind Sie im gesamten Land unterwegs und werden von einem erfahrenen Vertriebsteam in unserer Zentrale in Deutschland unterstützt.

- Faire & leistungsgerechte Bezahlung mit Bonusregelung
- Moderne Arbeitsausstattung mit Notebook und Smartphone
- Ein erfahrenes Vertriebsteam in unserer Zentrale als Backoffice-Unterstützung
- Viel Eigenverantwortung, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein familiäres Arbeitsumfeld

Ihre Aufgaben - SPANNEND:

Sie…

- … gewinnen neue Kunden und bauen langfristige Geschäftsbeziehungen auf
- … betreuen und entwickeln Bestandskunden im gesamten Vertriebsgebiet
- … beraten Unternehmen zu unseren technischen Dienstleistungen und Lösungen
- … erkennen Marktpotenziale und erschließen neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten

- Technisches Verständnis für erklärungsbedürftige Produkte oder Dienstleistungen
- Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie hohe Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Ungarns

Darauf können Sie sich freuen - INFORMATIV:

- Intensive Einführungsphase in der Zentrale mit Abteilungsrotation & Tandembesuchen im Außendienst
- Spannende Projekte mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und Eigenverantwortung
- Individuell abgestimmte Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
- Langfristige Perspektive in einem international erfolgreichen Familienunternehmen

Seit 1987 sind wir löwenstark am Markt – innovativ, familiär und zukunftsorientiert.

Als familiengeführtes Unternehmen mit Sitz in Hanau gehören wir zu den führenden Spezialisten für Reparatur, Verkauf und Service von CNC-, SPS- und Robotertechnik sowie Elektronik für erneuerbare Energien, Maritimer Elektronik sowie Elektronik in der Gebäudetechnik. Wir halten Maschinen am Laufen – weltweit.

Werden Sie Teil unseres #löwenstarkenteams und gestalten Sie den Ausbau unseres Vertriebs in Ungarn aktiv mit.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

jobs.title: Projektingenieur / Projektgeologe (m/w/d), Fachgebiet Geotechnik, Kufstein (Ingenieur/in - Geotechnik)
jobs.description: Die Dr. Spang Ingenieurgesellschaft für Bauwesen, Geologie und Umwelttechnik mbH ist ein mittelständisches Ingenieurbüro mit zentralem Sitz in Witten und Niederlassungen in Freiberg, Esslingen/Neckar, Nürnberg, Frankfurt, Naumburg, Hamburg, Berlin, München, Kufstein und Hannover.   Bundesweit sind wir mit über 350 Mitarbeitenden als Gutachter, Planer und Bauüberwacher in allen Bereichen der Geotechnik, dem konstruktiven Ingenieurbau, dem Tunnelbau, der Ingenieur- und Hydrogeologie, bei Umweltschutz und Altlasten, dem Natur- und Bodenschutz, im Wasserbau sowie in der Beweissicherung und bei Schadensgutachten tätig. Unser Kundenstamm besteht aus öffentlichen und privaten Auftraggebern. Der Schwerpunkt unserer Planungs- und Gutachtertätigkeit liegt im deutschsprachigen und angrenzenden europäischen Raum.   Entdecke was uns antreibt und werde Teil unseres Erfolgs!     Für unsere Niederlassung in Ottobrunn suchen wir ab sofort eine/n   Projektingenieur / Projektgeologen (m/w/d), Fachgebiet Geotechnik   Deine Aufgaben Innerhalb der Dr. Spang GmbH gibt es Geotechnikabteilungen mit Schwerpunkten z.B. in den Bereichen Straßen- / Bahnbau, Ingenieurbau, Leitungsbau oder Wasserbau. In den Abteilungen werden Erkundungskonzepte sowie boden-/felsmechanische Laborprogramme entwickelt und die Baugrunderkundung für Einzel- oder Linienbauwerke begleitet. Auf Basis der Ergebnisse werden geotechnische Berichte und Gründungsempfehlungen erstellt. Spezielle geotechnische Fragestellungen (z.B. Geothermie, Deichbau) können abteilungsübergreifend bearbeitet werden.   Deine Tätigkeitsbereiche umfassen Erstellung von geotechnischen Berichten und Gründungsempfehlungen Planung und Umsetzung von geotechnischen Erkundungskonzepten (z.B. mittels GIS) Ansprache und Klassifizierung von Locker- und Festgesteinen Ausschreibung und Begleitung von geotechnischen Leistungen Geotechnische Fachbaubegleitung und Durchführung von Kontrollmessungen Führen von Standsicherheits- und Gebrauchstauglichkeitsnachweisen (z.B. Baugruben, Böschungen, Gründungen) ggf. Kundenbetreuung und -beratung   Grundsätzlich besteht die Möglichkeit, abhängig von den Aufgaben der Geotechnikabteilung, persönlich Arbeitsschwerpunkte zu entwickeln, wie beispielsweise Entwicklung und Einsatz der Dr. Spang Gelände App für einen digitalen Workflow in der Baugrunderkundung, Bodenansprache und Ableitung von Baugrundmodellen Aktiver Einsatz der BIM-Methode (z.B. Fachmodell Baugrund) bei geeigneten Bau-/ Planungsvorhaben Dein Profil Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich des Bauingenieurwesens oder Geologie, vorzugsweise mit Schwerpunkt Geotechnik oder gleichwertige Qualifikation Mindestens Grundkenntnisse in Boden- und Felsmechanik Anwenderkenntnisse in geotechnischen Berechnungsprogrammen (z.B. GGU) von Vorteil Sprachkompetenz in Wort und Schrift Berufserfahrung erwünscht, jedoch keine Voraussetzung Sicherer Umgang mit gängigen Office-Anwendungen Führerschein (Klasse B) wünschenswert Deutschkenntnisse mindestens C1 Wir bieten dir Ein unbefristetes Anstellungsverhältnis und einen Einstieg ins Unternehmen, der durch ein sich stetig weiterentwickelndes Onboarding-Programm begleitet wird Work-Life-Balance durch Flexibilität im Arbeitsalltag (Gleitzeit, Mobile-Office-Kontingent etc.) Individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten anhand der eigenen Stärken und Interessen durch verschiedene Werdegänge Weiterbildung durch individuelles Fortbildungsbudget sowie Seminare durch unsere Dr. Spang Akademie, deren Vorträge teilweise von der IK Bau NRW anerkannt und mit Fortbildungspunkten versehen werden Flexibilität bei der eigenen, fachlichen Schwerpunktsetzung und Standortwahl Spannende und abwechslungsreiche Projekte Leistungsgerechte Vergütung und betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) Beste Arbeitsbedingungen mit modernstem Equipment Ein betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement mit verschiedenen Angeboten für die ganze Belegschaft Hohe Familienfreundlichkeit durch Eltern- und Pflegepakete Sehr gutes Betriebsklima durch persönlichen Kontakt sowie gelebte Werte eines Familienunternehmen   Weitere Informationen zu unseren Benefits findest du in unserer Recruiting-Broschüre in den FAQs unseres Jobportals unter karriere.dr-spang.de. Wenn Sie eigenverantwortliches Handeln schätzen und Sie Ihre Motivation und Leistungsbereitschaft in ein innovatives Umfeld einbringen wollen, dann werden Sie ein Teil unseres Teams und nutzen Sie die Chancen und Möglichkeiten eines wachsenden Unternehmens.   Wir freuen uns auf Ihre aussagekräftige Bewerbung mit Angabe Ihres frühestmöglichen Eintrittsdatums sowie Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellung.   - Wir setzen auf Vielfalt und gleiche Chancen für alle! Unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Behinderung, ethnischer Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung sowie sozialem oder religiösem Hintergrund. -   Unaufgeforderte Anfragen von Personalvermittlern und Personaldienstleistern werden nicht berücksichtigt.

jobs.title: Mitarbeiter:innen für den Besuchsdienst
jobs.description:
Die Wiener Sozialdienste sind eine der größten Non-Profit-Organisationen im sozialen Bereich in Wien. Wir setzen uns dafür ein, dass Menschen - egal, in welcher Lebenslage - die passende Unterstützung bekommen. Wir sind verlässlich und nah am Menschen. Wir achten auf das Miteinander, weil der Mensch im Mittelpunkt steht. 4 Mitarbeiter:innen für den Besuchsdienst Teilzeit 15 bis 20 Wochenstunden 5-Tage-Woche Einsatzort Wien

Das wird Ihr Aufgabengebiet:

Als Mitarbeiter:in im Besuchsdienst begleiten Sie unsere Klient:innen im Alltag und tragen dazu bei, deren Selbstständigkeit zu fördern und zu erhalten.

Sie sind eine verlässliche Ansprechperson für unsere Klient:innen und verfolgen unser gemeinsames Ziel, diese bestmöglich zu Hause zu unterstützen.

* Sie besuchen pro Tag mehrere Klient:innen in deren gewohnter Umgebung. Oftmals können unsere Klient:innen aus verschiedenen Gründen ihre Wohnung alleine nicht verlassen. Hier sind Sie und Ihre Unterstützung gefragt! Leisten Sie einen wertvollen Beitrag, indem Sie ihnen hilfreich zur Seite stehen.

* Sie unterstützen unsere Klient:innen beim Einkaufen oder erledigen dies für sie. Dabei achten Sie auf deren Bedürfnisse und Wünsche. Sie helfen beim Schreiben der Einkaufsliste, beim Tragen der Einkäufe sowie beim Ein- und Auspacken, damit die gewünschten Lebensmittel verlässlich zu Hause zur Verfügung stehen.

* Sie begleiten unsere Klient:innen bei Arzt- und Behördenwegen, unterstützen sie durch ihre Anwesenheit und sind für sie da, wenn Hilfe gebraucht wird.

* Sind alle wichtigen Erledigungen getätigt, so sorgen Sie für Gesellschaft bei Spaziergängen oder organisieren Freizeitaktivitäten, weil das Miteinander wertvoll ist.

Das bringen Sie mit:

Sie möchten Ihre Zeit einer sinnstiftenden Aufgabe widmen und bringen neben Engagement auch ein offenes Herz mit.

* Sie sind zeitlich sowie örtlich flexibel, damit Sie unsere Klient:innen in deren Alltag entlasten. Ihre wertvolle Unterstützung wird von Montag bis Freitag in ganz Wien benötigt.

* Sie sind eine zuverlässige Person und zeichnen sich durch Verantwortungsbewusstsein aus. Ihr Feingefühl und Ihre Empathie sind von zentraler Bedeutung für unsere Klient:innen und Sie können gut auf deren individuelle Bedürfnisse und Lebenssituationen eingehen.

* Sie bringen Offenheit mit und haben Freude am Umgang und Austausch mit älteren Menschen. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, gleich bei uns zu beginnen, da keine fachspezifische Ausbildung notwendig ist.

Das ist unser Angebot für Sie:

* Ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz mit Sinn: Freuen Sie sich auf eine abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit in einem etablierten Unternehmen - als Teil eines engagierten, multiprofessionellen Teams, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Wertschätzung und gegenseitige Unterstützung gelebte Praxis sind.

* Umfassendes Onboarding und strukturierte Einschulung: Unser strukturiertes Onboarding begleitet Sie Schritt für Schritt mit individueller Begleitung für einen erfolgreichen Start.

* Mobilität, die verbindet: Als Teil unseres Teams erhalten Sie die Wiener Linien Jahreskarte - für entspannte und umweltfreundliche Wege zur Arbeit und in der Freizeit.

* Alle unsere Vorteile für Mitarbeitende finden Sie auf http://www.wienersozialdienste.at/unsere-benefits/

jobs.description:

As a Business Development Manager - Partnerships & Growth at Trinsik, you drive partner acquisition for a global leading digital loyalty platform. Your core mission is targeting, reaching out to, and securing high-value brands to bring valuable offers into our loyalty ecosystem.

You manage the outreach pipeline end-to-end - from initial contact to signed partnership - and are measured on conversion. Our job is to build groundbreaking rewards platforms. Your job is to bring top-tier brand partners on board.

What You'll Do
º Own B2B partner and customer acquisition end-to-end for client projects - from target identification to closed deal

º Understand the value proposition of new or existing products fast, and translate it into sharp, conversion-focused outreach

º Build and manage the pipeline: prospecting, outreach sequencing, follow-up, qualification and closing

º Track, report and optimize the funnel - response rates, conversion, pipeline health - and react to the data

º Represent our clients' ventures and brands credibly to partners and decision-makers, often at senior level

º Test, learn and iterate on messaging, channels and targeting to lift conversion

Requirements
º A proven track record in (B2B) outreach, business development, sales or partnerships - you've built pipeline and closed deals

º The ability to understand a new offering fast and articulate its value convincingly

º A sales-, conversion- and success-driven mindset: you measure yourself on outcomes, not activity

º End-to-end ownership: comfortable running the full acquisition process independently, with structure and discipline

º Excellent communication and negotiation skills, written and verbal, in German and English

º Confident with CRM / pipeline tools and a data-informed approach to tracking and optimization

º A growth mindset: curious, self-driven, and comfortable being challenged

Nice to have
º Experience in high-profile brand acquisition or strategic partnerships

º Background in venture building, startups, or agency/consulting environments

º Familiarity with AI tools for outreach, research and pipeline automation

Benefits
The Numbers: €50,000 - €60,000 gross annually (positioned according to your competencies)

Daily Perk: your choice: a public transport subsidy or a tax-free daily lunch allowance.

Change of Scenery: Work remotely from anywhere within the EU (up to 20 calendar days/year) or take advantage of our sabbatical options.

Latest Software: We work with what's current. If you know something newer and better, let's test it.

International Team: A well-established, experienced crew located in Austria, Germany, Hungary and Switzerland.

Flat Hierarchies: Your input finds open ears-whether it's about designs, business ideas, or party plans.

Feedback Culture: open, and direct.

Cool Workplace: Collaboration happens right in the middle of Vienna.

In a nutshell

Work tasks: Main areas of work:
- Welcome guests warmly, assist with seating arrangements, and provide exceptional service by answering inquiries and offering menu recommendations for food and beverages. - Prepare and serve food, and hot and cold drinks to established standards, ensuring quality and consistency. - Organize workstations, operate tools and appliances in the serving and work area, and notify the kitchen of low stock levels as needed. - Maintain cleanliness and sanitation in serving and work areas, tools, and equipment; adhere to food safety laws and hygiene protocols - Operate the POS system to process cash, card, and digital payments accurately, providing receipts and resolving customer payment inquiries professionally. - Ensure cleanliness and hygiene by washing dishes, clearing tables, and maintaining dining areas, inspecting and monitoring products to ensure freshness and presentation consistency in accordance with company procedures. - Adhere to food safety, hygiene, and workplace safety protocols, including proper food handling, storage, and waste disposal. - Collaborate with team members, manage multiple tasks efficiently, especially during peak service times to ensure smooth operations, and assist with replenishing stock and supplies. - Provide support during staff absences or high-demand periods, performing duties as assigned to meet business needs. - Perform tasks assigned by the Manager adhering to schedules and deadlines. - Follow company regulations, procedures, and technical guidelines, participate in quality control checks, report issues promptly, and provide updates or reports as required.

- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Details about the schedules will be provided during the recruitment process.

Part time (0.25 - 0.75)

Tööülesanded: • Vastad sissetulevatele hinnapäringutele ja muudad need broneeringuteks.
• Haldad olemasolevaid kliendikontosid – oled nende usaldusväärne ja püsiv kontaktisik. • Arendad aktiivselt vanu ja uusi ärisuhteid reisibüroode, reisikorraldajate ja ettevõtetega. • Käid messidel ja ärikohtumistel ning külastad kliente nii Eestis kui ka välismaal. • Planeerid marsruute ja tagad, et iga kliendi transpordilahendus oleks algusest lõpuni sujuv.

Omalt poolt pakume: • Stabiilse töökoha tuntud ja usaldusväärses ettevõttes.
• Iseseisva rolli, kus sinu tulemused on selgelt nähtavad. • Rahvusvahelise kogemuse – kliendikülastused ja messid välismaal. • Konkurentsivõimelise palga – täpsustame vestlusel.

Muud nõuded: Võtab oma töö eest täieliku vastutuse – sinu tulemused sõltuvad eelkõige sinust endast.
On iseseisev – sa ei vaja pidevat juhendamist ega kinnitust, et oma tööd hästi teha. On usaldusväärne ja järjepidev – kliendid teavad, et saavad sinu peale alati loota. Tunneb end mugavalt väljakujunenud süsteemide ja protsessidega töötades. Leiab rahulolu hästi tehtud tööst ja pikaajalistest kliendisuhetest, mitte pidevate muutuste otsimisest. Valdab eesti ja inglise keelt nii kõnes kui ka kirjas – lisakeelte oskus tuleb kasuks. Eelduseks on varasem töökogemus, eelistatult rahvusvaheliste klientide ja ettevõtetega suhtlemisel ning turismi-, logistika- või autorendivaldkonnas.

jobs.title: Cloud Architect - Alibaba Cloud (H/F)
jobs.description:
About the position

As part of the global modernization of its infrastructure, our client is migrating its workloads currently hosted on end-of-life physical RKE servers in China to managed services from a Chinese cloud provider. This strategic project, estimated to last 12 months, aims to design a modern, automated, and highly available target architecture.



Contrat : Project-based permanent contract (CDI) or Freelance contract, project with an initial duration of one year (completion scheduled for summer 2027).

Location : Montbéliard area, an on-site presence of at least 2 days/week will be required for the first 2 or 3 weeks during the scoping phase.









Your responsibilities:

Reporting to the IT department's technical team, your responsibilities will be as follows:

Scoping and Estimation: Conduct the technical feasibility study, define the target architecture, and present the detailed estimation to the CIO in September.

Architecture Build: Design and build the infrastructure on a Chinese cloud provider (such as Alibaba Cloud), focusing on managed services.

Automation & Deployment: Replicate the existing automation mechanisms on GCP using Terraform and deploy the new clusters via Helm.

Friction Point Resolution: Design network architectures (SD-WAN, cross-border line) to maintain API connectivity with Google, manage authentication interoperability (Google Identity), and define security policies equivalent to Cloud Armor.









Profile sought

Experience : Proven and mandatory track record on a Chinese cloud provider (ideally Alibaba Cloud). We are looking for a profile with at least 5 years of experience as a Senior Cloud Consultant or Cloud Architect, who has already participated in scoping and estimation phases.

Technical Skills

Mastery of the managed Kubernetes ecosystem, managed databases, and object storage.

Expertise in Terraform and Helm.

Strong skills in international network architecture and cross-border connectivity.

GCP skills.

Knowledge of security solutions (WAF/Cloud Armor) and identity management (SSO/Google Cloud Identity).

Daily use of AI.

Soft Skills :

Analytical mindset and pragmatism to design solutions that are simple to operate daily.

Autonomy and proactive approach to guide the client in their strategic choices (e.g., alternatives to PubSub).

Ability to communicate easily with cross-functional teams.

Languages : Fluent English (international context), French or Mandarin would be a major asset.









Recruitment process :

- Initial interview with our recruiter and the head of the structure, who is an IT engineer.
- Presentation of your application to our client (following mutual agreement).
- Meeting with the client and their teams to discuss the position and expectations.

Would you like to know more? We invite you to apply and/or contact us!

jobs.title: Directrice/ Directeur hotel (H/F)
jobs.description:
Directrice / Directeur d'Hôtel (F/H) Hôtel économique de 68 chambres- région d'Aix-en-Provence Prise de poste : décembre 2026 CDI cadre, temps plein  Logement de fonction

LE CONTEXTE : Hôtel de 68 chambres implanté sur une destination dynamique du Sud-Est, portée par une double clientèle affaires et loisirs. L'établissement affiche un RPS de 82, avec un objectif assumé de progression.

Le poste s'inscrit dans un contexte de reprise, avec un projet de repositionnement à conduire : gouvernance directe, circuit de décision court et large autonomie confiée à la direction de l'établissement.

LA MISSION

* Piloter l'exploitation dans son ensemble - compte d'exploitation, structure de coûts, plannings, conformité et sécurité.
* Booster le chiffre d'affaires en optimisant le net RevPAR : pricing, mix segments, canaux de distribution et exploitation quotidienne de l'outil RMS (IDeaS), complétés par des actions commerciales locales.
* Faire progresser la qualité produit et service : satisfaction client, e-réputation, RPS, respect des standards de marque et suivi du plan de travaux.
* Manager et fidéliser une équipe resserrée, dans une culture d'exigence et de terrain.
* Structurer le recrutement : développer les partenariats locaux (écoles hôtelières, organismes de formation, agences d'intérim, France Travail), constituer un vivier permanent et mettre en place une véritable politique d'extras pour absorber les pics d'activité.
* Assurer un reporting mensuel rigoureux : résultats, écarts au budget, plan d'actions.

LE PROFIL RECHERCHÉ - Adjoint(e) de direction ou directrice/directeur front office souhaitant prendre son premier établissement - ou directrice/directeur déjà en poste sur le segment économique.

* Gestionnaire avant tout : rigueur comptable et financière, lecture fine du P&L, maîtrise des coûts, suivi budgétaire et clôtures mensuelles tenues avec précision. - Aisance réelle avec les chiffres : vous expliquez chaque écart et chaque ligne de charges, et vous ne présentez pas un chiffre que vous n'avez pas vérifié. -
* Performance qualité démontrée sur les postes précédents, chiffres à l'appui (scores de satisfaction, e-réputation, audits de marque).
* Culture topline développée : vous pilotez le prix, le mix segments et la distribution, pas seulement les coûts. -
* Autonomie, proactivité et présence terrain : le poste demande quelqu'un qui décide et qui suit.

LE PACKAGE

* Une rémunération attractive. - Logement de fonction sur place à partie de janvier 2027
* Statut cadre : fixe, complété d'un variable annuel sur atteinte des objectifs
* Incitations financières long terme sur 5 ans, attribuées selon les performances réalisées : vous n'êtes pas seulement rémunéré sur l'exploitation, vous êtes associé à la création de valeur de l'actif que vous aurez contribué à construire.

Rémunération : 45 000,00€ à 60 000,00€ par an

Avantages :
* Aide au logement

Langue:
* Anglais (Requis)

Lieu du poste : En présentiel

jobs.title: International Trainee  Fuel Engineer at Forsmark
jobs.description:
Job Description

Shape the future of energy.  

Are you ready to challenge the status quo, bring fresh perspectives and contribute to solving one of society's most important challenges? We are looking for talented graduates to join the Vattenfall International Trainee Programme. This is your opportunity to accelerate your development, build a strong network across Vattenfall and contribute to the energy transition from day one.

About the traineeship.  

This traineeship offers you a unique opportunity to kickstart your career in sustainable business. Each of the trainee positions is distinct, tied to a department within a specific business area and working location. This means that each position has its own tailored responsibilities, challenges and matching profile.  

What you will experience  

Personal and professional growth: Accelerate your development through structured learning, reflection, networking opportunities and real business challenges.

Cross-functional network: Connect with trainees and colleagues across Vattenfall's different markets, business areas and locations through programme activities, site visits and cross-functional collaboration.

Meaningful contribution: Take on real responsibilities from day one, contribute fresh perspectives and help shape the future of fossil free living.

As Joakim, a former International Trainee based in Stockholm, explains, “I expected beforehand that working at a corporate would mean only serious business. We do focus on learning and growth and bringing new perspectives to the company, but we also have fun and add humor and lightness. I feel like we are the change the company wants to see.”  

Your role as a Trainee - Fuel Engineer

The Fuel Engineering team provides technical expertise within nuclear fuel, control rods and safeguards. The team leads and supports projects related to the reactor core and fuel, including core modifications, fuel repairs, procurement of control rods and nuclear fuel, fuel and control rod licensing activities, safeguards and planning of fuel transport. The work combines technical support, project coordination and long-term development of fuel-related activities at Forsmark Nuclear Power Plant.

As a trainee, you will support both ongoing operational activities and development initiatives. Your responsibilities may include:

Supporting activities related to nuclear fuel

Participating in inspections of nuclear fuel and control rods

Reviewing technical reports, analyses and documentation

Supporting technical investigations and evaluations

Analyzing operational and inspection data

Contributing to development improvement initiatives

Collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders to solve technical challenges

The work is varied and combines technical analysis with practical activities. You may spend one day reviewing technical reports and inspection results, and another day supporting activities in the reactor hall during planned outage periods.

You will work closely with experienced team members and gain exposure to many different parts of the business. The role is particularly suitable for someone who wants to build long-term expertise within the nuclear fuel area and develop as a technical specialist over time.

Qualifications

Your qualifications as a Trainee - Fuel Engineer

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, preferably within Energy Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or another relevant engineering discipline

Excellent written and oral communication skills in Swedish and English

An interest in nuclear technology, energy systems and industrial operations

It is considered an advantage if you also have:

Experience of programming, scripting or data analysis is considered an advantage

Knowledge of MATLAB or similar tools is considered an advantage

Experience from technical projects, laboratory work or industrial environments is considered an advantage

An interest in process improvement and digitalization is considered an advantage

You should also recognize yourself in the following:

You are curious and eager to learn within a specialist field

You take responsibility and approach your work in a structured way

You work well both independently and together with colleagues and stakeholders

You are motivated by solving technical challenges and contributing to shared goals  

Whether you aspire to become an energy specialist, project manager, digital expert, engineer or future leader, the International Trainee Programme offers opportunities to explore your potential and build a meaningful career.

As Cato, a former International Trainee based in Amsterdam, mentions, “I feel we are part of leading the change in the energy transition. At Vattenfall we can contribute by adding our individual competencies and core values. I learn how to build relations and be resilient in an international organization.”  

To be considered for our traineeship, you should:  

Have completed, or expect to complete, an academic degree before the programme starts in March 2027

Have no more than one year of relevant work experience after graduation, excluding internships and working-student roles

Be fluent in English

Be available for the full-time programme from its start date

Have the right to work in the country where the position is based, or meet the stated work-permit requirements

Be open to mobility opportunities and collaborating across different locations.

Demonstrate curiosity, initiative and growth mindset while sharing our values: Active, Open, Positive and Safe.

Location:  

You will be working in the Fuel Engineering team and located in Forsmark, Sweden.

Additional Information

Our offer  

“Vattenfall provides me with the steepest learning curve. We are a group that feels connected by our core values in line with the organization's values: Open, Active, Positive and Safe. We all feel part of a movement that understands the importance of human connection, resilience, and curiosity in energy transition and sustainability.” - Rogier, former International Trainee based in Amsterdam.

The Vattenfall International Trainee Programme is the kickstart of your career within Vattenfall. Over the course of a year, you will combine meaningful work with structured development opportunities, networking, workshops and site visits across Vattenfall's business areas and locations.

jobs.title: Frontend Web Application Developer
jobs.description:
Location: Remote
Availability: 35-40 hours per week
Working hours: US East business hours
Reporting to: Lead developer

KoboToolbox has an immediate opening for a Frontend Web Application Developer to fill a full-time position of approximately 35-40 hours per week, for a commitment of at least 1 year. As a member of our team, you will share in the challenge and excitement of writing code used by over 32,000 organizations around the world. These organizations create data-driven change through the collection and analysis of more than 20 million surveys per month.

Only candidates who already have experience working on large web applications will be considered. Beyond technical acumen, we are seeking a team member who demonstrates curiosity, initiative, and a cooperative approach to problem solving and decision-making.

If you're passionate about leveraging technology to make a positive impact, we want to hear from you!

Responsibilities

  • Searching and reading an extensive, long-lived code base to understand existing behavior and conventions.
  • Recognizing when existing conventions may no longer be the best approach and suggesting improvements aligned with contemporary best practices.
  • Writing robust, concise, and reusable code with accompanying tests and documentation.
  • Reviewing other developers' code and providing constructive feedback.
  • Incorporating feedback from code reviews to improve your skills and align with team standards.
  • Using AI-assisted development tools effectively while maintaining responsibility for code quality and correctness.
  • Efficiently investigating bug reports from the support team, creating well-scoped fixes or actionable plans for resolution.
  • Scoping, prioritizing, estimating, and organizing work into manageably sized tasks.
  • Attending regular video-conference check-ins with other members of the technical team.
  • Communicating with the public in conjunction with our support staff or directly through forums, issue trackers, etc.
  • Contributing to discussions about design and architecture collaboratively with the larger team.
  • Performing other related duties as directed by the lead developer.



Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Professional experience writing, deploying, and maintaining client-side code for real-world, API-driven single-page applications.
  • Proficiency with TypeScript, React, and related technologies, including styling, state management, and efficient data exchange over HTTP.
  • Unflinching ability to work with legacy technologies such as Backbone and CoffeeScript.
  • Recent experience giving and receiving code reviews.
  • Ability to independently set up and troubleshoot a local development environment, knowing when to ask for help on genuine roadblocks.
  • Interest in data collection (surveying), particularly in humanitarian emergencies and other challenging contexts, and a desire to improve our platform for our users.
  • Proficiency with spoken and written English.
  • Fluency with Git.
  • Overlap with working hours in the Eastern time zone.
  • Average availability of at least 30 hours per week, preferably 35 hours or more.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with the following is preferred but not required to apply:

  • Using Docker and Docker Compose in a development environment.
  • Programming in Python, ideally with Django (and particularly Django REST Framework).
  • Building user-facing LLM integrations.
  • Surveying with XLSForm, ODK XForm, and OpenRosa.
  • Integrating with Stripe for payment processing.

An added note on qualifications... We know that people from underrepresented groups including women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, people with disabilities, and others are less likely to apply for a role if they don't meet every qualification listed. We're more interested in your potential and growth mindset than a perfect checklist match. If this role excites you and you meet many, but not all, of the qualifications, we'd still love to hear from you.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Kobo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.



Benefits

  • Genuine Impact: Contribute directly to projects that impact millions of people around the world globally, working alongside the largest international humanitarian organizations as well as thousands of national and small community based partners in 200 countries.
  • Meaningful Work Environment: Join a team that believes work should be meaningful as well as fun, tackling global challenges through innovative data collection and management tools with a proven impact for lasting change.
  • Diverse Team: Be part of an amazing, progressive, and globally diverse team that values diversity, equity, and inclusion across all spectrums.
  • Flexible Work Culture: Enjoy mutual flexibility supported by a culture that prioritizes work-life balance.
  • Professional Development: Benefit from generous professional development options.

 

Full Time Employee Benefits (U.S. candidates only):

  • Health & Wellness: 5 medical insurance options, dental, and vision (up to 80% premium covered), plus life insurance and Long Term Disability.
  • Financial Security: 401(k) retirement plan with 100% match up to 2%.
  • Work-Life Balance: 20 days paid time off, 12 floating holidays, unlimited sick days, and paid parental leave.

 

*Please note, if based in the US or Canada this is a full time employee position. In other locations full time employment or contractor positions are options depending on individual circumstances.

jobs.title: Barnvakt Nanny Uddevalla 5 ggr/v
jobs.description:
Om Nannynu! / About Nannynu!

Vi är ett av Sveriges största, första och mest prisbelönta barnvaktsföretag och stolta över att ha bra villkor i linje med kollektivavtal för alla våra anställda barnvakter.

Vi tror på att leverera barnvakter i världsklass och då vi är ett växande företag söker vi nu Dig som vill ge dig ut på nya äventyr som barnvakt/nanny. Vi ser till att du får jobba i en barnvaktsfamilj som passar in på din profil och att du utbildas i bland annat Barn-HLR och barnolycksfall i samband med att du börjar jobba som barnvakt på nanny.nu. Du kommer att ha tät kontakt med din närmaste chef och ett roligt extrajobb som är en merit för livet!

Om uppdraget / About the assignment

Familj söker en person som kan hjälpa till med barnpassning samt enklare hushållssysslor.

Familjen har två barn, 1,5 och 4,5 år, och önskar hjälp varje vardag, måndag–fredag. Passen är cirka 3–4 timmar per dag och förläggs ungefär mellan kl. 13.00/14.00–17.00.

Arbetsuppgifterna består främst av barnpassning, men kan även innebära enklare hushållssysslor såsom städning, tvätt och matlagning.

Vid behov kan det även bli aktuellt med hämtning från förskolan. Förskolan ligger på gångavstånd från hemmet.

Din profil / Your profile

Är du en person som vill underlätta andra människors vardag i form av barnpassning samtidigt som du har ett roligt extrajobb? Vill du ansvara för det finaste en familj har, nämligen barnen, och samtidigt hjälpa föräldrar att få ihop barnpassningen? Vill du skratta, busa och bidra till att barnen får en fantastisk stund tillsammans med en person de kan se upp till? Vill du bli en del av ett företag som levererar barnpassning i världsklass? Då ska du söka jobbet som barnvakt hos en av våra familjer!

Då barnvakt är ett extraarbete ser vi gärna att du har en annan huvudsaklig sysselsättning, t.ex. studier eller deltidsjobb och för att det ska bli en långsiktig relation vill vi att du har en rimlig restid till familjen (vi brukar tänka oss runt 30 minuter).

Sök jobb som barnvakt hos oss idag!

Vi erbjuder / What we offer

Börjar du jobba som barnvakt hos oss så kan vi erbjuda dig ett roligt och meningsfullt extraarbete med goda villkor då vi har kollektivavtal.

Du får dessutom:

    Nannycertifieringskurs där du lär dig mer om barnvaktsjobbet
    Kurs i barn-HLR
    Försäkring till, från och under arbetet
    Vi vill ha ett löneupplägg som känns bra för alla kompetensprofiler och åldrar därför öppnar vi upp för individuell lönesättning för alla som en har gymnasieexamen. För alla som fortfarande går i gymnasiet har vi en fast timlön på 132,15 - 165,19 kr/timme inkl. semesterersättning.
    Ob-tillägg samt storhelgstillägg
    Möjlighet till fast avtal med garanterade timmar
    Möjlighet till fortsatt arbete inom koncernen

Vid anställning som barnvakt hos oss begär vi utdrag ur belastningsregistret.

Vi intervjuar löpande och tipsar dig att vara snabb in med din ansökan.
