jobs.title: Library Events, Development and Partnerships Coordinator
jobs.description:
**General Mission**

The Coordinator is responsible for the development and programming of the library. They organise activities and events, develop partnerships, and contribute to the librarys visitor numbers.

They are also responsible for monitoring the collections, handling returned books, and keeping the library organised.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Library Programming and Development**

- Increase the librarys visitor numbers and appeal, taking into account the expectations and needs of its audiences.

- Promote the librarys spaces and collections by developing projects and events.

- Develop a range of paid activities and services.

- Manage the library shop and coffee area.


**2\. Talks and Debates**

- Design and organise talks, debates, lectures and events.

- Identify and invite authors, experts, associations and other relevant speakers or personalities.

- Encourage discussion, participation and interaction among different audiences.


**3\. Partnerships and Collaborations**

- Identify, develop and maintain a network of partners.

- Build partnerships and joint projects with external organisations and stakeholders.


**4\. Library Space and Collection Management**

- Ensure the efficient day-to-day operation of the library and report any issues or malfunctions.

- Handle returned books and ensure that materials are properly shelved and organised.

- Maintain the collections, including classification, presentation, repairs and replacement of damaged or missing items.

- Select and order new books and other materials.


**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a dynamic, independent and curious person who is proactive and enjoys interacting with the public. The successful candidate will play an active role in the cultural and commercial development of a welcoming and open community space.

- Excellent interpersonal skills and confidence in interacting with the public and partners.

- Ability to create and develop partnerships.

- Initiative and ability to propose and deliver projects.

- Commercial awareness and ability to identify potential sources of funding.

- Strong organisational skills, autonomy and versatility.

- A passion for reading, discussion and the exchange of ideas.


**Practical Information**

- Contract: 6-month fixed-term contract, renewable

- Working hours: 80%, spread over 4 days per week

- **Salary :** €2,268 gross per month

- Start date : October 2026

- Languages: English at C1 level required; French at B2 level preferred; Knowledge of Finnish is an advantage.

- How to apply: Please send your CV along with a short cover letter to **sg-ac@france.fi by 27 September.**

- If you have not heard from us within 4 weeks, please consider that your application has been unsuccessful.

jobs.title: Switchboard/Workplace support Coordinator
jobs.description:
Stockholm, Sweden


Switchboard/Workplace Support Coordinator

Role summary

As a Switchboard/Workplace Support Coordinator, you will play a key role in delivering workplace services and support to employees, visitors, and stakeholders. Acting as a primary point of contact, you will manage a wide range of workplace-related services including customer service, switchboard operations, issue management, administrative support, and workplace systems.

The role requires a proactive and service-oriented mindset, ensuring that inquiries, requests, and incidents are handled efficiently and professionally. You will collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to enhance the workplace experience and support continuous service improvement.

As the workplace organization evolves, the role may also include responsibilities related to access management and identification services.


Responsibilities

Customer Service & Workplace Support


    Respond to requests and inquiries via phone, email, and other communication channels.

    Deliver outstanding customer service to employees, visitors, and stakeholders.

    Investigate, coordinate, and resolve workplace-related issues, incidents, and service requests.

    Collaborate with internal teams, service partners, and vendors to ensure timely resolution of inquiries and incidents.

    Support workplace services including goods handling, mail-related inquiries, remote reception services, workplace projects, and operational initiatives.

    Maintain accurate records and documentation related to workplace services.

    Perform other duties as assigned.


Switchboard Operations


    Answer incoming calls and direct callers to the appropriate departments or personnel.

    Manage multiple communication channels professionally and efficiently.

    Provide information to callers and take messages when required.

    Support emergency communication procedures when required.



Systems & Administration


    Act as a superuser for workplace systems and support users when required.

    Coordinate and dispatch incoming fault reports to the appropriate teams.

    Perform administrative duties including data entry, filing, correspondence, invoice scanning, and archiving.

    Prepare reports, statistics, and documentation to support operational performance.



Future Scope


    Support access management and identification services, including administration of employee and visitor access solutions.

    Coordinate processes related to workplace access and security requirement




Qualifications, Education and Experience

    Passion for delivering outstanding customer experience with a high level of professionalism and integrity.

    Very good knowledge of Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

    High school diploma or equivalent.

    Experience from customer service, reception, switchboard, administration, or workplace support is an advantage.

    Good digital skills and ability to work effectively across multiple systems and tools.


Communication Skills

    Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

    Ability to communicate professionally with stakeholders at all levels.

    Strong listening, interpersonal, and customer service skills.

    Positive, professional, and solution-oriented approach.


Reasoning Ability

    Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

    Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

    High level of accuracy, attention to detail, and organization.

    Ability to assess situations and take appropriate action.


Health, Safety & Environment

Responsible for personal safety and the safety of others affected by your work. This includes:


    Completing all required QHSE training.

    Following company policies, procedures, and HSE requirements.

    Participating in QHSE activities as required.

    Reporting hazards, unsafe conditions, incidents, and near misses.

    Following safe work practices relevant to the work environment.




Working hours and location

This position is based at the client's premises in Kista. This role requires onsite presence Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 17:00, or 7.30-16.30 depending on business needs. Occasional travel to other locations may be required.

jobs.title: Assistant Professor in High Frequency Switch-Mode Power Supplies
jobs.description:
The Digital and High-Frequency Electronics (DHFE) section at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, based at the university campus in Odense, seeks outstanding individuals for full-time Assistant Professor positions in Power Electronics, focusing on power management for electronic and computing devices and systems. Successful applicants are expected to contribute to the development of academic programs and the research community. Applicants should have a PhD in Power Electronics or a closely related field. 

The DHFE section focuses on conducting research in digital and high-frequency electronics, embedded systems, control, and communication, utilizing cutting-edge reconfigurable computing and sensors. The aim is to develop next-generation electronics and computing solutions that solve technology-related challenges in fields such as autonomous robots, drones, IoT, smart grid, and healthcare.

Applicants are expected to establish and maintain a research program in high-frequency power electronics and power management for computation, along with low-voltage electronic systems. The position emphasizes converter and power-management for computing platforms and resource-constrained applications, including battery-operated, energy-harvesting, mobile, autonomous, embedded, and sensor-based systems.

The section is a vital component of our Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Science, and Master of Science programs in Electrical and Electronics Engineering in Odense. Currently, the section focuses on three research fields: 1) Drones for Infrastructure Inspections and Interactions, 2) High-Frequency SMPS and power management for low-power electronic systems, and 3) Telecommunication Systems. The section has 15 academics, including professors, postdoctoral fellows, PhD students, and engineers, to support research, industrial collaboration, and educational activities, and is growing steadily.

The SDU campus in Odense contains six faculties and soon a large university hospital, creating a great concentration of academics and students facilitating interdisciplinary research and rich student life. The city of Odense is culturally rich, surrounded by a vibrant and growing robotics community, and highly livable with a green-banked meandering river cutting through the centre and attractive residential areas.

 

Job Description

The position focuses on power management for resource-constrained autonomous, mobile, and embedded electronic systems. Relevant research areas include high-frequency power conversion, battery-operated systems, energy harvesting, power management architectures, embedded control, and analog/digital control of converters. The application domain spans from ultra-low-power electronics and sensors to mobile platforms, robotics, drones, IoT devices, and power management for embedded, compact, and high-performance computing systems.

The role strengthens DHFE’s research profile at the interface between power electronics, microelectronics, embedded systems, and intelligent electronic devices. It is expected to support shared research themes across SDU, including energy-efficient electronics, autonomous systems, battery-powered platforms, sensor networks, health technology, and miniaturized or distributed devices.

The successful candidate should work constructively both with colleagues within DHFE and also with colleagues from other research units, such as SDU Microelectronics, SDU Centre for Industrial Electronics, the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, Faculty of Health (specifically Health Tech), Mechanical Engineering, and other relevant environments, translating power electronics competence into system-level contributions for electronic devices and platforms.

 

Duties

As a faculty member, you will be responsible for developing and delivering undergraduate and graduate teaching in Electronic and Electrical Engineering, with particular attention to strengthening control and power electronics within the BSc portfolio. This includes supervising students at Bachelor and Master’s level, mentoring students, integrating with the student body, and participating in education and outreach activities. Research duties include establishing an externally funded research agenda, publishing in leading journals and conferences, supervising early-career researchers, and contributing to the development of DHFE’s research environment. The candidate is also expected to contribute to external collaboration and perform service at the section, department, university, and professional levels.

 

Qualifications Required

  • The applicant should hold a doctoral degree (PhD) in Power Electronics, Electronics, or a related subject area. 

  • Demonstrated potential for teaching undergraduate and graduate courses at the university level. 

  • The applicant must have relevant research expertise in areas related to efficient and high-frequency power converters, converter control, and power management for computing or embedded electronic systems.

  • The applicant must have teaching skills that align with the content and responsibilities of the position. This includes possessing both pedagogical and professional skills essential for carrying out the tasks associated with the role. 

  • A strong track record for research fundraising is required. 

 

For further information about the position, please contact Associate Professor Tim McRae (mcrae@sdu.dk)  or the Head of the Digital and High-frequency Electronics Section, Professor Emad Samuel Malki Ebeid, e-mail: esme@sdu.dk.  

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

  • Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must be in English and include:

  • A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages). 

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information, describing the research, along with any other relevant information, e.g. teaching experience, computational skills, etc.

  • A research plan with a focus on the development of your research line and research team. 

  • List of funded projects. 

  • Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).

  • List of publications with the most relevant publications highlighted. 

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Up to three names and emails of researchers can provide an informed reference letter at short notice. (Reference letters and other relevant qualifications may also be included.) 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected.

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file).

 

The application deadline is November 1, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

  

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and the preferred start date is from January 1, 2027. The final start date will be agreed with the successful applicant.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation.

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: Instrumentation Engineer – Project-Based Employment | Nevita | Nynäshamn
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Instrumentation Engineer looking for a hands-on role in a complex process industry environment? Nevita is currently looking for an Instrumentation Engineer for an initial three-month project assignment at our client's site in Nynäshamn, with good opportunities for extension.

Your role

As an Instrumentation Engineer, you will work closely with operations, maintenance, engineering and other technical disciplines at an established process plant. The role combines engineering activities with practical, site-based support and is well suited to someone who enjoys working close to the plant and solving technical challenges in an operational environment.

Your responsibilities may include:

    

Engineering and technical support within instrumentation and control.

    

Working with P&IDs and translating process requirements into instrumentation solutions.

    

Selection and specification of instruments, control valves and associated equipment.

    

Working with pressure, flow, level and temperature measurement.

    

Reviewing I/O, instrument loops, datasheets and technical documentation.

    

Supporting modifications, upgrades and troubleshooting of existing installations.

    

Ensuring instrumentation solutions comply with applicable standards and requirements, including ATEX.

    

Coordinating with process, electrical, automation, maintenance and other engineering disciplines.

    

Supporting commissioning, testing, I/O checks and FAT/SAT activities when required.

    

Providing technical support to site activities, contractors and suppliers.

Your profile

We believe you have:

    

A technical degree in Instrumentation, Automation, Electrical Engineering or a related field.

    

Previous experience working with instrumentation in the process, petrochemical, refinery, energy or similar heavy industry.

    

Good understanding of P&IDs and industrial process systems.

    

Practical experience with instrumentation, I/O, loops, control valves and process measurement.

    

Knowledge of ATEX and instrumentation in hazardous areas.

    

The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with operations and other engineering disciplines.

    

Good communication skills in English.

Experience with SIL/SIS and Functional Safety is considered an advantage. Experience with PLC/DCS systems, commissioning, FAT/SAT, troubleshooting or control systems such as ABB 800xA/AC800M, Emerson DeltaV or Siemens PCS7/TIA Portal is also beneficial.

About us

We are an engineering consultancy with an office in central Gothenburg and a growing presence in Stockholm. As industries transition towards a more sustainable future, we provide specialist engineering expertise to global and well-established clients within the gas, oil, chemical and energy sectors. Our projects often focus on the green transition, circular economy, CCS, hydrogen (H₂), HVO and LNG.

At Nevita, you will have the opportunity to work on large and exciting industrial projects, either on-site with our clients or in projects managed by Nevita. You will become part of a skilled and collaborative team where knowledge sharing and professional development are key values.

What we offer

    

Competitive employment terms and a flexible benefits package

    

Occupational pension, wellness allowance and dedicated time for wellness activities

    

Opportunities to work on large and technically challenging industrial projects

    

Continuous professional development and knowledge sharing

    

A social and inclusive culture where we care about each other and enjoy working together

Interested?

Submit your application today! Applications are reviewed and interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact:

📧 oscar.sahlin@nevita.se

jobs.title: Hydrauliikka-asentaja, laivateollisuus
jobs.description:
Etsimme hydrauliikka-asentajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Turkuun! Asiakasyrityksemme on erikoistunut laivateollisuuteen ja he tarjoavat kattavasti hydrauliikkahuolto- ja korjauspalveluita toimipisteellään, telakoilla ja aluksilla.

Pääasiallisena tehtävänäsi on toimia asentajana hydrauliikkaan liittyvissä huolto- ja korjaustehtävissä esim. letkujen valmistus sekä huolto. Tehtäviä voi olla aika ajoin myös sylinterityöt, öljyjen vaihto tai vaativammatkin korjaustyöt. Töitä tehdään kokoaikaisesti 37,5h/viikko ja odotamme hakijalta reissuvalmiutta, sillä töitä tehdään asiakasyrityksen toimipisteellä, telakoilla ja aluksilla. Reissujen pituudet vaihtelevat aina muutamasta päivästä pariin viikkoon riippuen telakasta/aluksesta ja tämän sijainnista, mutta useimmiten nämä sijaitsevat Suomessa tai muualla Euroopassa. Ajoittaisen ulkomaanreissaamisen vuoksi edellytämme sinulta vähintään kohtalaista englannin kielen osaamista.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

\- Aikaisempi tehtävään soveltuva koulutus esim. raskaan kaluston koulutus, hydrauliikka ja/tai työkokemus vastaavista tehtävistä on eduksi tehtävässä menestymisen kannalta.

\- Oman ajoneuvon käyttömahdollisuutta asiakasyrityksen sijainnin vuoksi ja lisäksi C-ajokortti lasketaan eduksi.

\- Reissuvalmiutta aina muutamasta päivästä muutamaan viikkoon asti ajoittain.

\- Arvostamme myös kiinnostusta tekniikkaa ja koneita kohtaan, kyvykkyyttä sitoutua tehtävään, halua oppia ja omaksua uusia asioita, kykyä omatoimiseen ja tiimityöskentelyyn, joustavuutta sekä rehtiä ja reipasta työskentelyotetta.

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan ja paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Täytä hakemuksesi ohessa olevan linkin kautta ja kerro siinä mahdollisimman kattavasti itsestäsi, osaamisestasi sekä aikaisemmasta työkokemuksestasi. Kaikki yhteydenotot: Click Henkilöstöpalvelut Oy, Seniorikonsultti Riku Koski, puh. 0504110470, tiedustelut arkisin klo 9-16.

jobs.title: Customs Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Hej Customs Operations Specialist,

Do you want to go to work and help create a better life at home?

With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our Customs Operations Specialist, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.

Your new job

As a Customs Operations Specialist, you’ll play an important part in the team and contribute to a better everyday life for the many. Your primary focus will be to send correctly compiled import declarations using a digital solution in direct contact with Customs Authorities in each country. The impact of our work will resonate in homes and hearts across the world. On a typical working day, you will:

    Control and investigate various issues to secure compliance in securing every customs declaration according to countries legislations.  

    Secure good communication and support to and from other IKEA units, external service providers and authorities within Europe to ensure timely, accurate and compliant entries according to customs rules and regulations.

    Contribute to the development of how we work and reach our goals within the department.  

What we’d like you to bring to the table

To be successful in the role as a Customs Operations Specialist we believe you are:

    Experienced in or hold an education within the field of customs and import operation, logistics or supply chain  

    Familiar with Microsoft Office tools, especially Excel

    Comfortable with working and navigating in digital IT solutions

    Fluent in both written and spoken English

It’s a plus if you also:

    Are service-minded with a clear and respectful way of communicating

    Work in a structured way both on your own, in a team and with relevant stakeholders.  

    Find motivation in routine-based work and a process driven environment with a high pace.  

    We are looking for a proactive and self-motivated individual who takes ownership of their work and continuously seeks opportunities to improve processes and ways of working.

    A broad professional network within customs, logistics, or relevant stakeholder groups is considered an advantage.

Be yourself, a Customs Operations Specialist, and more!

Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. With us, you contribute to building a democratic brand and workplace that has a positive impact on both the planet and people's lives.

Your health, wellbeing, and development matter most to us, and our benefits are designed with you in mind. As a co-worker and a person, you are an essential part of our down to earth, playful, and inclusive culture, collaborating with others across roles, departments, and even across the globe. In this curious and optimistic environment, you’ll find endless opportunities to grow. Make us the home of your career.

Customs Operations Europe & Africa in Älmhult, Sweden consists of approx. 35 co-workers, divided into 3 Support teams. Our assignment is to secure a well-functioning import and/or export process for more than 30 countries in the region, on different levels of detail. We give daily support and coordination in customs related topics within legal matters, goods flow and IT-knowledge to secure availability, affordability and ensure compliance.

We welcome your application

Get ready to assemble something new! We are currently looking for six new Customs Operations Specialists to join our team and welcome your application. We look forward to receiving your application by the 28th of September, 2026.

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. Once competence requirements are met, we will first consider impacted co-workers employed in IKEA Supply Services (Sweden) AB and secondly impacted co-workers at Inter IKEA Group.



At IKEA, we are looking for people who believe everyone deserves a seat at the table. You’re welcome no matter where you come from, what you believe, and what you look like. We don’t even care how you have furnished your home. We’re interested in you simply because you’re you. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that people’s different perspectives, backgrounds, and personalities make us better at understanding our customers’ dreams and needs. At IKEA we’re all on the same project.

If you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, just let us know.

jobs.description:
La Ligue de l'enseignement - Fédération des Œuvres Laïques de la Moselle (FOL57) recrute un(e) Directeur(rice) pour son centre d'hébergement permanent ouvert toute l'année « Les Jonquilles », situé à Xonrupt-Longemer, au cœur du massif des Vosges. D'une capacité de 250 lits, le centre accueille principalement des classes de découverte, des séjours de vacances pour enfants et jeunes, ainsi que des groupes d'adultes, familles et individuels.
En tant que directeur(rice), vous serez le garant du bon fonctionnement de l'établissement, de la qualité de l'accueil et de la mise en œuvre du projet éducatif de la Ligue de l'enseignement.
Vous partagez pleinement les valeurs de l'éducation populaire, de la laïcité, de l'engagement citoyen et de l'accès aux vacances pour tous en conjuguant vision stratégique, sens du collectif et capacité d'action.
Au sein du centre, le(la) directeur(rice) s'appuie sur une équipe permanente composée notamment de deux directrices adjointes, d'une cheffe de cuisine, d'une seconde de cuisine, d'une animatrice environnement, d'un agent technique et de personnels saisonniers et occasionnels ainsi que les services de la fédération.
Il(elle) assure la direction d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire, favorise le travail collaboratif et veille à la qualité du service rendu aux différents publics accueillis.

VOS MISSIONS
DIRECTION ET PILOTAGE DE L'ETABLISSEMENT
- Mettre en œuvre et faire vivre le projet éducatif de la Ligue de l'enseignement.
- Assurer le bon fonctionnement général du centre et la continuité du service.
- Veiller au respect des normes d'hygiène, de sécurité et de la réglementation applicable.
- Représenter le centre auprès des partenaires institutionnels et locaux.
- Veiller à la qualité de l'accueil et de la communication du centre.
- Promouvoir le centre et développer nos partenariats
MANAGEMENT DES EQUIPES
- Diriger, animer et accompagner les équipes permanentes et saisonnières.
- Organiser et répartir le travail des différents services.
- Favoriser la montée en compétences des personnels
- Mettre en œuvre le recrutement et veiller à l'intégration des personnels saisonniers et occasionnels.
ORGANISATION ET DEVELOPPEMENT DES SEJOURS
- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le service Vacances/Classes du siège de la fédération
- Accompagner les adjointes dans la préparation et le suivi des classes de découverte, des colonies et accueils de groupes.
- Développer les relations avec les prestataires d'activités et les partenaires locaux.
- Contribuer au développement de l'activité du centre et à la qualité de séjours proposés.
GESTION TECHNIQUE ET SECURITE
- Superviser l'entretien du patrimoine immobilier et des équipements avec l'agent technique
- Organiser les commissions de sécurité et assurer la tenue des registres réglementaires.
- Veiller à la mise en œuvre des 3 labels : Familles Plus, Ecolabels, Tourisme et Handicap
- Participer à la définition et à la mise en œuvre des programmes de travaux et d'investissement en collaboration étroite avec le siège de la fédération
GESTION ADMINISTRATIVE ET FINANCIERE
- Organiser le suivi des réservations et de l'occupation du centre (rooming)
- Contrôler les caisses et le compte courant du centre, Transmettre les pièces comptables au siège de la fédération où est tenu la comptabilité.
- Superviser l'économat avec la cheffe de cuisine et établir avec les adjointes la gestion du tarifs jour

CONDITIONS DU POSTE
- CDI à temps plein.
- Prise de fonction : 1er septembre 2026.
- Classification cadre selon la Convention Collective ECLAT. Indice 400 avec reprise d'ancienneté selon les dispositions conventionnelles.
- Logement de fonction possible. - Astreintes organisées avec l'équipe du centre.
- Véhicule de service, téléphone de fonction
- Mutuelle, Avantages du CSE,

Lomac A/S is a Danish manufacturing company specializing in steel constructions, working within areas such as marine, offshore, construction, and wind turbines.   • Reading technical drawings and working according to work instructions

jobs.title: Senior Carpenter

jobs.title: Manager, Solutions Consultants, UKI
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.

This role will be based in London, UK. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

 - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

 - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

 - Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

 - Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

 - Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR

 - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

jobs.title: Kundskapsledningsexpert (Borgå)
jobs.description:
**Östra Nylands välfärdsområde söker en KUNSKAPSLEDNINGSEXPERT för en visstidsanställning för tiden 1.10.2026 – 31.12.2027. Arbetet placerar sig i början vid enheten för digitala tjänster inom koncern- och strategitjänsterna, i teamet för kunskapsbaserad ledning och analytik.**

Enheten för digitala tjänster erbjuder ICTtjänster och ansvarar för utvecklingen av digitala tjänster inom hela välfärdsområdet. Du arbetar i teamet för kunskapsbaserad ledning och analytik tillsammans med andra experter inom digitala tjänster och verksamheten.

Vårt team ansvarar för välfärdsområdets kunskapsbaserade ledning, datalagret och rapporteringslösningarna. Datalagret tar emot data från flera olika patient och kunddatasystem samt bl.a. från ekonomi och personaladministrativa system.

Som kunskapsledningsexpert fungerar du som huvudanvändare för datalagret samt för andra teknologier för kunskapsbaserad ledning. Du säkerställer att datalagerlösningen betjänar välfärdsområdets behov, är nationellt kompatibel och leverantörsoberoende. Du deltar i modelleringen av datalagrets data samt i att producera, utveckla och upprätthålla rapportering. Datalagret är ett Azure Databricks-datalager och rapporteringen genomförs med Power BI. Modelleringen görs med SQL- och Pythonspråk.

Datagrunden består av kund- och patientuppgifter, ekonomiförvaltningens uppgifter, personalförvaltningens uppgifter samt andra uppgifter som är väsentliga med tanke på välfärdsområdets verksamhet. Huvuddelen av uppgifterna har modellerats enligt medaljongarkitekturen. Som expert inom kunskapsbaserad ledning förstår du data och hur data kan utnyttjas för att uppnå organisationens mål. Du är med och definierar informationsbehov tillsammans med ledningen och genomför dem via datalagret till rapporterna.

Din centrala uppgift är att utveckla utnyttjandet av datalagerlösningen och produktiviteten tillsammans med vårt team. Datagrunden ska framöver möjliggöra utvecklingen av analytik, maskininlärning och artificiell intelligens samt förbättra produktiviteten och kvaliteten i välfärdsområdets tjänster. Den exakta arbetsbeskrivningen formas enligt den valda personens kompetensområden.

Företagshälsovården handhas av Mehiläinen. Vi erbjuder också möjlighet att arbeta på distans enligt överenskommelse.

**Behörighetskrav:**

- En högskoleexamen som lämpar sig för uppgiften

- Som språkkrav krävs utmärkta muntliga och skriftliga kunskaper i det ena inhemska språket och goda muntliga kunskaper i det andra


**Vi förväntar oss dessutom:**

- Arbetserfarenhet av datalagerlösningar och/eller av att utnyttja stora datamängder i arbetet

- God samarbetsförmåga och erfarenhet av självständigt arbete inom kunskapsbaserat ledning, rapportering eller ICTutveckling och underhåll


**Vi uppskattar:**

- arbetserfarenhet och kunskaper av kunskapsbaserade ledningens uppgifter

- förmåga att lära sig snabbt

- kännedom om nationella riktlinjer för kund och patientdata inom social och hälsovården

- kunskaper i Azure Databricks, Power BI, SQL- och Pythonspråk


Anställningsvillkoren följer VÄLKA. Arbetet är dagarbete och veckoarbetstiden är 36 h 15 min. Den uppgiftsrelaterade lönen är 4290,9 euro/mån samt eventuella tillägg. Prövotiden är sex månader. Sökanden måste ge sitt samtycke till att en säkerhetsutredning genomförs.

Skicka in din ansökan senast 4.10.2026 kl. 23:59. Mer information ges av kunskapsledningschef Mervi Makkonen, tfn 040 152 8109 tai mervi.makkonen@itauusimaa.fi

Vid tillsättandet av uppgiften beaktas i första hand de anställda som sagts upp av produktionsmässiga och ekonomiska skäl inom Östra Nylands välfärdsområde, förutsatt att de uppfyller behörighetskraven för uppgiften.

jobs.title: Produktionsledare Getinge Sterilization
jobs.description:
Company description:

Getinge is a leading global provider of products and systems that contribute to quality enhancement and cost efficiency within healthcare and life sciences. We employ more than 10,000 people, and have operations in more than 40 countries. Saving lives is the greatest job in the world. Everything we do, from architectural planning to the equipment, therapies and solutions aim to secure the safest and most reliable care. As a leading medtech company, we focus every talent and resource towards helping our customers save as many lives as possible.

Job description:

På Getinge är vi engagerade i att hjälpa våra kunder att rädda liv och säkerställa utmärkt vård. Vi erbjuder innovativa lösningar för operationsrum, intensivvårdsenheter, steriliseringsavdelningar och för Life Science och institutioner. Ett jobb hos Getinge kommer att ge dig karriärmöjligheter som både inspirerar och utmanar.







Om rollen  



På Getinge Sterilization AB utvecklar och tillverkar vi steriliseringslösningar för Life Science-industrin. Nu söker vi en Produktionsledare till vår för funktionsprovning och orbitalsvets. I rollen ansvarar du för att leda och fördela arbetet för gruppen samt för att kontinuerligt utveckla personal, arbetssätt och metoder för att nå avdelningens uppsatta mål – med kunden i fokus.











Dina arbetsuppgifter








    Leda, fördela och följa upp det dagliga arbetet inom funktionsprovning och orbitalsvets, samt utveckla personal och arbetssätt
    Säkerställa att kontroll av färdig produktenhet och orbitalsvetsning utförs enligt fastställda rutiner, med fokus på säkerhet, kvalitet och kostnadseffektivitet
    Driva ett förebyggande arbetsmiljöarbete och bidra till att avdelningens kvalitets- och miljömål uppnås
    Driva och följa upp avdelningens nyckeltal inom säkerhet, kvalitet, leverans och produktivitet.
    Initiera och leda förbättringsarbete enligt Lean-principer och Getinges arbetssätt.







Rollen är placerad på plats i våra lokaler i Getinge, där ditt ledarskap och din närvaro i produktionen är centrala för uppdraget. Du rapporterar till Produktionschefen för siten.















Vad du har med dig



I den här rollen ser vi att du har följande med dig:








    Teknisk utbildning på lägst gymnasienivå, alternativt lång erfarenhet inom tillverkande industri
    Minst 5 års erfarenhet av tillverkningsindustri samt erfarnhet av personalledning inom produktionsmiljö
    Allmän kunskap inom arbetsmiljö och arbetsrätt
    Erfarenhet av arbete i kvalitetsstyrd industri, exempelvis medicinteknik, läkemedel, processindustri eller liknande, är meriterande
    Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift







Förutom dina erfarenheter värderar vi din personlighet högt. Som person är du proaktiv, drivande och tydlig i din kommunikation. Du är strukturerad, tar ansvar för en säker arbetsplats och agerar när kvalitets- eller miljöbrister upptäcks. Du trivs med att leda och utveckla medarbetare och är van att samarbeta med olika intressenter, både internt och externt.



På Getinge omfamnar vi en lärandekultur där vi tar ansvar för vår utveckling och sätter stort värde på kvalitet och samarbete. Framför allt bryr vi oss om varandra för att vi som team och bolag ska kunna fortsatta utveckla världsledande produkter. Vi är Team Players, Forward Thinkers och Game Changers!







Vi erbjuder



Vi erbjuder ett konkurrenskraftigt kompensations- och förmånspaket, inklusive friskvårdsbidrag, familjeförmåner och gemensamma aktiviteter och föreningsliv. Allt detta för att säkerställa att vi stöder ditt välbefinnande och dina mål.



Vi har en öppen dialog mellan ledare och medarbetare, samt mellan teamen. Vi fokuserar på att utveckla människor och tillsammans skapar vi en plan för lärande och kompetensutveckling när du börjar din karriär hos oss.







Ansökan



Ansökningar kommer att granskas löpande och vi rekommenderar därför att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, dock senast 2026-10-10. Vi ber dig att skicka in din ansökan i vårt rekryteringssystem genom att klicka på knappen "ansök nu". På grund av GDPR tar vi inte emot ansökningar via e-post.



Om du har några frågor angående processen vänligen kontakta ansvarig rekryterare på   Emma.paulsson@getinge.com.







Vi ser fram emot din ansökan. Vi hoppas att du vill följa med oss på vår resa mot att bli världens mest eftertraktade medicintekniska företag.

jobs.title: Distance Technologies: Data Collection Driver
jobs.description:
**Type:** Part-time, fixed term

**Location:** John Stenbergin ranta 2, Helsinki

**Application deadline:** 1.10.2026

Drive, collect real-world data and help develop next-generation technology designed to make vehicles safer and smarter.

**What will you be doing?**

Distance Technologies is looking for a part-time Data Collection Driver to support the development of its next-generation display technologies. Your main responsibility is to drive a Distance-provided car and collect camera and sensor data in different environments around the capital area. The data is used by Distances R&D teams to develop technologies such as depth estimation, positioning, and latency compensation, so your drives might take you from city streets and highways to forest roads in varying conditions.

Based on requests from the engineering team, you will plan suitable routes, operate pre-made data collection scripts from a laptop, and verify that the cameras and sensors are working properly. During the drive, you will troubleshoot basic technical issues independently, such as Wi-Fi, cable, USB device or storage problems. After each drive, you will check and upload the recordings and document the driving conditions and any unexpected events.

**What makes you a great fit?**

This role suits you if you are looking for a flexible part-time role, where you can combine driving with an interest in technology and gain experience in a real R&D environment. The role can fit well alongside technical studies, but relevant skills and curiosity may just as well come from work experience, projects or hobbies.

You are comfortable with computers, enjoy solving practical problems and can work independently based on technical instructions. What matters is a reliable approach to driving, technical curiosity, and willingness to learn.

**We expect you to have:**

- A valid Category B driving license and responsible driving skills

- Recent and regular driving experience in both urban environments and varying road conditions in Finland

- Good computer skills and confidence following technical instructions

- Ability to troubleshoot basic issues with Wi-Fi, USB devices, cables, storage and similar equipment

- Reliable and independent approach to your work

- Good English skills


**We consider as an asset:**

- Familiarity with Linux

- Experience with cameras, lenses, focusing, sensors, or similar equipment

- Basic scripting skills, such as automating a file transfer

- Familiarity with computer vision or related technologies


**We can offer you:**

- Chance to build valuable technical experience in a flexible entry-level role that can fit alongside your studies or other commitments

- Opportunity to join a growing deep tech company developing new technology for global automotive and defense applications

- Environment to improve vehicle safety, seeing how the data you collect contributes directly to its development

- Hands-on experience with advanced cameras, sensors, and test equipment while learning how deep tech products are developed

- Opportunity to work closely with experienced engineers, giving you practical exposure to computer vision and sensor development


**Practicalities:**

This is a part-time (16-32,5h/month) and fixed term position until 31.1.2027. Working hours are flexible and agreed based on data collection needs. As data collection depends on suitable weather conditions, scheduled shifts may occasionally need to be rescheduled at short notice due to weather. We therefore hope that you are flexible regarding working days and hours. In this role you will be employed directly as a aTalent employee at Distance Technologies. Start time is as soon as possible. The role will be located in Helsinki. Salary in this position is 18,00-22,00 €/hour depending on the level of your experience, and will be negotiated individually.

**Recruitment process timeline:**

- Interview rounds with Distance Technologies: week 42

jobs.title: Frøbjerg-Orte Friskole, Børnehave og Vuggestue søger pædagogmedhjælper/pædagogisk assistent til vores børnehave/vuggestue.
jobs.description:
Er du initiativrig, nysgerrig og drømmer du om at være en del af:

- en medarbejdergruppe, der har fokus på udvikling, og hvor der er plads til grin og forskellighed?

- et hus, hvor der er højt til loftet, skønne omgivelser og en kultur båret af højt fagligt niveau?

 Så er det dig, vi har brug for!

 Vores hus er opdelt i 2 grupper:

Yngstegruppen er vores vuggestue, og den er inddelt i tre grupper: Hoppelopperne, Løbebillerne og Springfrøerne.

Ældstegruppen er vores børnehave, og den er inddelt i Græshopperne, som er de ældste og kommende skolebørn, Mariehøns og Sommerfugle for de 3-4-årige.

Alle børn tilknyttes hver deres gruppe og primære voksne, samtidig med, at vi laver hverdagsaktiviteter på tværs af grupperne, når det giver mening.

 Vi har en ledig stilling i vores børnehave på 30-34 timer.

Vi ser værdien i at bringe de ansattes kompetencer i spil i for alle børn og da vi dagligt både morgen og eftermiddag arbejder på tværs af Yngste og Ældste, skal du være åben for at kunne se dig selv i hele huset.

 Vores pædagogik hviler på et fundament af grundmotorik og sanseintegration, altid bakket op af anerkendelse, nærvær, tilknytning og stjernestunder. Der skal være plads til udfoldelse og tid til fordybelse sammen med børnene og børnene imellem.

Vores naturskønne område med skov i baghaven og Frøbjerg Bavnehøj som nærmeste nabo, lægger op til en aktiv hverdag præget af aktiviteter både ude og inde. Kun fantasien sætter grænser…... også for de voksne.

 Vi lægger stor vægt på fællesskabets betydning for alle børn. Ved at understøtte den enkeltes udvikling, sikrer vi barnets mulighed for at føle sig inkluderet og som en del af en helhed.

Vi prioriterer et tæt forældresamarbejde, hvor vi i fællesskab altid sigter mod at vende vilkår til muligheder.

 Vi drømmer om at: 

·         Du elsker udelivet og ser uderummet som en integreret del af børnelivet.

·         Du har stor interesse for, og gerne erfaring med sanseintegration og børns motoriske udvikling.

·         Du er optaget af LEG og Langsom Pædagogik, og du understøtter naturligt børnenes egne initiativer og fordybelse.

·         Du har fagligheden i fokus og reflekterer gerne over egen og andres praksis.

·         Du kan se dig selv i en personalegruppe, hvor der er plads til livsglæde, humor, selvstændighed, fleksibilitet og gå på mod.

·         Du får øje på fordelene i at være en del af friskolelivet, -det tværfaglige samarbejde og den røde tråd på hele Frøbjerg-Orte Friskole, Børnehave og Vuggestue.

Frøbjerg-Orte Friskole, Børnehave og Vuggestue rummer tilsammen pt. 185 skoleelever, 47 børn på Ældstegruppen og 33 børn på Yngstegruppen. Stedet drives af en forældrevalgt bestyrelse, bakket op af forældreråd i børnehave/vuggestue.

Vi er ca. 48 medarbejdere fordelt mellem lærere, pædagoger, pædagogmedhjælpere, studerende, forretningsfører samt praktisk personale. Ledelsen består af Konstitueret Skoleleder og Pædagogisk Leder.

 Hvordan ansøger du?

 Stillingen er til ansættelse pr 1. december 2026.

 Vi ser meget gerne at du prioriterer at komme og besøge os, da det giver os mulighed for at vise dig alt det vi kan tilbyde og samtidig kan du mærke stemningen i huset. Ring til os for at lave en aftale om besøg.

 Ansøgningsfrist er senest d. 5. oktober 2026. Samtaler vil blive afholdt løbende.

 Ansøgning og bilag sendes som en PDF til: ansoegning@fofri.dk Skriv dit navn i emnefeltet. Du kan læse og se meget om os på vores hjemmeside http://www.fofri.dk

 Personlig kontakt til pædagogisk leder: Rikke Skovhøj tlf. 54552155 mail: bhleder@fofri.dk eller konstitueret skoleleder Kim Hedegaard tlf. 25143454 mail: viceleder@fofri.dk

Ansættelse sker i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst ”aftale om løn – og ansættelse for pædagogisk personale i de frie grundskoler”.

 Hvis du ikke har hørt fra os inden d. 30. oktober 2026, er stillingen besat til anden side.

Din ansøgning vil blive opbevaret i 6 mdr. Herefter bliver den slettet.

Company? Vend, home of FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA & Bilbasen, where millions of people across the Nordics connect to find what they need, whether it’s a job, a home, a way to move, or a fresh start.

Location? Join us in our central and modern Stockholm office, with the flexibility to work 3 days per week remotely!

Why us? This is your chance to step into a key role covering for one of our team members on parental leave! You will get to make a direct impact in a high-energy phase environment where you can shape our sales strategy, experiment with new ideas, and build the blueprint for the future while growing professionally across a Nordic scale.

Sounds like your cup of tea? Check out the details below!

WHO ARE YOU?

    Sales & Industry Experience: Background in proactive B2B sales, account management, or outbound sales with proven results and industry experience.

    Relationship Builder & Deal Closer: Skilled at combining consultative, insight-driven advisory sales for long-term partnerships with quicker, high-volume transactional outreach.

    Team Player: You embody a "team first" mindset and are driven by collective achievements and team performance.
    Data-Driven Mindset: Ability to comfortably use data and statistics to demonstrate clear value and ROI to clients.
    Entrepreneurial & Adaptable: Comfortable challenging existing ways of working, sharing fresh inputs, and finding new golden paths to success in a dynamic, evolving environment.
    Language Skills: Fluent in Swedish and English to build trust with local clients across Sweden and collaborate seamlessly with our Nordic colleagues.

WHAT’S THE JOB LIKE?

Focus on:

    Mission: Step in to support and grow a broad and exciting client base across the entire mobility sector, ranging from small and large car dealerships to sellers of MCs, boats, heavy vehicles, and RVs/caravans. You will reach out to existing accounts while positioning Blocket as their preferred platform to help them unlock their full business potential.
    Daily/Weekly Rhythm: Combine proactive, high-touch consultative calls and digital meetings with targeted outreach to mid-tier and smaller accounts.You will present data-driven insights to show the value of upsell products and advertising solutions.
    Key Projects: Help shape our outbound sales strategy, test new pitch models, and collaborate with Nordic teams to build a unified sales playbook.
    Stakeholders: Externally, a broad and exciting range of business clients across the entire mobility sector, from small and large car dealerships to sellers of motorcycles, boats, heavy vehicles, and RVs/caravans. Internally, our Blocket sales team, as well as Outbound teams in Norway and Denmark.

The challenge to turn into an opportunity!

We are in an exciting, high-energy phase where we continuously test new ways of working and build new structures as we grow. We’re looking for someone who thrives in change, isn't afraid of a shifting environment, and wants the freedom to test new ideas and shape our sales blueprint.

Hi! My name is Ida Karlsson, and I lead our fantastic Mobility Outbound Sales team in Sweden. We are a close-knit, driven team of five Account Managers who always prioritize team success. Our greatest strength is our ”team first' mindset, and that is precisely the culture I want to continue building with the team. I am looking for someone with industry experience and that extra spark to build strong, long-term relationships, a person who dares to challenge existing structures and find new paths to success.

GOT YOUR ATTENTION? Let us hear from you!

Make sure to apply by the 4th of October, we’re looking forward to hearing from you!

Sales Manager Ida Karlsson is happy to provide information about the daily work and answer any questions you may have about the role. Contact information is found in the bottom of the ad.

Want to get a feel for our culture and what drives us? Take a peek behind the scenes at our Career Page!

At Vend, our mission is simple: Smart choices made easy.

We’re here to make sustainable living effortless through seamless digital experiences. As part of a dynamic family of marketplaces, including FINN, Blocket, Tori, Bytbil, Oikotie, Bilbasen, and DBA, we connect people with services and products that matter.

Driven by purpose and curiosity, we constantly evolve to meet today’s needs and shape a smarter, more sustainable tomorrow.

At Vend, your time matters. We want you to explore new paths to smarter. Be curious with technology and lean forward. Dare to try, learn, and try again, as we innovate, grow and succeed together. Because your time matters. And when spent wisely, it creates value for you, for Vend, and society as a whole.

jobs.title: Backend developer
jobs.description:
About Froda

Froda was founded in 2015 with a clear vision – to revolutionize the banking experience for entrepreneurs by making it easy and affordable to invest in their ideas. Today, we are one of Sweden's fastest-growing fintech companies with large international growth plans. We are a creative tech company with the ambition to turn a historically expensive and unfair industry into something ethical and sustainable by promoting entrepreneurship.

Our mission to revolutionize the banking experience for entrepreneurs is not only reflected in our products but also in our workplace. By fostering a culture of respect, collaboration, and continuous learning, we provide opportunities for personal growth and professional development. Join us in transforming the banking industry and be a part of our journey to empower entrepreneurs.

About the Role

To further develop and scale our tech platform, enabling us to continue improving the banking experience for entrepreneurs, we are expanding our tech department. As a Backend Developer at Froda, you will be part of a cross-functional team working in one of our product areas — either developing features for our partners, improving our credit systems or maintaining our loan and payments core. For each team, the idea is to continuously deliver customer value as well as to improve the technical structure to make sure our systems are stable and healthy. Together with your team, you will design, build, and deliver scalable and maintainable solutions that directly impact our customers.

You will get a unique chance to be a part of a scaling fintech company with strong momentum and a stable foundation, backed by a banking license as a quality stamp.

Who are you?

We believe that you are an experienced and curious developer who thrives in collaborative environments and is passionate about building scalable solutions with real impact. You enjoy working closely with other skilled and open-minded professionals and actively contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. You are a pragmatic problem solver who communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are fluent in English, Swedish is a plus.

We believe that you have experience of:

    

At least 4 years in a similar role, ideally within product-focused teams

    

Programming in C#/.NET with a solid understanding of modern software design principles

    

Working with SQL and NoSQL databases in production environments

    

Cloud platforms such as Azure (or other major providers)

    

Agile methodologies and best practices in software engineering, including testing, CI/CD, and DevOps mindset

    

Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, RabbitMQ, and microservices architecture is a strong plus

What’s in it for you?

At Froda, you’ll be part of a company that combines the best of both worlds – a fast-moving, high-energy culture with the stability and structure to support long-term success. We’re 100+ ambitious self-starters who genuinely care for each other and the work we do, all while having fun together.

Here, you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership of your work, develop your skills, and shape your own growth journey. With big ambitions and a rapidly evolving business, there’s plenty of room to grow, lead initiatives, and make a real impact on both our company and the industry. If you're looking to be part of a success story and contribute to something bigger, this is the place for you.

Furthermore, you’ll get:

    

An opportunity to be part of an exciting journey, shaping the future of our company and transforming the SME financing landscape

    

Fabulous office overlooking Stockholm and a friendly culture that values work/life balance

    

We prioritize working in the office to maximize the positive impact of in-person collaboration, but we offer flexibility with work hours and remote work

    

Competitive compensation package

    

Insurance and pension plan

This role is all about building the tech that powers funding for thousands of entrepreneurs —if you're excited by our mission, apply or tell a friend!

jobs.title: Head Chef
jobs.description:
Arctic Skylight Lodge is a hotel opened in 2020, located less than 5 km from the center of Äkäslompolo. The surroundings are unique, as all our buildings are situated in the middle of the forest. We offer 10 glass cabins, a glass-walled restaurant with 22 seats, and a stunning riverside sauna with an outdoor hot tub, featuring views of the river and the possibility for ice swimming throughout the winter.

The restaurant serves breakfast for hotel guests, lunch, and in the evenings a three-course menu. We are looking for a Head Chef to join our team someone with the skills to create delicious and beautifully presented dishes for our guests. We expect flexibility, resilience under pressure, and the ability to lead a small team. We require versatile experience, a self-directed approach to work, and strong problem-solving skills.

We hope you can design dishes that delight our guests and make them want to return. Our menu has traditionally included three starters, four main courses, and three desserts, with flavors ranging from Nordic tastes to Asian influences. There is also a possibility to work morning shifts.

The working language is mainly English. Work begins in November and lasts until the end of the season in April. Salary is negotiable depending on experience. Accommodation is provided and it is located 1,5km away from lodge.

jobs.title: Chief Specialist, Physical activity and functional capacity
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about advancing research and innovation that improves physical activity, functional capacity, and human performance across the lifespan? LAB University of Applied Sciences is seeking an internationally recognized researcher with expertise in physical activity, functional capacity, rehabilitation, or related fields to strengthen its Physical Activity and Functional Capacity Research Group.

We welcome applicants with expertise in areas such as physical activity promotion, prevention of functional decline, neurofunctional health, rehabilitation, digital health solutions, and data-driven assessment and monitoring of human function and performance.

What your work will be like

In this position, you will contribute to the scientific development of LAB's Physical Activity and Functional Capacity Research Group and strengthen its national and international profile. You will participate in high-quality research, build multidisciplinary collaborations, and support the development of impactful research, development, and innovation activities.

You will work closely with academic, healthcare, industry, and societal partners in Finland and internationally. You will be expected to actively acquire competitive research funding from Finnish, European, and international funding programmes, publish in leading peer-reviewed journals, and strengthen cooperation between LAB University of Applied Sciences and LUT University.

Key research tasks include:

- conducting and leading high-quality research in physical activity, functional capacity, rehabilitation, or related fields.
- acquiring competitive research funding from national and international funding instruments.
- leading and contributing to multidisciplinary research, development, and innovation projects.
- publishing scientific results in internationally recognized peer-reviewed journals.
- building and maintaining strategic partnerships with industry, healthcare organizations, public-sector actors, and academic institutions.
- strengthening research collaboration between LAB University of Applied Sciences and LUT University.
- Depending on the selected candidates experience and expertise, the role may also include leadership of the Physical Activity and Functional Capacity Research Group and responsibility for developing its strategic research agenda and scientific activities.

What we expect from you

You have a doctoral degree in a relevant field, such as health sciences, rehabilitation sciences, sport and exercise sciences, physiotherapy, public health, biomedical sciences, human movement sciences, neuroscience, health technology, digital health, or another relevant discipline. Qualifications corresponding to the Finnish title of Docent (Adjunct Professor) are considered an advantage.

To succeed in this role, you should demonstrate:

- a strong track record of internationally recognized research and scientific publications.
- demonstrated success in securing competitive research funding.
- experience in leading multidisciplinary research and development projects.
- experience in collaboration with industry, healthcare, public sector, and academic partners.
- strong communication, networking, and scientific leadership skills.
- The ability to lead and develop a multidisciplinary research team; previous research group leadership experience is considered an advantage.
- excellent English language skills (CEFR C1) and good working knowledge of Finnish (CEFR B2), or a willingness to develop Finnish language proficiency. Additional language skills are considered an asset.

What we offer

The position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the future of physical activity, functional capacity, rehabilitation, and digital health research within a rapidly developing university research environment.

You will join an innovation-driven university of applied sciences with strong regional, national, and international networks. LAB provides access to a growing ecosystem of companies, research institutes, healthcare organizations, and public-sector partners that support collaboration and the development of new solutions. You will work in an increasingly international, highly skilled, and collaborative community that values openness, curiosity, and teamwork. You will also benefit from LAB's developing research infrastructure.

Your primary workplace can be either the Lahti or Lappeenranta campus. LAB follows a modern hybrid work model that combines flexibility with regular collaboration on campus.

The position is permanent and full-time, starting on 1 November 2026 or as agreed. A six-month probationary period applies.

Employment conditions follow the collective agreement for universities of applied sciences (Sivistysala ry). The position falls under the working-time system for experts and support staff, with a regular working time of 36.25 hours per week.

The monthly salary ranges from approximately EUR 5,200 to EUR 6,100 depending on the successful candidates qualifications, experience, and demonstrated expertise.

Interested? Please submit your application and CV through the recruitment system by 25 September 2026 at 23:59 (Finnish local time, UTC+2). We will review applications on a rolling basis. Only applications submitted through the recruitment system will be considered.

For further information about the position, please contact RDI Director Kati Peltonen (kati.peltonen@lab.fi, +358 44 708 1041). She is available for enquiries on Friday, 18 September 2026, from 13:00 to 14:00 and on Tuesday, 22 September 2026, from 09:00 to 10:00 (Finnish time).

Read more about the LAB University of Applied Sciences [here](https://www.lab.fi/en/info/about-us).

The best of both worlds: studies and work. The LAB University of Applied Sciences is a higher education institution specialising in innovation, business and industry. It operates in Lahti and Lappeenranta, Finland, and also online. We offer education in five fields: health care and social services, technology, business, hospitality, and design, fine arts and visual communication. We focus on supporting responsible, regenerative growth through intangible value creation, multipurpose materials, and human well-being. We have 10 900 students and 650 teachers and RDI experts.

Technical support for using the recruitment system: recruitment@lab.fi

jobs.title: CNC Machine Setter / Operator
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Position: 5-Axis CNC Machine Setter / Operator Company: N & E Precision Engineering Location: Longford, Ireland Salary: €38 to €42K / annum Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent Reporting to: Production Manager About the Role N & E Precision Engineering is seeking an experienced 5-Axis CNC Machine Setter / Operator to join our precision engineering team in Longford. The successful candidate will be responsible for setting up, proving out and operating CNC milling machines to manufacture high-precision components in accordance with engineering drawings, specifications and quality requirements. The role will involve working with 3-, 4-, and 5-axis CNC machining, with previous CNC programming experience being a significant advantage. Key Responsibilities • Set up and operate CNC milling machines, including 3-, 4-, and 5-axis equipment. • Prepare tooling, workholding, offsets and machine settings. • Read and interpret engineering drawings, tolerances and GD&T requirements. • Program, edit and prove out CNC programs where required. • Manufacture precision components to the required quality standards. • Carry out first-off and in-process dimensional inspections using appropriate measuring equipment. • Make authorised program and offset adjustments where required. • Maintain accurate setup sheets, tooling lists and production documentation. • Identify and report machine, tooling or quality issues. • Maintain CNC machines and the working area in a clean, safe and organised condition. • Work closely with Production, Quality and Maintenance teams. • Follow all company health and safety and quality procedures. Requirements • Previous experience as a CNC Setter / Operator in a precision engineering or manufacturing environment. • Experience with CNC milling and 4- or 5-axis machining. • Ability to read and understand engineering drawings. • Experience with dimensional inspection and precision measuring equipment. • Good understanding of CNC tooling, offsets and machine setup. • CNC programming experience is a significant advantage. • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality and safety. • Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Working Hours The successful candidate may be required to work either: • Day Shift: 8:00 am – 4:30 pm • Evening Shift: 4:30 pm – 1:00 am Shift allocation will depend on operational requirements Career Opportunity This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced CNC professional to join a precision engineering environment and further develop their 5-axis machining, setup and programming skills. Candidates with previous aerospace or other high-precision manufacturing experience are particularly encouraged to apply. How to apply? Please forward CV to gustavo.cainelli@guspes.com Application Process: We aim to respond to all applicants within 10 working days. If you do not hear from us within this timeframe, please consider your application unsuccessful. We may contact you regarding future opportunities.

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Joroisiin
jobs.description:
**Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Joroisen alueelle.**

Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A

- Joustavan työajan

- Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan

- Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

- Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen

- Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin


**Toivomme sinulta**

- Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan

- Positiivista ja iloista asennetta

- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi

- Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi


Edellytämme sinulta Tartuntatautilain **48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa** sekä **55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä**. Lisäksi tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteensosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti.

Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti! Lisätietoja tehtävästä kaivatessasi voit olla yhteydessä meihin sähköpostitse hkapuhr@validia.fi

**Rekrytoinnin eteneminen**

Panostamme siihen, että rekrytointi on reilua ja että juuri sinun osaamisesi pääsee esiin. Tässä rekrytoinnissa hyödynnämme **Hubert.ai -tekoälyhaastattelua.**

Hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen sinut kutsutaan chat-pohjaiseen haastatteluun virtuaalisen rekrytointiassistenttimme Hubertin kanssa. Haastattelu kestää noin 15-20 minuuttia, ja voit tehdä sen sinulle sopivana aikana. Suosittelemme kuitenkin aloittamaan sen pian, jotta rekrytointi etenee sujuvasti. Tekoälypohjainen haastattelu toimii vain tukityökaluna, kaikki lopulliset arviot ja päätökset tekee ihminen.
