Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti! Lisätietoja tehtävästä kaivatessasi voit olla yhteydessä meihin sähköpostitse hkapuhr@validia.fi

**Rekrytoinnin eteneminen**

Panostamme siihen, että rekrytointi on reilua ja että juuri sinun osaamisesi pääsee esiin. Tässä rekrytoinnissa hyödynnämme **Hubert.ai -tekoälyhaastattelua.**

Hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen sinut kutsutaan chat-pohjaiseen haastatteluun virtuaalisen rekrytointiassistenttimme Hubertin kanssa. Haastattelu kestää noin 15-20 minuuttia, ja voit tehdä sen sinulle sopivana aikana. Suosittelemme kuitenkin aloittamaan sen pian, jotta rekrytointi etenee sujuvasti. Tekoälypohjainen haastattelu toimii vain tukityökaluna, kaikki lopulliset arviot ja päätökset tekee ihminen.

jobs.title: Virksomhetsleder Miljø og samferdsel
jobs.description:
Vil du lede en virksomhet med ansvar for samferdsel, kommunal infrastruktur og offentlige rom?

Ålesund kommune søker en tydelig og utviklingsorientert virksomhetsleder for Miljø og samferdsel. Vi ser etter deg som vil lede en kompleks og viktig virksomhet med ansvar for forvaltning, myndighetsutøvelse, drift og utvikling innen samferdsel, kommunal infrastruktur og offentlige rom.

Virksomheten har ansvar for forvaltning, myndighetsutøvelse, planarbeid, drift, vedlikehold og utvikling innen samferdsel og kommunal infrastruktur. Ansvarsområdet omfatter blant annet kommunale veger, gang- og sykkelveger, parkeringsplasser, broer, kaier, trapper, parker, grøntområder, friområder, byrom, lekeplasser, offentlige toaletter og enkelte idrettsanlegg. Vinter- og sommerdrift er en sentral del av oppgavene. Virksomheten planlegger og gjennomfører også utviklingsprosjekter på kommunal veg og i offentlige rom, og følger opp kommunens ansvar i Bypakke Ålesund.

Som virksomhetsleder får du et helhetlig ansvar for fag, økonomi, personell og utvikling. Du skal videreutvikle en organisasjon med bredt ansvarsområde, sikre god drift og kvalitet, og bidra til samhandling på tvers av fagmiljø og samarbeidspartnere.

Virksomheten har tre avdelinger i dag:

  • Forvaltning
  • Drift
  • Prosjekt

Stillingen inngår i kommunalområde Samfunn, og du blir en del av ledergruppen. Sammen har ledergruppen ansvar for å videreutvikle og profesjonalisere kommunens tjenester.

Kommunens omdømme skapes av dyktige medarbeidere som hver dag bidrar med kompetanse, engasjement og samfunnsansvar på ulike arenaer.

 


Arbeidsoppgaver

Du vil blant annet få ansvar for:

  • å lede og videreutvikle virksomheten i samsvar med kommunens mål og prioriteringer.
  • å sikre forsvarlig drift, forvaltning og myndighetsutøvelse innen virksomhetens ansvarsområder.
  • økonomi, budsjett, rapportering og ressursbruk innenfor vedtatte rammer.
  • å bidra til god gjennomføring av store investerings- og utviklingsprosjekter.
  • å følge opp kommunens ansvar i Bypakke Ålesund og andre samarbeidsprosjekter.
  • å legge til rette for medvirkning, kompetanseutvikling og et godt arbeidsmiljø.
Kvalifikasjoner

Vi ønsker at du har:

  • høyere utdanning på bachelor- eller masternivå innen tekniske tjenester, samferdsel, ingeniørfag eller andre relevante fagområder.
  • ledererfaring med ansvar for økonomi, personell og fag.
  • erfaring fra kommunal sektor.
  • erfaring med organisasjonsutvikling, endringsarbeid eller komplekse drifts- og forvaltningsmiljø.
  • god forståelse for økonomistyring og offentlig forvaltning.

Det er en fordel med erfaring fra samferdsel, kommunalteknikk, drift av infrastruktur, prosjektgjennomføring eller andre relevante tekniske tjenester.

Personlige egenskaper

Vi søker deg som:

  • er en tydelig og samlende leder.
  • har god gjennomføringsevne og evne til å prioritere.
  • kombinerer strategisk blikk med operativ forståelse.
  • bygger tillit og skaper gode samarbeidsrelasjoner i organisasjonen, med politikere og med innbyggere og næringsliv.
  • er utviklingsorientert og motiveres av et viktig samfunnsoppdrag.
  • har gode samarbeidsevner, tydelig kommunikasjon og endringskompetanse.
Vi tilbyr
  • en sentral lederstilling med stor samfunnsmessig betydning.
  • ansvar for en virksomhet med høy faglig kompetanse og viktige utviklingsoppgaver.
  • mulighet til å påvirke utviklingen av kommunens samferdselsløsninger, infrastruktur og offentlige rom.
  • samarbeid med sterke fagmiljø og støttefunksjoner innen innkjøp, HR, kommunikasjon, juridiske tjenester og økonomi.
  • lønn etter avtale.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ålesund kommune er den største kommunen mellom Bergen og Trondheim, og et regionsenter for Nordvestlandet. Kommunen har rundt 58.000 innbyggere. Området rundt byr på rike muligheter for et aktivt friluftsliv for alle, jakt og fiske, og kommunen har et rikt og blomstrende kultur- og næringsliv. Ålesund er en universitetsby og har landets største universitet, NTNU.

Kommunen er en stor arbeidsgiver med sine over 4.500 dyktige og engasjerte medarbeidere som utfører viktige samfunnsoppdrag. I det daglige arbeidet vektlegger vi verdiene våre: åpen, engasjert og modig. Visjonen for kommunen er «nasjonal slagkraft, regional attraktivitet og lokal identitet».

jobs.title: System Support Technician, Lund or Stockholm or Linköping
jobs.description:
Are you the person colleagues are glad to reach when a system stops cooperating? We're looking for a System Support Technician with Salesforce experience to join our System Support team at our HQ in Lund, or our offices in Linköping or Stockholm - a role where technical problem-solving and genuine service go hand in hand.

Who is your future team?

You'll join our System Support team, ten technicians who maintain and provide first line support for a range of Axis systems, including Salesforce, our own in-house CRM, our intranet, Microsoft 365 and access management. We're part of the internal IT Helpdesk, which supports Axis employees globally.

We're a down-to-earth team where no one is too senior to pick up a ticket. We help each other out without worrying too much about who does what, and we'd rather solve the problem together than protect our own patch.

What you'll do here as System Support Technician

Your day is built around helping colleagues around the world get past whatever is standing in their way. You'll be the first line of support for our own CRM and for Salesforce, and you'll keep access management running smoothly across a range of our systems. Beyond solving what lands in your queue, you'll help make sure fewer problems land there in the first place.

    

Support colleagues globally through our case management system, ServiceNow

    

Handle access management across a range of Axis systems

    

Troubleshoot and resolve issues in the systems we support

    

Create and maintain knowledge articles and workflows

    

Collaboration with other teams on systems that connect to ours



Who are we looking for?

You're service-minded, and you enjoy the moment when a technical problem finally gives way. You're curious about how different systems work and how they connect, and you take a user-centric approach to your work. Sharing what you know comes naturally to you, and you're easy to work with day to day. You know how to prioritize, and you keep your work structured even when several things need attention at once.

You're also an early adopter who is curious about new technical solutions, combined with a pragmatic understanding that not all of them are applicable to our use cases or feasible to implement.

We'd love to hear that you have:

    

Several years of experience providing system support to users

    

Hands-on experience supporting users in Salesforce

    

An IT education, or equivalent experience

    

Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken, since we also provide global support

Bonus points for:

    

Experience working with ServiceNow as a case management system

What Axis has to offer

We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance - developing solutions used worldwide.

Curious to discover more?

We have a host of places where you can learn more about Axis, our products, solutions, company culture, and what working at Axis is really like.

Check out:

Life at Axis blog

Engineering at Axis blog

Innovation at Axis



Ready to Act?

Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications.

We go through applications continuously so don't wait - send in your application today!

jobs.title: Customs Compliance Specialist
jobs.description:
Company Description

Customs Operations Europe and Africa region in Älmhult, Sweden consists of approximately 47 co-workers. The department includes a dedicated team of Customs Compliance Specialists, alongside operational customs teams, working together to secure well-functioning import and export processes for more than 30 countries in the region. We provide daily support and coordination on customs-related topics, including legal requirements, goods flow, and IT solutions, to secure availability, affordability, and compliance.

Job Description

The Customs Compliance Specialist ensures the efficiency and compliance of the import and export activities in their region and for the countries assigned to their region.

    In conjunction with the Customs Compliance Manager, establish and maintain Compliance procedures and working methods associated with areas of responsibility
    Lead and coordinate customs classification activities within the assigned area of responsibility, ensuring accurate tariff classification, compliance, and alignment with business needs.

    Build strategic relationships with internal and external business partners, including Customs or other Government agencies
    Work with Finance, Accounting, Transport and Purchasing partners on compliance issues
    Maintain regulatory knowledge and analysis skills as business, regulations or systems change to meet the business needs
    Assume responsibility for other tasks and projects as assigned

Qualifications

We are now looking for a new colleague who wants to be a part of our amazing team. We believe you are motivated and inspired by the above assignments. You have plenty of energy and curiosity to learn, and we see that you are a person that is driven and dares to challenge people around you. You are service-minded, with a clear and respectful way of communicating. You enjoy working in a structured way both on your own, within the team and with relevant stakeholders. You have high integrity and the ability to establish relationships at all levels of the organization, based on trust. You can work with both operational and tactical issues, and you possess facilitation and trainer skills. You can prioritize your work to deliver assignments with high quality. You also can analyze the details while keeping focus on the big picture and follow up on relevant goals and deviations.

You should be:

    Comfortable with working and navigating in digital IT solutions
    Fluent in English, both written and verbal

We believe that you have:

    Demonstrated knowledge of Customs Import/Export regulations and compliance management
    Solid knowledge and practical experience in customs classification (tariff classification) and related processes, including the application of customs regulations and maintenance of classification data.  

    Experience and knowledge of Change Management
    Good listening skills and strong ability to document and communicate in a clear way
    Ability to build efficiencies and compliance into operations while meeting the business needs
    Previous experience in working with external authorities

Additional information

Please note this position is based in Älmhult, Sweden.

Please apply in English before the 28th of September 2026.

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. Once competence requirements are met, we will first consider impacted co-workers employed in IKEA Supply Services (Sweden) AB and secondly impacted co-workers at Inter IKEA Group

As we are eager to fill this position, interviews may be conducted before the application deadline. We therefore encourage interested candidates to apply at their earliest convenience.

jobs.title: Logistics Operations Developer
jobs.description:
In Purchasing Development, we enable purchasing of sustainable and affordable IKEA products by developing a strong global supplier network. We work close to suppliers, partners, Range and Supply Chain Operations to secure quality, availability, sustainability and the lowest possible cost for the many people.

Within Purchasing Development, Category Area Food is part of the Food total value chain transformation. We are shaping a simpler, more connected and more industry-relevant way of working for IKEA Food, with clearer accountability, faster decisions and stronger supplier performance. Food has its own conditions, with limited shelf life, food safety requirements, freshness needs and changing market expectations. This calls for practical, fact-based and close supplier collaboration.

We are now looking for a Logistics Operations Developer who wants to help strengthen supplier logistics performance and capability across an assigned geography. In this role, you will work close to suppliers and business teams to make sure supplier routines, data quality, logistics compliance and execution readiness support reliable, compliant and cost-conscious supply.

This is a role for someone who enjoys turning operational signals into clear improvement actions. You will help suppliers and office teams understand what needs to be improved, follow up progress and make sure repeated issues are solved in a structured way within agreed ways of working.

About the role

As Logistics Operations Developer, you will own and develop supplier logistics performance for assigned suppliers and geographies. You will follow up delivery performance, data quality, logistics compliance and launch or change readiness. You will also support supplier capability development through analysis, training, implementation follow-up and corrective actions.

You will work closely with Business Developers, Business Development Managers, Product Sourcing Leaders, Inventory Planners, suppliers and other internal stakeholders. Your input will help bring supplier-side logistics reality into business decisions, so we can improve availability, reduce recurring issues and support growth at lower cost.

In this role, you will:

    Own supplier logistics performance follow-up for assigned suppliers and geographies.
    Follow up delivery performance, data quality, logistics compliance and execution readiness.
    Translate Category Business Plan, supplier priorities and improvement needs into practical logistics actions.
    Drive supplier improvement plans and corrective actions that strengthen delivery performance, supplier routines and logistics set-ups.
    Provide supplier-side logistics feasibility, risk and readiness input for sourcing, launch, range change and deviation decisions.
    Train and support suppliers and office teams in agreed logistics requirements and routines.
    Identify process, data or digital improvement needs from supplier operations and secure the right escalation.

We are looking for someone who:

    Has experience from supplier operations, logistics, supply planning, supplier development or operational performance improvement.
    Understands supplier delivery performance, data quality, capacity and readiness, logistics set-up and compliance drivers.
    Can analyse performance data, spot recurring deviations and recommend clear corrective actions.
    Is comfortable guiding suppliers and office teams through requirements, routines and practical improvement work.
    Communicates clearly across cultures, roles and locations, with a simple and fact-based way of working.
    Enjoys solving problems structurally and helping others build capability for long-term performance.

At IKEA, low cost has a meaning. It helps us create better products at lower prices and make them available to more people. In this role, your everyday work with supplier logistics helps turn that idea into action.

You will be part of strengthening the Food value chain by making supplier operations more reliable, more compliant and easier to work with. Together, we keep the customer in the centre, act with business acumen and build a Food setup that can grow with speed, care and cost-consciousness.

We look forward to receiving your application by the 28th of September, 2026.

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. Once competence

requirements are met, we will first consider impacted co-workers at Inter IKEA Group.

jobs.title: Team Leader - Night Shift Operations

As Team Leader, you will oversee the daily operation of our night shift transport and distribution activities. You will manage a team of postmen and operational staffconsisting of 15 persons, ensuring that deliveries are completed safely, efficiently, and on time.

You:

  • Are confident managing diverse teams and multicultural workplaces

  • Have strong organizational and planning skills

  • Can work independently and make decisions under pressure

  • Possess good communication and interpersonal skills

  • Are comfortable using IT systems and operational software

  • Have a proactive mindset focused on continuous improvement

  • Are fluent in English , both written and spoken

  • Hold a valid driving license

Experience within courier, delivery operations will be considered an advantage.

What We Offer

  • A key leadership position with significant responsibility

  • Opportunities for professional and personal development

  • Salary, pension, and employment conditions in accordance with the applicable 3F collective agreement

Working Hours

This is a full-time position of 37 hours per week.

The role primarily covers night shift operations, with working hours scheduled according to a fixed roster. Flexibility is expected during periods of high operational demand, employee absences, holidays, and operational changes.

Location

Greve, Denmark

Would you like to become part of a growing transport company where service quality, reliability, and teamwork are at the heart of everything we do?

We would love to hear from you.

Send your application and CV to:
abi@lagerhotel.dk

jobs.title: Inventory Planner
jobs.description:
In Supply Chain Operations, we lead, plan and execute the supply of IKEA products between suppliers and retailers.

We work across the IKEA value chain to make sure products reach stores and retail partners in a simple, efficient and responsible way. Our shared goals are clear: availability, affordability and sustainability. Together, we help make IKEA products available for the many people.

Within SCO, Category Area Logistics Services secures and develops the logistics services that make the goods flow work in practice. We work with distribution, mid-receiver units and food logistics services. Together with our logistics service providers, we secure the right capacity, cost, service, quality, safety and sustainability.

Category Food Logistics Services is part of CALS and focuses on securing logistics solutions for IKEA Food, including warehousing, cold-chain transportation and goods flow to stores. We work with temperature-controlled flows and everyday follow-up to support availability, food safety, freshness, cost efficiency and sustainability across markets.

IKEA Food is an important part of the total IKEA experience. It helps us welcome people, bring Swedish food traditions to life, support everyday moments in our stores, and make good food available to the many people. Behind every meal, snack and food product, there is a goods flow that needs to be safe, fresh, reliable and cost-conscious. In Category Food Logistics Services, we commit to make that happen.

About the role  

We are now looking for an Inventory Planner who wants to be part of the IKEA Food goods flow, where planning accuracy supports availability, freshness, food safety and a stronger customer experience. In this role, daily planning and execution come together so food products can move safely, reliably and efficiently from supplier to distribution centre and onwards into the IKEA Food experience.

The role works closely with Category, suppliers, service providers, distribution centres and internal planning teams. You will use signals from orders, stock, forecasts, lead times and distribution to take clear inventory actions, supporting the Food transformation ambition to simplify execution, reduce handovers and focus planning where it creates business value.

In this role you will:

    Own supplier-to-DC and/or DC-DC inbound availability for assigned products, DCs and markets.
    Maintain accurate inventory and inbound flow execution, including orders, ERP corrections and physical-flow corrections.
    Act on daily inventory corrections, inbound order handling, flow bookings and deviations within agreed parameters.
    Balance availability, food safety, freshness, cost, sustainability and lead-time adherence when planning and following up the inbound flow.
    Secure supplier and logistics-service-provider execution through confirmations, holiday planning, inbound coordination and invoice follow-up.
    Manage deviations related to quality, blocked goods, shelf life, shortages and inventory accuracy with timely action and escalation.
    Improve ways of working together with suppliers, service providers, DC/LSP operations and internal stakeholders.

We are looking for someone who:

    Has experience from supply-chain operations, inventory-, supply planning, inbound logistics or DC flow.
    Works confidently in ERP e.g. Infor tools, order-management and planning systems.
    Uses operational KPIs, inventory data and deviation follow-up to make clear decisions, including using excel and Power Bi.
    Understands availability at lowest cost, freshness, quality and inventory-accuracy risks, and knows when to act or escalate.
    Communicates well across suppliers, logistics service providers and internal teams.
    Takes pride in accuracy, structure and keeping the inbound goods flow reliable every day.

Reliable availability depends on many small inventory and inbound flow decisions done right, every day.

As Inventory Planner, you help secure the right products in the right place at the right time, with good freshness, compliance, service and cost-conscious flow. You turn supplier, inventory and distribution signals into action so stores and partners can rely on stable availability, and IKEA Food can be enjoyed with trust, quality and care across markets.

For questions about the role, please contact Business Development Managers Irina Kärnsund via, irina.karnsund@inter.ikea.com or Eda Lennartsson via eda.serdar.jonsson1@inter.ikea.com or Shirley Zhang via shirley.zhang@inter.ikea.com

We look forward to receiving your application by the 28th of September, 2026.

If you have any questions regarding the recruitment process contact People & Culture Specialists Samuel Karlsson via samuel.karlsson@inter.ikea.com or Femina Ladhani Karlsson via femina.ladhani.karlsson@inter.ikea.com

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. Once competence

requirements are met, we will first consider impacted co-workers at Inter IKEA Group.

jobs.title: Laboratory Test Engineer
jobs.description:
For our client we are looking for a Laboratory Test Engineer to strengthen the project engineering team on automation and protection testing including real time simulations. 

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in power systems, testing and real time simulations. The role focuses on designing and implementing automation, protection and secondary injection tests according to customer specifications. Ideally, the candidate has a vision on how to productize simulation and testing offering. 

You will be mainly accountable for:
· Designing and implementing automation and protection testing including hardware-in-the-loop testing for power systems according to customer specifications
· Leading customer approvals and factory testing of distribution protection relays
· Maintaining the customer approval test laboratory in Vaasa
· Productizing the simulation and test offering

Qualifications For The Role:
· A B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in electrical or electrical power system engineering or equivalent
· Several years of experience working with power systems and prior experience with electrical installations or a commissioning background
· Prior experience of leading customer approvals or FATs (Factory Acceptance Testing)
· Experience with real time simulators such as RTDS, Typhoon Hil or Opal RT and relay test devices and amplifiers such as Omicron
· Experience with PSCAD or a similar software is seen as a strong benefit
· Good communication and presentation skills, including fluency in English (written and spoken), Finnish and Swedish language skills are seen as benefits

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have a B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related field?*
- Do you have at least 3 years of experience working with power systems, electrical installations, or commissioning activities?*
- Have you previously led or participated in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) or customer approval testing for protection or automation systems?*
- Do you have hands-on experience with real-time simulation tools such as RTDS, Typhoon HIL, or OPAL-RT?*
- Do you have experience using relay testing equipment such as Omicron test sets or similar protection testing devices?*

jobs.title: Business Developer
jobs.description:

Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.

As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.

- EU AI Act high-risk requirements
- Risk & control frameworks: ability to design operating controls, not just interpret legal text

- Ability to operate in delivery mode owning a workplan, running governance gates, tracking remediation (not only advisory mode)

Background could include:
- AI governance/responsible AI programme delivery
- Quantitative risk analyst - Financial-services compliance or operational risk

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalle
jobs.description:
Haluaisitko tehdä merkityksellistä ja joustavaa osa-aikatyötä apua tarvitsevien sympaattisten asiakkaiden kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, eläkeläinen tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Etsimme helpperiä avustamaan 16-vuotiasta asiakastamme koulupäivien ajan. Työaika arkisin klo 8-14.30.

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, lasten ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme tai isäämme.

Mikä on helpperi?
Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua, seuraa ja/tai tukee kodin puhtaanapidossa omaa nimettyä avustettavaa henkilöä, kuten ikäihmistä. Helpperin työ voi sisältää avustajan tehtäviä, kuten asiakkaan tukemista kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, kauppareissuilla, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain kahvitellen yhdessäolon ja jutustelun merkeissä. Etsimme myös avustajien lisäksi siivooja-helppereitä, joiden työtehtäviin kuuluu ammatillinen kotisiivous ja ikkunanpesu. Ajan myötä helpperistä ja asiakkaasta tulee usein jopa ystäviä työskentelyn myötä.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin. Tärkeintä on reipas työote ja aito halu auttaa.

Mitä helpperin työ vaatii?
Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Avustajan työ ei vaadi muita erityisiä taitoja. Riittää, että haluat viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa ja helpompaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat. Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta.

Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä? Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:
- "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."
- "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."
- "Hembyn yhteisöön kuuluminen."

Helpperinä saat:
- Oman nimetyn asiakkaan, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana
- Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 12-16 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset.
- Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!

Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

jobs.title: Electrical Construction Manager

jobs.description:
Role Purpose

To represent the Project Manager on major construction sites and to take responsibility for all site related activities associated with the construction of a varied range of projects. The Electrical Construction Manager will be expected to take the lead on all on-site activities from pre-mobilisation through to commissioning and eventual demobilisation.

Electrical Construction Manager Responsibilities

In conjunction with your project team, you will be responsible for the execution of various stages of a project as follows:

Project Start-Up:

• Assist PM in development of construction programme, short term look ahead planning

reports, equipment and materials schedules.

• Visit site and develop a site establishment schedule.

• Familiarisation with change management with PM.

• Assist in project validation.

• Put site safety starter pack in place and participate in HSEQ plan.

• Set up site establishment.

• Method statement and Risk Assessment preparation and review with sub-contractor.

• Review construction drawings and sign off

• Assist in benchmarking installation practices and Quality procedures

Project Running Phase:

• Productivity

• Develop a daily key action plan that includes HSEQ, productivity and people management.

• Assist Project team in expediting of major equipment deliveries.

• Maintain a site diary

• Attend/Chair internal meetings with sub-contractors.

• Ensure that all variations are picked up in conjunction with PM and QS.

• Ensure labour allocation sheets are being completed by sub-contractors.

• Produce short term programmes in line with master programme.

• Mark up master programme each week and issues to PM.

• Effectively manage sub-contractor supervision to enable efficient productivity

• Ensure sub-contractor workforce is on site at workface on time.

People

• Liaise with sub-contractors to address available work faces.

• Liaise with our client in co-ordination between building and services.

• Work closely with other supervisors to ensure effective co-ordination between M&E services.

• Integrate with other internal and external supervisors to ensure cross co-ordination of trades and installation processes.

• Take ownership and responsibility of issues to drive out solutions in conjunction with Project Manager.

Safety

• Ensure tool box talks, inductions and safety briefings are being carried out.

• Maintain plant logs and ensure weekly safety checks are carried out.

• Ensure operatives are working safely, wearing appropriate PPE and working to agreed method statements.

• Ensure compliance with Health and Safety Policy in particular to the operation of work

permits, site safety audits and weekly walk arounds.

• Carry out daily walk around adopting a “don’t walk by” approach to safety.

• Implement H&S behaviour/culture and Golden Rules.

Quality

• Plan and co-ordinate delivery of materials and plant.

• Mark up drawings in conjunction with inspection testing.

• Ensure inspection test plan is enforced by snagging works, then offering to client for

inspection at various stages of the installation working to ZERO snags.

• Ensure that free issue equipment is checked, cared for and once accepted confirm to engineer to sign off for payment.

Close Out Activities:

• Liaise with commissioning engineer in ensuring all systems are tested, demonstrated and handover.

• Ensure all site safety devices are proved.

• Ensure all life systems are complete and certified.

• Issue final marked up drawings are correct.

• Liaise with PM on site demobilisation, including plant, labour, materials and site establishment.

• Ensure all statutory notices, schematics, wall charts are in place on site in accordance with project completion checklist.

Other Duties:

• Maintain a site diary.

• Assist QS in his / her duties

• Ensure company’s good image is maintained at all times.

• Integrate with site team.

• Ensure your agreed training plan is enforced

jobs.description:
PALKATAAN KOKKI MONIPUOLISIIN TEHTÄVIIN, VAKITUISEEN JA KOKOAIKAISEEN TYÖSUHTEESEEN

Haemme ammattitaidostaan ylpeää kokkia yksityiseen perheyritykseen hotelli Gustavelundiin. Hotellimme sijaitsee Tuusulanjärven rannalla kauniissa puistomaisemissa, noin 15 min Helsinki-Vantaan lentokentältä ja puolen tunnin ajomatkan päässä Helsingin keskustasta.

Asiakaskuntamme koostuu kokouksissa, koulutuksissa ja erilaisissa yritystapahtumissa kokoontuvista ryhmistä, joille valmistamme kokoustarjoiluja, ryhmäillallisia sekä buffetruokailuja. Toteutamme laadukkaasti ja korkeatasoisesti monipuolisia ja vaihtuvia tuotteita: päivittäin tarjolla on hotelliaamiainen sekä lounas, iltaisin tarjoillaan bankettien lisäksi A la Cartea. Viikonloppuisin tarjoilemme brunsseja, olemme myös suosittu perhejuhlien pitopaikka. Terassillamme kesäkeittiössä valmistetaan grilliruokia ryhmille sekä salaatteja, pizzoja ja hampurilaisia walk-in asiakkaille. Hotellissamme järjestetään festivaalityyppisiä tapahtumia, kuten urheiluautotapaamisia, juhannusjuhla, bändi-iltoja ja varttuneemman väen disco-iltoja. Haluamme tarjota vieraillemme mahdollisimman paljon itse tehtyä ruokaa, leivomme ja valmistamme annoksia tuoreista raaka-aineista.

Työkielenämme on suomi. Toivomme sinulta kausivaihteluiden vuoksi joustavuutta: käytössämme on MaRaTes tasausjärjestelmä. Työskentelemme pääsääntöisesti kahdessa vuorossa, arkisin kello 6.00 - 20.30, viikonloppuisin alkaen kello 7.00 ja päättyen aina kulloisenkin tilaisuuden mukaan. Työ sisältää ilta- ja viikonloppuvuoroja. Palkkauksen pohjana on MaRaTes sekä normaalit ilta-, sunnuntai- yms. lisät, Kokemuksen määrän ja laadun mukaan palkka on myös neuvoteltavissa.

Arvostamme asiakaspalvelutaitoja, vastuullisuutta ja vieraanvaraisuutta sekä innostunutta ja innostavaa asennetta. Hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot sekä ammattikoulutus ovat työssä onnistumisen edellytyksiä. Hakijoilta edellytämme aiempaa kokemusta ravintolan keittiössä työskentelystä sekä hygieniapassia.

Tarjoamme monipuolisen työpaikan, jatkuvan kehityksen ja uudistuksen alla olevat upeat puitteet, mukavat asiakkaat ja huippuluokan työkaverit. Kanssamme olet mukana kehittämässä toimintaa perheyrityksessä, jossa on helppo tuoda esiin omia näkemyksiä ja ideoita ja osallistua toiminnan kehittämiseen.

Työ alkaa heti.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Position in Animal Welfare Risks of Feeding Red Seaweed to Dairy Cows
jobs.description:
The Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Aarhus University, calls for applications for a full-time postdoctoral position. The two-year position is available from 1 February 2027, or soon thereafter. The position will be in the research unit Behaviour, stress and welfare (BSW).

Dairy cattle contribute substantially to agricultural greenhouse gas emissions, primarily through enteric methane production, making the identification of effective nutritional mitigation strategies an important area of research. While the feed additive Bovaer has received considerable attention for its methane-reducing effects, concerns regarding animal health and welfare have led to increasing interest in alternative solutions, including seaweed-based feed additives. The seaweed Asparagopsis spp. has shown significant methane-mitigating potential; however, its use has also raised animal welfare concerns. Consequently, there is a need to evaluate the animal welfare effects of seaweed-based feed additives.

Research tasks
  • Evaluating the effects of seaweed-based feed additives on the behaviour and welfare of dairy cattle.
  • Investigating behavioural indicators of discomfort and pain associated with feed management.
  • Validating welfare assessment measures through experimental approaches, including pharmacological interventions.
  • Contributing to scientific publications and dissemination of research results.
  • Participating in knowledge exchange activities with public authorities and industry stakeholders.
  • Contributing to teaching and supervision of students at the bachelor's, master's, and PhD levels.


Qualifications
We are seeking a candidate who has:
  • A PhD degree or equivalent in biology, animal science, veterinary science, or a related field, and research experience in animal behaviour and welfare.
  • A strong interest in strategies aimed at reducing the climate impact of dairy production through feeding management.
  • At least a basic understanding of feeding management.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to communicate scientific research results effectively.
  • The ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a research environment.
  • For non-Scandinavian candidates, a commitment to learning Danish, including reading, writing, and speaking, is expected during the employment period.


Contact
Further information on the position may be obtained from Professor Margit Bak Jensen, phone: +4522365482, email: margitbak.jensen@anivet.au.dk

What we offer
  • A well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment and animal experimental facilities
  • An informal and multicultural research environment with high professionalism and close collaboration and networking activities
  • A workplace characterized by equality and a good work-life balance, and an open discussion across different fields of research.


The candidate will have the opportunity to be trained and gain experience in:
  • Teaching and supervision of students at the BSc and MSc level through active involvement in teaching in animal science and in the veterinary science programme.
  • Research-based consultancy to authorities, where it is relevant.


Who we are
Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences is well-known for its skilled and very innovative interdisciplinary research environments with high international impact. We perform world-class research, which contributes with solutions to solve essential societal challenges within the green transition: food production and veterinary medicine – nationally and globally.

The department generates novel research at the highest international level within sustainable food production, environment, climate, health and welfare for animals and humans. The activities form the basis for the research-based public sector consultancy and degree programs covering bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degree programs within animal science and veterinary medicine. We offer a lively, engaged and innovative learning and study environment, which is closely integrated in the research environment.

Our department has unique and advanced animal experimental research facilities and technologies, situated in close connection to the research environment, and a comprehensive national and international research network and good industrial and professional collaboration.

Please refer to Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences (au.dk) for further information about the department: https://anivet.au.dk/en

Place of work and area of employment
The place of work is the Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, AU Viborg,
Blichers Allé 20, DK-8830 Tjele, and the area of employment is Aarhus University (AU) with related departments.

Living in Denmark
Please visit the international staff website: https://internationalstaff.au.dk/prearrival/ for information about arriving to and living in Denmark for both the applicants and their potential families.



Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self.



Formalities and salary range
Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

jobs.title: Junior Software Developer
jobs.description:
Want to work with sustainability and software? Looking to be part of an innovative, fast-growing Danish greentech company with global reach? Then Explicit might be the place for you.

We are looking for a software developer to join us to develop and maintain our digital platforms as we scale.

We do drone-based emissions monitoring across oil & gas, maritime, waste management, and other industries. By helping operators safely identify methane leaks and quantify emissions, we're proud to be supporting industry efforts to improve environmental performance while enhancing operational efficiency and asset integrity. We measure greenhouse gas emissions data from various sources and combining them with atmospheric data. Based on scientific methods we then quantify emissions and visualize the data to provide emissions intelligence to operations enabling actions on emissions.

We have a strong focus on R&D, and we are exploring new cutting-edge technologies and ideas to innovate what we can do within emissions monitoring.

The job

You will be part of a small, talented tech developer team, responsible for designing, building and maintaining our digital platforms, which are the core of the products we deliver to customers.

As a Software Developer your responsibilities will include:

  • Co-development of our main applications Microsoft Azure, Blazor Server Application (C#)

  • Co-development of our calculation engine, Microsoft Azure Function (Python)

  • Develop new, more appealing user experiences aimed at different user groups to view products and services.

  • Maintain databases, application services and reporting landscape specific to the European maritime emission monitoring set-up.

  • Improve analysis tools and the user experience for the customers, the drone pilot and the internal project manager in collaboration with the project manager running the campaigns.

About you

We are looking for a candidate who meets the following criteria:

  • A bachelor's degree or master’s degree in engineering, data science, software design, computer engineering, mathematics, physics or similar

  • Experience with code development in C# and Python and preferable Rust

  • Experience with database design (SQL)

  • Familiar with software development processes in Azure DevOps

  • Experience with development of user interfaces and UX design is an advantage, but not a requirement

  • Fluent in English. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement

  • Genuine interest in technology and IT infrastructure

  • Structured and focused on delivering quality work and being a good team player.

 

What we offer

  • A permanent, full-time position in a fast-growing greentech company with real-world impact on cutting industrial emissions

  • Competitive benefits including paid pension, health insurance, parental leave and 6 weeks' holiday allowance

  • Software ownership early on, with senior developers to learn from

  • A flat hierarchy where ideas are heard, initiative is encouraged, and responsibility comes early

  • A supportive team that values collaboration, trust and learning

  • Job location is just north of Copenhagen in Virum, Denmark.

Application and information

We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we will be evaluating applications on an ongoing basis. Application deadline is 18 October 2026. Expected start date is 1 November 2026.

Please send your application, including your motivation and what a competence you bring, together with your CV to jobs@explicit.dk. Write “Software developer” in the subject field.

If you have any questions about the job, you are welcome to contact Rasmus Ebdrup, Chief Digital Officer at reb@explicit.dk

Explicit ApS is a pioneering Danish green tech company specialising in drone-based emissions monitoring across the energy, maritime, waste management, and other industries. We deliver reliable, transparent and actionable emissions data to some of the largest energy companies all over the world using our patented drone-based methodology.

We are headquartered in Virum, Denmark, with offices in Norway, Germany and Australia. Our international team of around 30 colleagues brings together engineering, data and environmental expertise, united by a shared mission to make a difference in emissions monitoring. Svejsning · Smedearbejde · Trailere og maskinkonverteringer – Fuldtid, fysisk tilstedeværelse, Gedved, Danmark

Er du typen, der læser en tegning, tænder for svejseapparatet og er stolt af det, der kommer ud i den anden ende? RENTEQ Automotive er en startup i vækst, og vi har brug for en dygtig smed til at svejse de trailere, rammer og dele, der indgår i hver eneste maskine, vi konverterer. Om RENTEQ Automotive

Din rolle

Som vores smed vil du omsætte tegninger til de færdige dele, der går i vores produkter. Fra vores værksted i Gedved svejser og tilpasser du trailere, bærende rammer og de øvrige stålkomponenter, der udgør rygraden i vores maskinkonverteringer. Meget af materialet vil kommer fra egen cnc bukkemaskine og laserskærer.

Det her er ikke kun et samlebånd – der vil være mange forskellige projekter, og du skal kunne tænke selvstændigt. Du arbejder tæt sammen med ingeniør- og produktionsteamet, kan finde ud af bidrage til problemløsninger tidligt, og hjælper os med at bygge klogere fra gang til gang.

Dine opgaver

•     Bygge, svejse og tilpasse trailere og de øvrige dele, der indgår i konverteringen af maskinerne

•     Holde værkstedet organiseret, udstyr vedligeholdt og processer dokumenteret

•     Understøtte prototypeiterationer – forvent at der er hyppige designændringer og flere projekter kørende på én gang.


Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Har du praktisk erfaring inden for svejs/smedearbejde – det kan være fra en håndværksuddannelse, teknisk skole eller reel værkstedserfaring?

Det vil være en fordel, hvis du kan sætte kryds ved det meste af nedenstående:

•     Erfaren svejser – MIG og TIG

•     Erfaring med trailer-, chassis- eller konstruktionssvejsning er et stort plus

•     Fortrolig med almindeligt smedeværktøj – vinkelsliber, plasma-/gasskærer og opretningsværktøj

Vi tilbyder

•     Et uformelt og rart team i en flad virksomhedsstruktur med variation i arbejdsdagene

Declaration of interest regarding PhD project in renal calcium transport
jobs.description:
Declaration of interest regarding PhD project in renal calcium transport

 

The laboratory of Henrik Dimke, Cardiovascular and Renal Research Unit at the Department of Molecular Medicine, University of Southern Denmark is seeking a highly motivated PhD student in the field of renal transport physiology. Particular emphasis will be placed on signalling through the calcium-sensing receptor and the regulation of renal calcium transport in transgenic models.

 

Research environment

The PhD student will join the laboratory of Professor Henrik Dimke in the Cardiovascular and Renal Research Unit. The laboratory studies epithelial ion transport and the mechanisms that maintain calcium, magnesium, and phosphate balance, with particular emphasis on renal calcium transport, the calcium-sensing receptor, claudins, and kidney stone disease. The Research Unit focuses on innovative molecular and biomedical research related to cardiovascular and renal physiology. We offer a stimulating, international research environment where English is the preferred language at meetings and seminars. You will work in the modern NytSUND building, which is directly connected to the new Odense University Hospital and provides state-of-the-art laboratory and animal facilities. You can read more about the department and institute here.

 

Project description

The project will investigate how altered calcium-sensing receptor (CASR) signalling disrupts the endocrine and renal control of calcium homeostasis. Particular attention will be given to autosomal dominant hypocalcaemia type 1, in which excessive CASR activity suppresses parathyroid hormone secretion and promotes renal calcium loss. The project will examine the signalling mechanisms linking CASR activation to renal calcium transport and whole-body calcium balance. The successful applicant will use clinically relevant genetic models, including inducible and cell-specific transgenic approaches, together with detailed physiological characterization, molecular and biochemical techniques, and imaging.

 

Qualifications

Qualified and highly motivated candidates from all nationalities are encouraged to apply. 

 

The successful applicant must have

  • A Master's degree (Danish: kandidatgrad) or another relevant degree that concludes a research-based study programme of minimum five years’ duration at an institution of higher education. If you do not have a Master's degree, the Graduate School will make an individual assessment of your academic qualifications.

  • Good oral and written English language skills

  • you must at the time of submission have documented research experience. E.g. be the author or co-author of an article in a peer-reviewed international journal (must at least be submitted) or of a published abstract from an international scientific conference, or have worked as research assistant full time for at least 6 months (after completing your masters degree). The research experience of each applicant is individually assessed by the Graduate School.

 

The successful applicant should have

  • The ability to work independently and in a structured manner. 

  • Good collaborative and interpersonal skills. 

  • Previous experience with experimental animal work or relevant molecular and biochemical techniques, such as western blotting or immunohistochemistry, is preferred but not required.

 

For further information about the project, please contact:

Professor Henrik Dimke

Department of Molecular Medicine

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

Tel. +45 65 50 83 10 E-mail: hdimke@health.sdu.dk


Applications must include:

• A letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.
• Detailed CV, including personal contact information
• Certified copy of diploma (Master’s degree in a relevant field)

• • Contact details for at least one professional reference who may be contacted during the assessment process.


Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. References will normally be contacted only for shortlisted candidates.

Further information about the PhD-program can be found at the homepage of the University.


Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated. 

 

Closing date: October 12th, 2026


Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.

 

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order).

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.


Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98.

 

The Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark is one of Denmark’s leading faculties of health sciences. With nine departments, internationally top‑class research, and a broad range of health‑related study programmes, we contribute to developing the knowledge, treatments, and healthcare system of the future.

 

As an employee at the faculty, you become part of an ambitious and interdisciplinary environment characterised by high academic standards, strong collaborations, and excellent opportunities for professional development. The faculty has activities in Odense, Esbjerg, and Copenhagen. In Esbjerg and Copenhagen, strong academic communities provide the framework for research and education, while our modern faculty building in Odense brings research, education, and administration together under one roof and is directly connected to Odense University Hospital.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Algal Microbiome Engineering
jobs.employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
jobs.description:
The position

At the Norwegian College of Fishery Science, Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics (BFE) at UiT The Arctic University of Norway, there is a vacant position as a postdoctoral researcher affiliated with the Microalgae & Microbiomes Research Group. The position is for a fixed term of 3 years. It is a prerequisite that the applicant can carry out the project over the full course of the employment period. No person may hold more than one fixed term position as a Postdoctoral Research Fellow at the same institution.

The postdoctoral project focuses on programmable marine microbiomes and mechanistic interactions within the diatom phycosphere, with particular emphasis on synthetic biology, microbial ecology, and molecular interactions between marine microalgae and associated bacteria. The successful candidate will contribute to the development of experimental model systems for studying metabolite exchange, microbial community interactions, and engineered microbial consortia in marine environments.

The position is affiliated with ongoing research activities in marine microbiology, synthetic biology, and systems biology at UiT. The research combines microbiology, molecular biology, microbial cultivation, genome-informed molecular ecology, synthetic biology, and multi-omics approaches to better understand and engineer marine microbial ecosystems relevant to carbon cycling and marine biotechnology.

As a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, you will have the opportunity to advance your scientific career and further qualify for academic positions. If you do not already have the educational competence that meets the requirements for an Associate Professor position in Norway, UiT will arrange such competence during the employment period.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. You must be able to start in the position within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.


The project/position's field of research

The postdoctoral researcher will develop and apply experimental approaches for studying mechanistic interactions between marine microalgae and associated bacterial communities within the diatom phycosphere. The project will focus on the development of programmable and experimentally tractable microbial model systems using synthetic biology, microbial cultivation, and molecular biology approaches.

The successful candidate will work with cultivation and engineering of marine bacteria and microalgae, construction of synthetic microbial consortia, and investigation of microbial metabolite exchange relevant to nutrient cycling and carbon fixation in marine ecosystems. The project may also involve transcriptomics, genomics, metabolomics, and bioinformatics analyses to investigate molecular interactions between diatoms and associated microorganisms.

The position is part of a broader research program focused on programmable marine microbiomes, marine microbial ecology, and biotechnology applications relevant to climate resilience, sustainable aquaculture, and marine carbon cycling. The postdoctoral researcher will work in an interdisciplinary and international research environment and is expected to contribute actively to scientific publications, collaborative research activities, and external funding development.

You must submit a project proposal (max 2 pages) that describes how you scientifically can contribute to designing diatom phycosphere communities through the uses of engineered genetic circuits or other synthetic biology tools. The proposal should include your view on the state-of-the-art and opportunities for achievable but ground-breaking science with regards to engineering microbial consortia and non-traditional synthetic biology hosts. The proposal must include a progress plan.


Contact

For further information about the position, please contact Group Leader Hans Christopher Bernstein:

  • email: hans.c.bernstein@uit.no 

 or the Head of Department Bjørn Petter Finstad: 

  • email: bjornpetter.finstad@uit.no 

Qualifications

Required qualifications: 

  • A Norwegian doctoral degree or an equivalent foreign doctoral degree recognized as equivalent to a Norwegian PhD in microbiology, molecular biology, biotechnology, synthetic biology, marine biology, microbial ecology, systems biology, chemical engineering, bioengineering, or another relevant discipline. If you're in the final stages of your PhD, you may still apply for the position, provided that you submit parts of your dissertation along with your application. This enables the evaluation committee to assess the quality and likelihood of completion by the desired employment date. You must include a statement from your supervisor or institution stating the expected completion date for your PhD degree. Documentation of your completed PhD degree must be submitted before commencement.
  • Excellent written and oral English language skills. Nordic applicants can document their capabilities by attaching their high school diploma.
  • Documented experience in experimental microbiology, molecular biology, and scientific publishing, including publication of research in peer reviewed international journals. Experience in one or more of the following areas is required:
    • synthetic biology
    • microbial cultivation
    • marine microbiology or marine microbial ecology
    • microalgae research
    • molecular cloning and genetic engineering
    • microbial ecology
    • microbial co-cultivation systems

Desired qualifications: 

  • Experience working with non-model microorganisms and/or developing molecular tools for environmental microorganisms is considered particularly advantageous.
  • Experience with one or more of the following areas is considered an advantage:
    • microbial genomics, transcriptomics, or metagenomics
    • bioinformatics and analysis of omics datasets
    • metabolomics or analytical chemistry
    • microbial community analysis
    • programming/scripting in R, Python, or similar languages
    • systems biology or computational biology
  • Knowledge of a Scandinavian language or willingness to learn Norwegian is considered an advantage.

The successful candidate must be able to work independently and as part of an interdisciplinary research team. Emphasis will also be placed on motivation, potential for research, scientific creativity, organizational skills, communication abilities, and personal suitability for the position.

In the assessment the main emphasis will be attached to the submitted works and the project proposal for the qualifying work. Emphasis shall also be attached to experience from popularization/dissemination and academic policy and administrative activity.

At UiT we put emphasis on the quality, relevance and significance of the research work and not on where the work is published, in accordance with the principles of The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA).


Inclusion and diversity  

UiT The Arctic University i Norway is working actively to promote equality, gender balance and diversity among employees and students, and to create an inclusive and safe working environment. We believe that inclusion and diversity is a strength, and we want employees with different competencies, professional experience, life experience and perspectives.  

If you have a disability, a gap in your CV or immigrant background, we encourage you to tick the box for this in your application. If there are qualified applicants, we invite least one in each group for an interview. If you get the job, we will adapt the working conditions if you need it. Apart from selecting the right candidates, we will only use the information for anonymous statistics. 


We offer
  • Involvement in an interesting research project 
  • Good career opportunities 
  • A good academic environment with dedicated colleagues  
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement  
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.

More practical information for working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility 


Application

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information submitted by the application deadline via Jobbnorge. It is therefore important that you include all necessary documents demonstrating your qualifications for the position.

Your application must include:

  • Application letter
  • Project proposal (max 2 pages)
  • CV
  • Diplomas and transcripts (all degrees)
  • Documentation of English proficiency
  • Contact information to 2-3 references
  • Documentation of educational competence, if available
  • Description of your academic production, stating which works you consider most important
  • The academic works (published or not) you wish us to take into consideration in the assessment

If you're in the final stages of your PhD, you may still apply for the position, provided that you submit parts of your dissertation along with your application. This enables the evaluation committee to assess the quality and likelihood of completion by the desired employment date. You must include a statement from your supervisor or institution stating the expected completion date for your PhD degree. Documentation of your completed PhD degree must be submitted before commencement.

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. If English proficiency is not documented in the application, it must be documented before starting in the position. 


Assessment

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications based on the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description draw up for the position. A copy of the assessment report will be sent to all applicants. 

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview should among other things, aim to clarify the applicant’s motivation and personal suitability for the position. A trial lecture may also be held.


General information

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants. 

The remuneration for Postdoctoral research fellow is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1352 with a gross annual salary ranging from NOK 650'-760' (in a 100% position). (In special cases, a higher salary may be considered.) A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. You will become a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, which gives you many benefits in addition to a lifelong pension. Read more about your employee benefits at: spk.no.

The successful candidate must be willing to get involved in the ongoing development of their department and the university as a whole.

UiT wishes to promote gender equality. If two or more applicants are found to be equally qualified, the university will rank applicants from the underrepresented gender ahead of others.

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is a multi-campus research university and the northernmost university of the world. Our central location in the High North, our broad and diverse research and study portfolio, and our interdisciplinary qualities make us uniquely suited to meet the challenges of the future. At UiT you can explore global issues from a close-up perspective.

Credibility, academic freedom, closeness, creativity and commitment shall be hallmarks of the relationship between our employees, between our employees and our students and between UiT and our partners. 

The Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics (BFE) consists of Department of Arctic and Marine Biology, Norwegian College of Fishery Science (NFH) and School of Business and Economics.The main task of BFE is to conduct teaching and research dissemination at a high national and international level within all relevant fields. Prioritized research areas are aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems, climate, life in the arctic, marine bioprospecting, fish health, seafood products, business and macroeconomics, resources and environment, markets and management of marine resources. The interdisciplinary profile of the faculty provides good opportunity to develop research projects involving several research groups at the faculty according to its strategy.

jobs.title: 2 Mekanikere/montører søges til spændende automotive virksomhed i Horsens N, Gedved
jobs.description:
RENTEQ Automotive søger efter praktiske og dygtige mekanikere/montører, der kan tage hånd om den mekaniske/eltekniske montage på vores fabrik i Gedved, og som har det rette mindset til at arbejde i en produktion, hvor processerne løbende optimeres.

Om RENTEQ Automotive

RENTEQ Automotive er en ung dansk virksomhed med en ambition om at reducere CO₂-udledningen ved at elektrificere varebiler og entreprenørmaskiner og opbygge batteritrailere. Vi har udvikling i Dragør og produktion på vores fabrik i Gedved, og vi tager hele rejsen på os – fra ingeniørarbejde og udvikling helt frem til serieproduktion.

Jobbet

Som mekaniker/montør hos os arbejder du med den praktiske montage på produktionslinjen – primært opbygning af vores Vanteq, på sigt også entreprenørmaskiner og vores batteritrailer.

Produktionen er stadig ung, så der er masser af plads til at forbedre den. Du arbejder tæt sammen med ingeniør- og produktionsteamet, bidrager til problemløsning tidligt og hjælper os med at bygge klogere fra gang til gang. Du er med til at sikre, at hver eneste komponent behandles korrekt og dokumenteres præcist, idet dit arbejde er fundamentet for hele konverteringsprojektet.

Dine typiske opgaver vil være:

●      Montage af Vanteq på produktionslinjen – efter fastlagte arbejdsinstruktioner

●      Montering af elektriske komponenter, kabelføring og drivline i chassis og karosseri

●      Tilpasning og fejlfinding på komponenter i tæt samarbejde med elektronik- og software-teamet

●      Kvalitetskontrol og dokumentation af alle monteringssteps og fund undervejs i produktionen

●      Løbende forbedring af proces og arbejdsgange – du kan bidrage til de guider og checklister, vi udvikler

●      Primært arbejde med Vanteq – og også entreprenørmaskiner kommer nok også ind i Gedved

●      Sammen holder vi altid produktionen organiseret, udstyr vedligeholdt og processer dokumenteret for at sikre den højest mulige kvalitet.

Er det dig?

Vi leder efter en person med solid praktisk erfaring og en tilgang, der kombinerer præcision med fleksibilitet. Vigtigst er, at du kan arbejde selvstændigt, men også er dygtig til at samarbejde i et team, der hele tiden lærer og udvikler sig. Det vil være en fordel, hvis du kan nikke ja til nedenstående:

●      Erfaring med montering og demontering af motor, hydrauliksystem og brændstofkomponenter på landbrugsmaskiner, entreprenørmaskiner eller varebiler

●      Solidt kendskab til mekaniske systemer, væskesystemer og elektriske grundelementer

●      Ideelt set en stærk interesse for elektrificering

●      AC-kursus eller tilsvarende (ikke obligatorisk, men en stor fordel)

●      Evnen til at arbejde struktureret og dokumentere dit arbejde

●      Selvstændighed og ansvar, men også åbenhed over for feedback og samarbejde

●      Tålmodighed og en positiv tilgang til arbejde i et udviklingsmiljø, hvor vi hele tiden forfiner processen

●      Dansk på højt niveau; fungerende engelsk er en fordel, da vi er et internationalt team.

Vi tilbyder

●      En central rolle i vores produktionsteam, hvor din praktiske viden sætter direkte aftryk på, hvordan vi konverterer maskiner

●      Mulighed for at påvirke og udforme arbejdsprocesserne – dine idéer og erfaringer bliver hørt

●      En fast rytme i produktionen med arbejde på Vanteq og på sigt flere maskintyper

●      Tæt samarbejde med dygtige ingeniører og et uformelt, kollegialt team

●      Ordentlige faciliteter, godt værktøj og en støttende arbejdskultur

●      Løn: 190-240 kr./t afhængig af kompetencer og erfaring

●      Reelle muligheder for at vokse fagligt og personligt i takt med, at virksomheden udvikler sig.

Sådan søger du

Send dit CV og et par linjer om dig selv og din erfaring til simon@ren-teq.com. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og inviterer relevante kandidater til en uformel første samtale – så vent ikke for længe med at tage kontakt.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Simon på simon@ren-teq.com eller på 21942143

jobs.title: Technical Writer (AutoCAD)
jobs.description:
About the role

In this role, you will help bring a major substation project across the finish line. Your main focus is to keep all technical drawings up to date: you will take physical redline markups from the field and redraw them into precise digital AutoCAD drawings.

This is a highly independent role that requires precision and attention to detail. While working autonomously, you will contact the local engineering office if needed to clarify any questions or details regarding the drawings. You will receive thorough onboarding and ongoing support fro senior experts when needed.

You are offered
- Hands-on experience with a major international substation project
- Independent working environment
- Remote work possibility from anywhere in Finland

Work tasks

In this role, you will redraw electrical substation redline markups into clean AutoCAD DWG drawings, making sure the final documentation accurately matches the actual installation on-site.
- Perform precise clean drawing of substation redline markups and changes into DWG format using AutoCAD
- Collaborate with the Senior Document Controller to follow document management systems and coding guidelines
- Communicate with the local engineering office to clarify drawing details and technical specifications
- Maintain and update AS IS design documentation following new construction phases
- Consult with internal electrical experts to resolve technical queries
- Manage your daily tasks independently in a focused desktop-working environment

We are looking for

- Ongoing or completed studies in Engineering
- Knowledge of AutoCAD and experience working with DWG files
- Fluent English (written and spoken) for international collaboration

It is meritorious if you have
- Knowledge of Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / Autodesk Forma
- Studies or background in Electrical Engineering

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
- Orderly
- Responsible
- High precision
- Attention to detail
- Ability to handle routine tasks independently

 

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.
