Industrial Painter Wanted for Give Steel A/S

Do you have experience with surface treatment of steel structures? Are you skilled in spray painting and using airless pump equipment? And do you thrive in a busy work environment where quality and safety are top priorities?

If so, Give Steel A/S is looking for an Industrial Painter to join our painting department in Brande.

You will become part of an international company specialising in the surface treatment of large steel structures. Our painting department operates 24/7 throughout the week, while your position will primarily be on the day shift.

Why Choose Us?

We continuously develop and improve our production processes and utilise modern equipment for surface treatment and fire protection coatings. You will have access to state-of-the-art facilities, including newly built paint halls with advanced ventilation systems and a new water-based paint application facility.

We prioritise a safe and positive working environment and value teamwork, mutual respect, and strong social relationships.

What Will Your Workday Look Like?

You will be responsible for spray painting steel structures using primarily airless pump equipment. We focus on using modern technology and equipment to support efficient production processes.

Safety is a key aspect of surface treatment work. You will therefore receive thorough training in safety procedures as well as the handling of waste materials and residues generated during the painting process.

Your Primary Responsibilities

You will work with:

  • Surface treatment of large steel structures.
  • Spray painting using primarily airless pump equipment.
  • Following established safety procedures.
  • Handling waste materials and residues from the surface treatment process.

What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for a reliable and team-oriented employee with experience in the surface treatment of steel structures.

We imagine that you:

  • Hold a valid epoxy certificate.
  • Have experience with surface treatment of steel structures.
  • Have experience using airless pump equipment.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced work environment.
  • Work well as part of a team.
  • Speak and write either Danish or English.

What We Offer

  • Skilled and supportive colleagues.
  • A positive work environment with a strong focus on safety and well-being.
  • A workplace built on strong social values.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Canteen scheme and additional employee benefits.
  • Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.
  • Fitness facilities and massage services.

Practical Information

  • Working hours: Full-time position on the day shift.
  • Start date: As soon as possible.
  • Location: Give Steel A/S, Sjællandsvej 14, 7330 Brande, Denmark.

Would You Like to Join the Team?

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact the Painting Department Team Leader, Kenneth Helmuth Thomassen,  +45 66 50 77 44

Please submit your CV and clearly state your relevant experience.

We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible, and the job posting will be removed once the position has been filled.

About Give Steel A/S

Give Steel A/S is a manufacturing engineering and steel construction company specialising in the design, engineering, production, and installation of load-bearing steel structures and steel roof trusses.

Quality, safety, and documentation are integral parts of our daily work. We also focus on climate considerations, material selection, and documentation throughout both the engineering and production processes.

You will become part of an international company with strong technical expertise and excellent opportunities for professional development. Collaboration, responsibility, and integrity are key values in our everyday work.

jobs.title: Junior Structural Analyst
jobs.description:
Type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Vaasa, Finland/Trieste, Italy

Application deadline: 23.9.2026

Want to start your career in structural analysis and develop your FEM expertise through real engineering challenges? Wärtsilä is looking for a Junior Structural Analyst to join its Structural Analysis team!

**What will you be doing?**

As a Junior Structural Analyst, you will work with structural calculations and FEM analyses that support Wärtsiläs product and technology development. Your work will focus especially on cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems. You will perform and evaluate FEM analyses, prepare technical reports, and collaborate with designers and other specialists to turn analysis results into engineering decisions.

You will join an experienced Structural Analysis team where knowledge is actively shared. Your analyses and reports will be reviewed by experienced colleagues, giving you regular feedback and support. You are encouraged to ask questions, discuss different approaches, and learn from specialists working with demanding structural analysis challenges.

You will start with clearly defined calculation assignments and take on increasingly complex analyses as your skills develop. Over time, you can deepen your expertise in different component areas and contribute to simulation method development and new ways of working. **What makes you a great fit?**

You may be taking your first steps in structural analysis or already have some relevant experience and want to deepen your FEM expertise. Most importantly, you have a solid foundation in mechanics and FEM and the motivation to develop into a structural analysis specialist.

You enjoy solving technical problems and working with others, but you are also comfortable taking ownership of your own assignments. You communicate your findings clearly, actively look for solutions, and know when to ask colleagues for input.

**We expect you to have:**

- A relevant Masters degree in Mechanical Engineering, Technical Mechanics, or a related engineering field

- A good understanding of mechanics and the fundamentals of FEM

- Practical experience with FEM through studies, projects, internships, or work

- Good communication skills in English

- A proactive approach to learning, problem-solving, and teamwork


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience with Abaqus, Ansys, OptiStruct, Nastran, SimLab, HyperMesh, or similar simulation software

- Previous internship, summer job, or project experience related to structural analysis or mechanical engineering

- Interest in simulation method development, noise simulation, machine learning, digitalization, or other new analysis methods and tools

- Finnish or Swedish language skills


**Why join Wärtsilä?**

- Contribute to the development of Wärtsiläs marine technologies and solve engineering challenges shaped by an evolving industry.

- Work in an international R&D environment where structural analysis connects you with specialists across different engineering disciplines.

- Deepen your FEM expertise through real structural analysis challenges and gradually take on more demanding assignments.

- Learn alongside experienced specialists who review your work, share their expertise, and support your development.


**Practicalities:**

This is a permanent, full-time position, and you will be employed directly by Wärtsilä. The position can be based either in Vaasa, Finland, or Trieste, Italy, and follows Wärtsiläs hybrid working model. The starting date will be agreed upon with the selected candidate.

**Interested?**

Please submit your CV in PDF format in English or Finnish by September 23rd at the latest via aTalents application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/381526/create/. A motivation letter is optional, but with a role-specific motivation letter you can provide more information about your relevant skills and why this would be an interesting opportunity for you.

Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, as we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

You can familiarize yourself with Wärtsilä here: https://www.wartsila.com/. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact aTalents Managing Recruitment Consultant Roosa Lönnqvist (+358 50 421 0255, roosa.lonnqvist\[at\]atalent.fi).

**Company description**

jobs.title: Structural Analysis Expert
jobs.description:
Type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Vaasa, Finland/Trieste, Italy

Application deadline: 23.9.2026

Looking for new challenges within structural analysis that go beyond routine simulations? Join Wärtsilä to solve complex engineering problems and shape how they are analyzed.

**What will you be doing?**

As an Expert in Structural Analysis, you will solve demanding structural strength and durability challenges using FEM and numerical analysis. You will perform, evaluate, and report simulations related to dynamics, fatigue, stress, and structural strength, supporting product and technology development across cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems.

Your assignments will range from focused structural calculations to complex investigations where you identify the root causes of technical challenges and determine how to move forward. You will work closely with designers, component experts, and other technical specialists, using simulation and measurement data to support engineering decisions and solve real product development challenges.

Beyond individual analysis assignments, you will contribute to developing simulation methods, processes, and new ways of working. You will share your findings and expertise within the Structural Analysis team, helping others apply new methods and learnings in their work. Depending on your expertise and interests, you may also contribute to areas such as noise simulation, machine learning, and digitalization.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You already have several years of professional experience in FEM and structural analysis, combined with a strong understanding of mechanics and numerical analysis. You are comfortable taking ownership of demanding simulation assignments, evaluating results critically, and communicating your findings and recommendations to designers and other technical specialists.

You enjoy getting to the root of complex technical problems and finding practical ways forward. You work independently when needed but value collaboration, actively seek input from others, and are equally willing to share your own expertise and learnings with the team.

**We expect you to have:**

- Professional experience in structural analysis and practical FEM simulations, preferably involving engine components or other mechanically demanding products

- An MSc or PhD degree in Mechanical Engineering, Technical Mechanics, or a related engineering field

- Experience with Abaqus, HyperMesh, SimLab, OptiStruct, or similar simulation software

- Good communication skills in English

- A proactive and solution-oriented approach, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical teams


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience or interest in machine learning, digitalization, or data analytics

- Experience or interest in numerical noise analysis or noise simulation development

- Experience with CFD or multiphysics simulations

- Experience developing simulation methods, processes, or analysis tools

- Finnish or Swedish language skills


**Why join Wärtsilä?**

- Solve varied structural analysis challenges, from focused simulations to complex investigations requiring deeper technical analysis.

- Shape simulation methods and ways of working, giving you opportunities to influence how structural analysis is developed and applied.

- Apply your expertise to engineering decisions that directly support the development of Wärtsiläs marine technologies.

- Collaborate across an international R&D environment where experienced specialists actively share methods, findings, and technical knowledge.


**Practicalities:**

This is a permanent, full-time position, and you will be employed directly by Wärtsilä. The position can be based either in Vaasa, Finland, or Trieste, Italy, and follows Wärtsiläs hybrid working model. The starting date will be agreed upon with the selected candidate.

**Interested?**

Please submit your CV in PDF format in English or Finnish by September 23rd at the latest via aTalents application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/381516/create/. A motivation letter is optional, but with a role-specific motivation letter you can provide more information about your relevant skills and why this would be an interesting opportunity for you.

Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, as we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

You can familiarize yourself with Wärtsilä here: https://www.wartsila.com/. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact aTalents Managing Recruitment Consultant Roosa Lönnqvist (+358 50 421 0255, roosa.lonnqvist\[at\]atalent.fi).

jobs.title: Assistant Professor in Operations and Supply Chain Digitalisation
jobs.description:
The Center for Supply Chain Digitalisation (CSD), at the Department of Technology and Innovation, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for an Assistant Professor in Operations and Supply Chain Digitalization with special focus on simulation and/or artificial intelligence applied to operations and supply chains.

The targeted start date is February 2027.

The successful candidate will be responsible for collaboratively building up the area of operations and supply chain digitalisation with a primary focus on quantitative methods such as discrete-event and agent-based simulation, process automation, data science, and machine learning.

Successful candidates will drive internationally recognized and competitive research, work closely with industry, and are expected to attract external research funding. The position has a strong focus on experimental and applied research in production systems and supply chain fields. The candidate will play a key role in providing outstanding education, supervising bachelor's and master’s students, and developing junior research staff.

SDU CSD is a highly international group of faculty members, embedded in a region with a strong network of companies, including some of Denmark's largest global industrial players (i.e. Danfoss, Linak, Siemens) and many manufacturing SMEs. Projects currently run by the group cover a range of topics within the field of operations and supply chain digitalization.

The successful candidate must have a background in engineering. PhD degree preferably in industrial engineering, supply chain, operations management, operations research, or the like.

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

 

We expect

A highly motivated, collaborative person, who can work in an international, interdisciplinary team, with documented research skills in the field of operations and supply chain. The candidate needs to be a team player and, at the same time, be able to work independently. The successful candidate is active in publishing in engineering journals.

The ideal candidate can connect research with practical technology application and has demonstrated skills and competencies in one or more of the following areas:

  • Discrete-event and/or agent-based simulation

  • Artificial intelligence, machine/deep learning applied to operations and supply chain (AI-applications in other fields are not relevant for this position) 

  • Agentic AI applied to operations and supply chain

  • Business and intelligent process automation

Further information is available from Associate Professor Elias Ribeiro da Silva elias@iti.sdu.dk.

 

We offer

  • A professional workplace culture that values equality, mutual respect, and is designed to accommodate and encourage work-life balance

  • A vibrant social environment with structured activities and informal routines that promote cross-disciplinary interaction and cultivate an inclusive, supportive atmosphere.

  • An engaging, dynamic, and international interdisciplinary environment with extensive collaboration opportunities across national, international, and industrial partners

  • Opportunities for continued professional development and education for all staff members.

  • Access to a well-developed research infrastructure

  • A strong institutional commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in all aspects of the workplace

 

About the workplace

The position is within the SDU Center for Supply Chain Digitalisation (CSD) at the Faculty of Engineering on the international campus Sønderborg. The center conducts research at the intersection of supply chain management, data science, and digital technologies. Our work applies quantitative, data-driven methods to analyse, design, and optimise complex supply chains.

In close collaboration with industry partners, the center focuses on the full data journey across the supply chain, developing tools and methods based on advanced analytics, simulation, and artificial intelligence to enable stronger coordination, end-to-end transparency, and more sustainable and efficient supply chain operations.

SDU CSD is situated in a region with a robust network of companies, including some of Denmark’s largest global industrial players as well as numerous SMEs. The group’s current projects mainly focus on building quantitative models and methods to support better decisions or on turning data-driven optimisation, simulation, and digital tools into practical use in operations. 

The SDU CSD is a highly international and interdisciplinary group of faculty members, with international students. The campus is in Sønderborg, an attractive coastal town with an open Scandinavian culture, and affordable housing and living costs.

 

Special benefits when working in Denmark

  • The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week

  • 30 days of paid holiday per year

  • The yearly salary for a full-time assistant professor is between DKK 502.905 and DKK 566.647 depending on the years of working experience. Postdoc experience may place you on a higher salary step. The salary includes a base salary, a position-related supplement and pension (18.07 %). Additional supplement(s) for special qualifications can be negotiated. Authorisation supplement(s) will be granted, if relevant for the position. Your local eligible trade union representative at SDU negotiates your salary on your behalf.

  • Subsidized preschool childcare and a free education system from primary school up to university level

  • Universal health insurance as a resident of Denmark, including family members officially residing in Denmark

  • In relation to childbirth, employees are entitled to a combined total of 52 weeks of parental leave, shared between parents, with full or partial salary depending on circumstances.

  • Researchers recruited from abroad are offered a special researcher tax scheme with a lower tax rate. 

  • Travel and moving expenses may be partially covered.

 

Living in Denmark

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. Among other things, the staff answers questions concerning salary, taxation, housing and accompanying family.

We recommend that international applicants also take the time to visit Work in Denmark.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

 

Application and assessment

Applications will be assessed by an expert committee. When the expert committee issues its assessment, applicants will receive the portion of the assessment pertaining to them personally.

The committee assesses candidates only based on the application materials. Please include the following documents in English: 

  • Brief motivation letter

  • Curriculum vitae

  • Full list of publications

  • Copies of the three publications on which the applicant wishes to be evaluated. Please attach one pdf-file for each publication

  • Diplomas/Certificates (Master and PhD degree)

  • Summary and documentation of teaching experience. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio.

  • Documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  An interview may be included as part of the overall evaluation of the applicant’s qualifications. If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support. Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply and specific faculty information for application at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period. The preferred start date is from February 2027.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: Premium Support Engineer (London, Weekend)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

As a Premium Support Engineer at Replit, you’ll be the front line for our highest-value customers — delivering fast, expert, and reliable technical support when it matters most. You’ll handle complex product issues, guide customers through critical incidents, and ensure every interaction meets the highest standard of quality and speed.

Replit is at the forefront of AI-driven software development, and how we support customers is constantly evolving. You’ll play a critical role in shaping how Premium Support adapts to new products, new customer expectations, and AI-assisted workflows, operating effectively in ambiguity and driving clarity for your team.

You’ll combine deep technical troubleshooting with calm, confident communication to keep builders moving — whether it’s an enterprise team deploying at scale or a top-tier developer relying on Replit to power their business.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Serve as the trusted front-line contact for large enterprise customers, guiding them on AI prompting best practices, resolving bugs, and turning feedback into a better product experience, whilst adhering to strict SLAs.

 - Diagnose, reproduce, and resolve complex technical issues across the Replit platform.

 - Escalate and track high-impact issues with Product and Engineering, ensuring timely fixes and transparent communication.

 - Lead customer-facing communications during outages or incidents.

 - Analyse recurring issues and identify process and documentation improvements to reduce time-to-resolution

 - Build and update internal tooling, automation, and documentation that improves team efficiency.

 - Partner with Engineering, Product, Sales and other internal teams to ensure Premium customers receive a consistent, high-quality experience.

 - Help onboard and mentor other support engineers, raising the team’s overall bar for responsiveness and quality.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 4+ years in technical support, developer support, or systems engineering.

 - Experience managing and delivering against operational SLAs for enterprise accounts

 - Strong hands-on debugging experience with JavaScript, Python, or similar languages, including the ability to read and reason through an unfamiliar codebase.

 - Working knowledge of APIs, databases, and Git-based CI/CD workflows.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to convey technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - Familiarity with support tools like Zendesk, Linear, Slack, and internal debugging utilities.

 - Proven ability to manage multiple high-priority issues simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and composure.

 - A proactive, ownership-driven mindset and genuine empathy for customers building on Replit.



NICE TO HAVE:

 - Has used Replit in the last 3 to 6 months.

 - Experience working with IDEs, terminals, or other common developer tools.

jobs.description:

Replit is building a modern, AI-native learning function, and we're looking for a Sr. Learning Experience Lead to own it. You'll own our learning platform and the onboarding and enablement experiences that run on it: designing them, delivering them, turning them into durable on-demand learning, and proving they work. This is a builder-leader role. You'll design learning, facilitate it live, build it into the platform, and measure its impact, and you'll do much of that hands-on, in the tools, the way a modern builder works.

 

You'll start close to home and grow the mandate. Your initial focus is owning the onboarding experience for our Support organization, taking it end-to-end and turning it into a real, tracked, repeatable system. Over time, you'll elevate onboarding and enablement beyond Support to the broader company, partnering with our People team, with the learning platform as the vehicle.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the learning platform. As its DRI, you own the roadmap, the learning journeys, and the instructional design behind them. You make the calls and own the outcomes.

 - Support onboarding, end-to-end. Facilitation, the live-to-on-demand pipeline, and the role-based journeys that get new team members confident and productive fast.

 - Create content and learning plans. Prescriptive learning paths and the content that fills them.

 - Own measurement criteria and data-driven results: The layer that proves onboarding and enablement change behavior and speed ramp, not just completion rates, with the tracking and feedback loops that keep it healthy over time. As the mandate grows.

 - Grow the platform and the learning function as adoption expands, raising the bar for how people learn at Replit.

 


REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - Deep L&D / learning-experience expertise. You've designed and run learning programs, not just authored content, and owned outcomes whose impact was visible across an org.

 - A builder. You turn ideas into working things with modern tools (you've built learning apps, LMS experiences, or similar yourself) and you'd rather ship and iterate than wait for a perfect spec.

 - A track record of leading multi-person, cross-functional efforts. You've stood up onboarding, cohort programs, or learning paths from scratch. You think about end-to-end experiences and create learning journeys that people actually use and love.

 - Facilitation chops. You can run the room live and convert what happens there into durable, on-demand content.

 - A measurement instinct. Pre/post, behavior change, co-designing metrics with the leaders and ICs who live with them; a healthy skepticism of vanity surveys.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT US:

Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money.

 

In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE:

Millions of people rely on Notion to do their most important work. Protecting that trust starts with protecting the people who build Notion: our employees, their laptops, their identities, and the SaaS apps they rely on every day.



We are looking for a hands-on Corporate Security Engineer to own and improve the technical controls that keep our workforce and corporate environment safe. This is a security engineering role focused on building scalable controls and automation across identity, endpoints, SaaS, and workforce infrastructure, not a traditional IT support or corporate engineering role.



You'll own and evolve core security controls, design systems and automation that scale with the company, and help make security both stronger and easier to use. You'll partner closely with IT, Infrastructure, GRC, and Detection & Response to improve the security foundations that employees rely on every day.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Harden our identity and access management stack, including Okta and Google Workspace, with phishing-resistant MFA, strong SSO and SCIM lifecycles, and least-privilege access across SaaS.

 - Run our endpoint security program across a macOS-first fleet, including MDM, EDR, and configuration baselines, with working coverage for Windows and ChromeOS.

 - Secure AI tool usage at the endpoint, including governance of large language models, AI agents, and model context protocol (MCP) integrations; detect and prevent unauthorized or risky AI service access and data exfiltration through AI-enabled tools.

 - Reduce SaaS risk at scale through SSPM tooling and custom automation, including detection of risky OAuth grants, excessive permissions, shadow IT, and configuration drift.

 - Write code (Python, Terraform) to automate access reviews, onboarding and offboarding, configuration drift detection, and audit evidence collection.

 - Partner with Detection & Response to ensure corporate systems produce the telemetry needed to detect identity, endpoint, and SaaS abuse.

 - Support SOC 2, ISO 27001, and customer audits as a byproduct of good engineering, not a separate workstream.

 - Partner with Detection & Response on investigation and response for corporate security incidents, including phishing, account compromise, lost devices, and BEC.

 


SKILLS YOU NEED TO BRING:

 - Have 5+ years of hands-on experience in corporate security, enterprise security, or IT security engineering at a cloud-native company.

 - Have working knowledge of a major identity provider (Okta, Entra, or Google Workspace) and the underlying protocols (SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM).

 - Have hands-on experience operating endpoint management and detection tooling across macOS and enterprise environments.

 - Write production-quality scripts and automation in Python or Bash, and have shipped Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code for security configuration.

 - Are familiar with SaaS security risks (OAuth governance, audit logging, SSPM) and the realities of integrating a long tail of vendors.

 - Have working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) at the security configuration level.

 - Communicate clearly in writing and work effectively across IT, Engineering, Legal, People, and GRC.



NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience at a fast-growing tech or AI company where the security program had to outpace headcount.

 - A background in IT engineering, SRE, or production engineering that transitioned into security engineering.

 - Experience building internal security tooling or workflows that improved employee or developer experience.

 - Contributions to the security community through open-source tools, blog posts, or conference talks.

 

We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you’re excited about a role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you’re a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Cleaning Supervisor – Full-Time Position in Copenhagen

We are looking for a responsible, well-organised and motivated Cleaning Supervisor to join our team in Copenhagen.

This is a hands-on position combining team supervision, customer communication, quality control and daily cleaning operations. We are looking for someone who enjoys working with people, takes responsibility and can effectively organise both their own work and the work of others.

Your responsibilities

  • Preparing and managing staff schedules and organising shift coverage

  • Maintaining regular contact with employees and coordinating their daily work

  • Communicating with clients and responding to their requests and needs

  • Training, onboarding and supporting new employees

  • Organising training and providing ongoing guidance to the cleaning team

  • Performing regular quality checks and ensuring that our cleaning standards are maintained

  • Ordering cleaning products, equipment and other necessary supplies

  • Cleaning at client locations when required

  • Handling day-to-day operational issues and finding practical solutions

  • Supporting and motivating employees in their daily work

  • Ensuring good communication between employees, management and clients

  • Supporting the company in acquiring and onboarding new clients

We are looking for someone who:

  • Speaks English confidently

  • Is willing and motivated to learn Danish

  • Has strong organisational and communication skills

  • Is comfortable communicating with both employees and clients

  • Is responsible, reliable and able to work independently

  • Can make decisions and solve problems in a busy working environment

  • Is flexible regarding working hours and willing to work in shifts

  • Is available to work every second weekend

  • Is willing to take part in cleaning duties when necessary

  • Living in Denmark is an advantage, but not a requirement. However, you must be willing and able to relocate to Copenhagen for the position

  • Has, or is able to obtain, the legal right to work in Denmark

  • Previous experience in cleaning, supervision, team coordination or a similar position is an advantage

What we offer

We offer a responsible and varied position in a stable and established cleaning company in Copenhagen, where you will play an important role in our daily operations and future development.

Salary: DKK 37,500 gross per month
Working hours: 38 hours per week
Schedule: Shift work, including every second weekend
Location: Copenhagen, Denmark
Employment: Full-time

The work will primarily take place at different client locations across Copenhagen, so flexibility and the ability to organise your working day are important.

We are looking for someone who is not afraid to take responsibility, enjoys working with people and is committed to maintaining high standards of cleaning and customer service.

How to apply

If you are interested in joining our team, please send your CV together with a motivation letter or a short video introducing yourself to:

info@teamclean.dk

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Growth Enablement
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT REPLIT

Replit is building the world's most ubiquitous AI coding agent. Replit Agent can be used by anybody to bring their ideas to life. Whether it's an app for yourself, the next great startup idea, or a tool to make you more productive at work, Replit Agent can help build it. Replit is also the leader in secure vibe coding. We protect apps, give users features to manage security risks, and help them vibe code more safely.





ABOUT THE ROLE:

Replit is changing how people and companies turn ideas into software. Reaching those customers requires engineering that connects acquisition to the product experience and gives teams trustworthy evidence about what works.


This role goes beyond operating conventional marketing technology. You will rethink growth systems for a world where agents can observe performance, diagnose problems, take action, and learn from the result.


As the founding engineer for Growth Enablement, you will set the technical direction for this area. You will build agentic systems alongside shared foundations for attribution, audiences, lifecycle engagement, referrals, and promotions. The work spans web, mobile, billing, and data.


You will work directly with marketing, sales, and partnerships to find the highest-leverage problems and ship the first solutions. Successful projects will become platforms that help these teams move faster and give Replit a clearer view of what drives durable growth.





YOU WILL:

 - Design agentic growth systems that monitor performance, diagnose failures, run approved experiments, and improve from the results.

 - Explore AI-native approaches to answer engine optimization, campaign operations, audience discovery, and measurement.

 - Build acquisition measurement across web and mobile, including click-ID capture, identity matching, server-side conversion APIs, and warehouse attribution.

 - Create a shared standard for deep links and context transfer across web, iOS, Android, and app-store handoffs.

 - Build reusable systems for promotions, referrals, campaign landing pages, fraud controls, attribution, and holdout measurement.

 - Build audience pipelines that sync warehouse-defined cohorts and exclusions to each delivery channel.

 - Work directly with marketing, sales, and partnerships to turn business needs into technical systems.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend expertise in TypeScript/Node, Python, Go, or a similar language.

 - Strong SQL skills and experience working with a data warehouse and event instrumentation.

 - Hands-on experience with attribution, marketing technology, deep linking, payment webhooks, or high-scale event pipelines.

 - A record of working with non-engineering partners to turn ambiguous business needs into shipped systems.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Built growth or martech infrastructure at a consumer or PLG company, such as referral systems, promotion platforms, lifecycle tooling, or CDPs.

 - Built agents that act on business data with clear evaluations, permissions, and human controls.

 - Experience with experimentation platforms such as Statsig and lifecycle tools such as Iterable.

 - Familiarity with privacy and consent handling in marketing data pipelines.




BONUS POINTS:

 - Experience shipping mobile attribution with OneLink, Universal Links, App Links, or SKAN.

 - Experience carrying attribution through payment systems such as Stripe or Razorpay.

 - Regular use of AI agents to plan, implement, test, or review your work.




WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Extreme ownership: identify important work, carry it through launch, and resolve blockers quickly.

 - Data-driven decisions: define hypotheses and success criteria before launch, then change direction when the evidence calls for it.

 - No borders: solve the highest-impact problem, whether it requires a PRD, a warehouse query, code, or campaign setup.

 - Speed through reversibility: ship the smallest step that produces useful signal, and slow down for decisions that are hard to reverse.

 - Strong communication: make technical constraints and business requirements clear to engineers and go-to-market partners.
   

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The hybrid role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: Social Comms
jobs.description:
Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr

NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce.

Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that.

The Social Comms role: We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment.

As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. You're a pundit, optimist, skeptic, researcher and writer all rolled into one.Â 

The measure of your work would be whether the right people are actually engaging: researchers, builders, journalists, policymakers, and the ordinary users who sense something is off. No growth-hacking or engagement bait please. We would rather stay small and authoritative than sound like a brand. The work is async, any timezone, and you'd have direct access to the passionate team and to everything we publish before it's public.

You will have a significant say and authorship of our blog (nascent stages still), linkedin, other social accounts, public spaces, and private community spaces that you recommend. Anything relevant to our work.

You'd be a great fit if

  • You care deeply about what AI is doing to human relationships and social norms; you're concerned and curious.
  • You understand how LLMs work at an abstract level and the flaws they have.
  • You've run or grown popular social accounts before.
  • You write like a person, and you don't lean on AI to think or post for you.
  • You can read a piece of research and find the three lines people will actually care about.
  • You can disagree with strangers thoughtfully in public, critics included.
  • You have a feel for which channels matter, and which ones aren't worth our time.
  • You have experience in civic domains, public-good, policy, trust-and-safety, or non-profits.

Bonus: you have already published material relevant to AI and its proliferation and risks.

jobs.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
jobs.description:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

 

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 

Duties

 

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

 

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

 

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

 

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

 

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

 

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

jobs.title: AI Response Analyst
jobs.description:
The work

iMerit, an EXL company, is looking for detail oriented analysts to evaluate and rank AI generated responses to image based prompts. You will judge answers on accuracy, relevance, clarity, conciseness, safety, localization, and how well they follow the user's instructions, then explain your reasoning in writing.

Much of the job comes down to this: look at the image, look at what the model said about it, and decide whether the two actually match.

What you will do

  • Review images alongside the prompts and responses attached to them

  • Interpret both visual and conversational context before scoring anything

  • Compare multiple responses and rank them against defined criteria

  • Confirm that descriptions and claims about an image reflect what is actually there

  • Verify factual claims using approved research sources

  • Flag tasks that cannot be reliably evaluated

  • Write clear justification for every ranking you submit

What you bring

  • A sharp eye for visual detail and the patience to look twice

  • Strong critical thinking, research skills, and reading comprehension

  • Sound judgment and well supported decision making

  • Professional written English, including the ability to describe what you see precisely

  • The consistency to apply detailed guidelines the same way, task after task

  • Experience in image annotation, content review, editing, research, design, or localization is welcome but not essential.

Good to know

  • Independent contractor engagement for the length of the project.Â 

  • Fully remote with flexible scheduling around agreed deadlines.

  • Tasks include visual content, so a device and connection that display images comfortably are required.

  • Volume varies with project demand.

  • The rate of pay will be specified in the job offer

jobs.title: Cohort 0
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



About the Role

Join Replit's key teams across the company, such as AI Research, Strategic Finance, or the Office of the CEO, for a unique paid internship built for sharp quantitative and creative minds. You will work alongside our top executives, in addition to world-class engineers, designers, and finance team on some of the hardest problems in AI-native software creation and accelerating key areas of our business.



We are creating a dedicated track for students with strong mathematical backgrounds because the problems we are solving sit at the intersection of deep math and applied AI, including agent reasoning, systems optimization, and improving how our models learn and perform at scale. Your work will directly shape how millions of users build software.




You Will:

 - Contribute to real engineering problems that push the boundaries of AI-powered software creation

 - Collaborate with engineers, designers, and product managers on infrastructure that powers Replit's platform

 - Prototype novel approaches to problems in AI, systems, or tooling where mathematical rigor is the differentiator

 - Ship work that impacts millions of developers globally, in an environment where your ideas are heard and often implemented



Required Skills and Experience:

 - Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Statistics, Physics, or a related quantitative field

 - At least one semester of schooling remaining after the internship

 - Demonstrated excellence in competitive mathematics such as IMO and IOI, quantitative research, or advanced coursework

 - Genuine curiosity about AI, agent systems, company building, or developer tooling

 - Extremely bullish on Replit and the future of AI-native software creation. We would love to see what you have built on the platform
   



What We Value:

 - First-principles thinking: Ability to break down complex problems from the ground up and reason about them rigorously

 - Mathematical intuition: Strong grasp of the underlying math behind machine learning, optimization, or systems

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating well with cross-functional teams

 - Strong communication: Ability to explain complex quantitative concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Curiosity and speed: Genuine excitement for hard problems and the drive to iterate quickly



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: Field Marketer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion has a very successful "land and expand" business model; our customers start using Notion for free, upgrade over time as they expand their teams, and embrace increasingly sophisticated use cases. Often, these users and champions are different than the person who has enterprise purchasing authority.

The Demand Generation team serves as a dot-connecter across sales, marketing, and operation teams to identify, engage, and convert decision makers at our target mid market and enterprise companies.

In this role, you will partner with demand generation teammates and sales stakeholders to ideate and execute in-person events, designed to help open, accelerate, and close business.

As a Field Marketing Manager, you will own and execute field events that are Notion-hosted, third party, co-partnered, and ancillary to third party events. This strategic position focuses on driving pipeline that meaningfully contribute to Notion's bottom line.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Delight Notion customers and prospects, with a guest-first approach to creating field events and experiences that bring the Notion brand and product to life.

 - Own end-to-end planning, execution, and measurement of field programs to support our AMER Sales team - encompassing executive experiences, large-format educational events, trade shows, and co-sponsored activations with partners.

 - Manage all event logistics, production, venue sourcing, budget tracking, marketing campaigns, sales enablement, content development, and audience acquisition.

 - Leverage quantitative and qualitative insights to make recommendations on how we invest in field events to drive incremental business impact.

 - Partner closely with Sales and broader Marketing team to align events and audiences to objectives for top accounts and craft tailored programs that nurture those accounts

 - Partner with our Operation and BizTech teams to manage and better utilize our go-to-market systems




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 4-5+ years of related marketing experience.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - You're a creative problem-solver who doesn't wait for a perfect playbook. You've built field events from scratch, and you're energized by figuring out what works in new territory.

 - You have a bias for action and experimentation. You'd rather test and learn than wait for consensus, and you know how to balance scrappiness with strategic thinking.

 - You're a strong cross-functional collaborator. You know how to work with sales, ops, and creative teams — and you can align people around a shared goal without needing authority to do it.

 - You're pipeline-obsessed. You understand how your programs connect to revenue and can speak credibly about pipeline contribution, not just top-of-funnel metrics.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience in a fast-paced, B2B tech environment

 - You're a Notion user and understand our value to businesses

 - Salesforce, Marketo experience



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $135,000-$160,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Brand Designer, Creative Studio
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

This role is based in New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.



This role sits on Notion’s Creative Studio, a small team of designers, illustrators, and filmmakers. Our work tells the story of our offering in a way that reflects the products themselves: smart, refined, and with a dash of wit on the side.



As a Brand Designer, you’ll work on high-impact brand initiatives and campaigns: setting direction from early strategy through final execution, partnering closely with stakeholders and executives, and raising the bar for craft and systems. You’ll be asked to define approaches, resolve ambiguity, and influence both project outcomes and how the team works.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Concept, art direct and design high-visibility moments from brand campaigns, product launches, and events, developing approaches that can scale across a broad range of surfaces, moments, and channels.

 - Contribute to our brand systems and develop standards and tooling that improve velocity and consistency for teammates near and far.

 - Mentor and raise the bar for other designers and creative partners through feedback, critique, and patterns that make great work repeatable.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 10+ years in an agency or in-house environment, with demonstrated leadership on ambiguous, complex, high-impact work.

 - A strong portfolio of work that’s culturally resonant and visually diverse, and that showcases your ability to tell stories across many channels.

 - A deep commitment to systems thinking, typographic excellence, and sensitivity to small details.

 - Experience working with a broad range of makers. You’ve teamed up with illustrators, animators, copywriters, filmmakers, photographers, and beyond to bring your ideas to life.

 - Excellent partnership skills. You can work hand-in-hand with cross-functional stakeholders, drive alignment, and make pragmatic tradeoffs.

 - A tinkerer’s mindset. You're curious about how your tools are evolving and have a strong perspective on how AI can expand creative expression and drive production. You’ll actively experiment with new AI workflows to concept, prototype, and push our design systems further.






Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $200,000 - $250,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. jobs.title: Systems Engineer – Aerospace & Optical Communications
jobs.description:
Full-time, primarily onsite position in Tallinn. We welcome applications from both strong junior and mid-level Systems Engineers. Starting date as soon as possible or by agreement.

Work tasks: The Systems Engineer will support the definition, coordination, integration, verification and delivery of Golbriak Space’s optical communication systems.
Main responsibilities: * Capture, analyse, define and maintain system and subsystem requirements * Translate product and mission objectives into clear technical requirements, actions and deliverables * Allocate requirements across subsystems and maintain traceability throughout the product-development lifecycle * Coordinate interfaces between mechanical, optical, electronic, software, thermal, manufacturing and testing activities * Identify technical dependencies, assumptions, constraints, conflicts and risks * Develop system-level verification and validation plans and define appropriate acceptance criteria * Support system integration, testing, troubleshooting and qualification activities * Review test results and verification evidence against defined requirements * Coordinate the resolution of technical issues involving multiple engineering disciplines * Track technical activities, dependencies, risks, decisions and milestones * Prepare and support technical and design reviews * Maintain requirements specifications, interface documentation, verification plans, technical reports and engineering decision records * Support configuration management and the controlled implementation of engineering changes * Collaborate closely with founders, engineering leads, technical teams, suppliers, partners and customers * Contribute to the improvement of systems-engineering processes, documentation and development workflows

We offer: * A central engineering role with direct impact on advanced optical communication systems
* Meaningful technical ownership across requirements management, system integration, verification and engineering coordination * The opportunity to work across mechanical, optical, electronic, software, manufacturing and testing disciplines * Close collaboration with an international and multidisciplinary engineering team * The opportunity to develop your expertise in systems engineering, optical communications, telecommunications and aerospace * The ability to contribute to technical decisions, engineering processes and ways of working as the company grows * A gross monthly salary of €2100–€3000, depending on experience, skills and expected level of responsibility * Relocation support to Estonia if required * Reasonable flexibility in working hours, consistent with operational and team needs

Other requirements: We are looking for a candidate with strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, technical curiosity and the ability to understand complex systems as a whole. The person should be able to identify dependencies, constraints and potential conflicts between different engineering disciplines.
The successful candidate will be organised, reliable and willing to take ownership. They should be able to coordinate multiple technical activities and priorities simultaneously. Strong communication and collaboration skills are required, together with the ability to explain complex technical information clearly. The company’s working language is English, so professional working proficiency in English is required. The candidate must be willing to work primarily onsite in Tallinn and be comfortable in a fast-moving environment where priorities and technical requirements may evolve.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: Freelance Copywriter
jobs.description:
CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.

 

The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.

 

About the Role

Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:

  • Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands
  • Skincare and beauty
  • Tech and software
  • Finance and investing
  • Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability
  • Education
  • Home improvement
  • Automobiles and motorcycles
  • Health and wellness
  • Medical and clinical fields
  • Digital marketing
  • SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing

Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities
  • Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites
  • Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy
  • Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors
  • Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices
  • Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing
  • Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team

Qualifications
  • Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills
  • 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred
  • Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices
  • Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics
  • Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content
  • Portfolio featuring published work preferred
  • Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred

Compensation

Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.

Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate

This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page

After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate

After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate

 

Application Process

Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

Võimalik on töötada ka ainult nädalavahetustel (näiteks laupäevast esmaspäevani) — töö sobib hästi lisatööks või hooajaliseks tööks suveperioodil. jobs.title: Outcomes Architect Manager, Tokyo
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As a first-line leader directly managing a team of Outcomes Architects, you’ll own your team’s execution across workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, expansion qualification, and at-risk account recovery — accountable for both the customer outcomes and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn’t a traditional Customer Success management role. The best OA Managers are coaches first: they know what great workflow discovery looks like, can review a mutual success plan and identify where value realization is breaking down, can inspect an executive business review and sharpen the value narrative, and can help an OA turn account activity into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

You’ll run an inspection cadence and cultivate a coaching culture that make consistent execution possible across the team. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultant leaders, Services, Support, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers move from workflow design to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal readiness.

If you’re a builder who loves developing people as much as driving customer impact — and you want to lead a team in a post-sales motion that’s being redefined for the AI era — this is the role




WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion.
